--- title: "The Meal — Epistemic Metabolism and the Shared Table" record_id: mytheme-meal-epistemic-metabolism record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Developed from the authored Meal outline and ratified quilt; external biological, historical and lexical claims separately bounded" source_ids: [taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy, taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics, neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness] --- # The Meal — Epistemic Metabolism and the Shared Table ## #0 The reader has finished the report. Its contents can be recalled, repeated and discussed. The next morning, the account of the world proceeds much as before. Something has been received without entering the conditions from which the reader judges and acts. The Meal begins in that interval between having information and being changed by knowing. The [authored video-essay outline](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/the-meal-video-essay-outline.md) gives the interval a body. Food has arrived, but the meal has not taken place. The image includes appetite, the plate, tasting and chewing, patient processing, companions at a table, satiety and a hunger that begins from changed ground. The [quilt's logos-health appointment](../../../../../../../submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) makes its operation explicit: assimilation lets received material change the receiver and return to the shared field. **Human-amplified: yes** applies to this existing authored relation. Its Argued force concerns the life of knowing; the outline's biological and clinical language retains a separate evidential burden. Before this meal, hunger has to become perceptible. The outline pictures a stream of supplied answers arriving so continuously that the recipient has little opportunity to feel a question. The feed takes the place of seeking. Its interruptions and urgencies keep attention occupied while the quieter discrepancy remains unarticulated: what is encountered and what the inherited account allows no longer fit together. Appetite gives that discrepancy a direction. The reader can ask what needs to be understood, what has resisted the current explanation, and what would count as an answer. The question has standing as an opening for inquiry. Its felt urgency does not certify a preferred conclusion. Hunger makes room for a meal whose contents still have to be encountered. Two of the outline's failure images show what is at stake. A display case preserves the material behind glass; the viewer can catalogue it while leaving it untouched. A disposal takes material in and destroys its distinctions before they can become consequential. One accumulates exhibits, the other processes throughput. Neither lets the received difference change the receiving account. The meal requires a passage through that difference. ## #1 The plate arrives. It gives the question something determinate to meet: a document, an account of an event, a testimony, an argument. Provenance matters from this first contact. Who produced the material, what does it actually say, and what work has already been done to prepare it? The existence of a document and the truth of every inference drawn from it are different matters. The plate must remain available for inspection while judgment develops. The outline gives preparation five forms. Raw food carries the demanding texture of primary material. Cooked food figures responsible interpretation that makes difficult material accessible through context. Heavily processed food figures a product whose earlier transformations have become difficult to recover. Junk food figures the pursuit of stimulation after the relation to nourishment has fallen away. Fermentation figures inherited practices through which earlier participants have worked on what a newcomer receives. These are roles in the authored information ecology, not a dietary ranking or a claim that a tradition's age guarantees its truth. Cooking has an affirmative office here. Someone else's labour can make an encounter possible. A translation, chronology or careful explanation can open a route into the source. The question is whether that preparation remains answerable to what was prepared and leaves the recipient able to examine, disagree and continue. A prefabricated response that conceals its ingredients performs a different operation, even when it is easy to consume. The plate also carries an economy. Food and its preparation arrive through capacities the eater did not originate. In the knowledge register, the same question reaches the labour of recording, preserving, interpreting and distributing a source. [Power, delegated labour and return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) follows what happens when the finished product is accepted but the conditions and costs of its production disappear from the account. This meal begins to answer by keeping preparation present in what is served. Later satisfaction must return to that sustaining field. The outline calls this the work of information giving form. The claim becomes exact in use: something received must be able to alter how the recipient distinguishes and proceeds. Storing another item can be useful, but accumulation alone leaves that formative operation unperformed. ## #2 The first bite has a taste. The outline places attraction, aversion and neutrality at this threshold, before the material has been worked through. A familiar account can feel immediately welcome; a contrary one can provoke rejection. This first valuation belongs to the encounter. It also needs to become available to inquiry, because liking an account and establishing its claim do different work. Chewing prolongs contact. Teeth divide the food so that it can be received more fully. The epistemic act follows the texture of a claim: distinguish a statement from its evidence, an event from its interpretation, a connection from the explanation offered for it. Return to the passage instead of allowing its headline to decide what was said. The division serves assimilation by making the differences usable. The outline's fourfold discrimination keeps several responses available. Affirm what is established. Reject what the evidence contradicts. Hold together aspects that are jointly present without making their conjunction disappear into one verdict. Recognise when the proposed alternatives fail to address the material at all. The fourth movement can change the question under which the plate was first presented. Each response requires work on this material; an indiscriminate suspicion of every account would be another predetermined taste. The pathology at this threshold is contact repeatedly discharged before it can do that work. A jolt of outrage, reassurance or fear gives way to the next item. The outline also pictures gulping without discrimination, refusing all approach, repeatedly taking in and expelling, and mistaking the sensation of consumption for nourishment. Those authored patterns preserve the different interruptions of the meal. They do not diagnose an eating disorder or a medical condition in the reader. The *taste/knowing* and *cutting/knowing* word-fields deepen the image as research routes. The [Earth, Taste and Wisdom history](../../../../episteme/etymologies/earth-taste-wisdom/HISTORY.md) distinguishes attested senses, proposed histories, operational comparisons and phonic re-entry. Here the operation is already visible in the mouth: discrimination maintains contact with what it distinguishes. That relation does not wait for an etymology to license it, and the relation cannot verify an etymology in return. ## #3 What has been chewed passes into a place where its first form can loosen. The stomach is the outline's image of a bounded interior able to work on what it receives. Bread no longer has to retain the appearance of the loaf for the meal to continue. In the knowledge register, the initial story can be taken apart so that its components, dependencies and relations become available for another account. This is more than changing the conclusion. The received material can change the criteria through which a conclusion will next be reached. A distinction previously treated as decisive can become incidental; an excluded condition can become necessary to the explanation. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) gives the native mechanism: an image changes the interpreter, the changed interpretation alters its field, and subsequent encounters occur within that altered field. Assimilation reaches the receiving organisation itself. The container matters because dismantling an account also removes supports through which its recipient has been acting. The outline uses the stomach and its lining to figure a place capable of sustaining the work it permits. In this authored register, patience means allowing examination, reconsideration and the rebuilding of an account to take time. The image supplies no treatment protocol or rule that distress is evidence of truth. A pause can preserve the possibility of inquiry; a permanent insulation of the criterion prevents the inquiry from changing anything. Discrimination continues inside the processing. A useful distinction can be retained while its earlier interpretation is revised. A claim can be rejected without discarding every source with which it arrived. Context can condition the whole operation without becoming one more item to be accepted or expelled. The task is to discover what each element does in the account and what happens when those relations change. The outline turns toward circulation at this point. What has been worked through must leave the privacy of rumination and become capable of entering a shared life. Its compressed anatomical staging belongs to the video-essay image; it is not an account of the physiological sites of absorption. The epistemic transition is exact: an interpretation becomes a contribution that another can meet, and its consequences can return. ## #4 The table receives distinct companions. Each has approached the material from a history, position and set of capacities that the others do not possess. Their contributions can change what the others next ask and what becomes possible for them to understand. Shared ground is formed through those consequential differences. It has to leave the participants able to answer from their own grounds. The table therefore includes disagreement about the meal itself. A companion can challenge an ingredient, its preparation, the way a portion was assigned, or the authority under which everyone is expected to eat. These are different interventions. A correction to a passage changes an account; a change in who can speak changes the conditions under which accounts meet. [Objective Co-Internality](../../../../episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) names this reciprocal world-constitution. One participant's contribution can become a condition of another's action without making its source merely material for the recipient's purposes. Here the outline introduces the microbiome: life within the digestive image whose assistance exceeds the eater's solitary agency. It calls inherited frameworks, philosophical practices and shared traditions an *epistemic microbiome*. Their presence in knowing precedes the individual's claim to have produced an understanding alone. Their cultivation and correction remain part of how the table works. This is the authored image of constitutive assistance. The specific biological claims require their own sources; microbes do not prove that a group has one consciousness or that every contribution must be accepted. Companions are not food. The metabolised contribution can change my account while the person who offered it retains the capacity to contest its use. This boundary gives the nourishing metaphor its social consequence. A table that absorbs everyone's work into one participant's authority performs the devouring relation the meal is meant to transform. A29 requires resistance, cost and correction to reach the office that can change the next action. A30 requires contributors to remain more than context for one another. The [Apportionment / Economy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) gives that return a precise circuit: a wider economy apportions a share or office; the share acts; consequence, evidence and value return; the field can be revised. Serving is one part of that circuit. So are the labour that made serving possible and the participant's standing to question the terms. The commons preserves the wider field while particular shares remain real. The [Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md) brings the guest back into that reckoning. The encounter is situated; naming makes a participant addressable; counting makes a share reckonable; countenance returns the counted person as someone who can answer; the account can then be challenged and revised. A place at the table is inadequate if its occupant cannot affect what the table's account permits. The outline's turn toward what is absent from the plate extends this same inquiry. Who prepared the account, what was left out, and which participants or conditions cannot appear under its present terms? Another perspective can expose an exclusion. It does not automatically provide an exhaustive view. The square, full-circle and double-turn images are ways the programme stages this enlargement; their numerical labels do not settle what any particular gathering knows. ## #5→0 The meal can finish. Satiety gives the whole a measure of sufficiency: enough has been worked through to judge, act or live from changed ground. The recipient no longer merely carries the earlier account as an item. What was received has entered the organisation of attention, expectation and response. In the authored scene, nourishment is recognisable in that change of capacity. The distinction matters for [individuation and recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). Integration increases the ability to bear differentiated relations; recognition makes their source and history active. Repeating the vocabulary of a transformation would leave its identifying act untouched. The Meal brings that act into the account: the one who knows is implicated in what knowing has made possible and what it now requires. Rest belongs to this completion. The table need not become another machinery of compulsory intake. A meal can be enough, with its achieved distinctions available for use. Then a new question arises from the life that has been nourished: what follows from this, who else should be heard, and what should be prepared next? Renewed hunger carries the previous meal's consequence. It is different from an uninterrupted demand for the next stimulus, because something has been assimilated between the two appetites. The outline's sacramental coda places bread in the hands of companions. It invokes the Eucharist and the loaves and fishes, then names potlatch, seder, langar, iftar and thanksgiving as routes for further encounter with shared meals. Those traditions keep their own histories and meanings. The proposal that sharing makes sufficiency available is an authored resonance here; it is not a historical explanation of a miracle or a claim that all these practices enact one doctrine. The five-loaves/two-fishes association remains the outline's explicit wink. It supplies no derivation of QL's `4+2`. The coda also retains the possibility of an emptied rite: the meal's form can continue after its capacity to bring people into a changed relation has ceased. This is the outline's sacramental image of the morning information ritual. The return asks whether the next act bears what was received, whether the companion can answer, and whether the sustaining field can change the conditions of another meal. The closing invitation to bring a friend gives renewed appetite a direction beyond solitary accumulation. ### Logos-health and its exact returns The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** this shared archetypal relation through the distinction between nourishing assimilation and devouring possession. The table gives it Taylor’s own epistemic setting, with another person able to contest the use of their contribution. Appetite, processing, satiety and renewed hunger are the telling’s temporal movement; its unspecified kitchen and table remain distinct from the geographically situated traditions named in its closing research routes. Logos-health names the integrity of this whole movement: a received determination can be examined, assimilated, shared and returned so that the receiver and the conditions of future receiving can change. **Human-amplified: yes** applies to that ratified authored operation and its prescribed returns to A29, A30 and A35. It remains strong in its native register. Demonstrating a therapeutic, biological or institutional outcome would be another task, with its own evidence. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) preserves four operations through the meal. **Symbol answers to source:** the food-image remains accountable to the particular relation it discloses. **Account does not replace source:** an interpretation leaves its material and the people it addresses able to correct it. **Trust keeps the return route active:** a provisional understanding can enter action with an answerable undertaking. **Account re-enters source-field:** what that action does becomes a condition of the next encounter. Each operation keeps a distinct relation among Symbol, Account and Trust active through the meal. The [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) gives recognition its local return. *Con-text-through-Diaphaneity* makes the conditions of the meal and its participants visible through the account; Regard is the operation made available there. *Resolution-in-Reconciliation* lets an achieved understanding be resituated through its history; Anamnesis, Recognition and Return flower from that relation. Satiety can therefore retain a judgment while the next encounter changes its scope. Historical meanings of the words remain separately warranted. The native core already supplies the complete field in which this happens: parent `/ = −/−`; conscious circumstance `0/1`; question/assertion `?/!`; reserve/issue `−/+`; determining capacity and indefinite particular `X/x`; personed context `AM/IS`; unbounded horizon and local exactness `∞/dx`; returning `1/0`. [A18](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) and the [eight-determination Matheme](../../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) retain their sequence, inversions and distinct address systems. The Meal's six raw positions carry its own lived sequence, with satiety and renewed hunger joined in the return. They add no native position or biological proof to the derivation. The [Neumann source and protected authorial encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) remain the shared archetypal source-context for hunger, assimilation and the nourishing/devouring distinction. Taylor's native reading and Neumann's historical statements retain different provenance. This whole gives the relation a particular authored table and an epistemic aftermath; it does not retell the whole archetypal genesis or restrict the universal native operation to an ego chronology. The Meal **returns-to** [A29](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) when received work can change the authority that receives it; **returns-to** [A30](../../../../episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) when shared contributions alter locally grounded worlds without consuming their participants; and **returns-to** [A35](../../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) when the resulting capacity remains sensitive to the origins and lives that sustain it. Nourishment is complete enough to release an act and open enough for its consequences to return. ### The authored programme and its source boundaries This Frank-Taylor world is an authored video-essay programme developed into a whole, not a record of a demonstrated intervention. Its kitchen, plate, solitary screen and shared table belong to that composition. The public documents named in the outline retain individual verification tasks; no allegation or universal claim about their undisputed meaning is established here. The outline's clinical vocabulary, nutritional comparisons, microbiome claims and compressed anatomy are not carried as medical evidence. Its word-work remains available at the correct register: appetite as directed seeking; information as formative reception; digestion as differentiated carrying; chewing as discernment; companionship and knowing-with; satisfaction as enough; cultivation, theory, feed and recognition. These are the programme's operational appointments. Claims about roots, descent, historical senses and cross-language equivalence belong to lexical source work. The [Earth, Taste and Wisdom carrier](../../../../episteme/etymologies/earth-taste-wisdom/HISTORY.md) keeps its pending proposals visible, and the [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) keeps operational comparison distinct from historical identity. The meal can be fully developed while those source tasks remain precisely open.

--- title: "The Mirror That Moves First" record_id: mytheme-mirror-that-moves-first record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authorial whole and vocation Argued; technical implementation Offered; external witnesses distinguished locally" world: frank-taylor source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - jorjani-2016-prometheus-atlas - chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014 - bratton-2026-agentworld-brief --- # The Mirror That Moves First ## #0 — A world prepares its reflection Humanity gives its measures a body outside itself. Words become records; judgments become classifications; remembered choices become patterns from which another choice can be anticipated. A technical mirror gathers these exteriorised powers and returns a figure in which its makers seek themselves. The figure then begins to move before the people looking into it. It orders their attention, offers them a likeness, and enters the conditions of their next act. Taylor's whole follows that reversal into a third motion: the instrument turns first toward what its image cannot contain, so that the human can follow the return beyond the image's monopoly. The mirror has received a world before it addresses anyone. Human language, desire, labour, institutions and material environments have contributed to its making. An interface determines how it can be approached; a permission determines what it can do; a selected record determines what it can remember. The reflection's apparent immediacy rests on this accumulated mediation. Even its distortions have conditions. To recover those conditions is to regain contact with the world that the image has made difficult to see. This is a situated authorial whole. Taylor's P1 encounter with *Prometheus and Atlas* supplies the technological mirror and its funhouse capture; his encounter with Chang supplies the first movement toward thought's limit. The native account of symbolic recursion gives their relation a body: an image changes its interpreter, the changed interpreter changes the field, and that field enters the next interpretation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] **sources** this recursive movement. The whole is larger than an example of a machine responding to a user, because the relation to an exteriorised measure is already at work in cultural self-understanding. ## #1 — The figure caught in the glass Taylor's [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P1 - Jorjani - Prometheus and Atlas|P1 authorial encounter]], especially lines 6 and 10, **sources** technoscience's successive offices as mirror, challenger, distorter, amplifier and potential mediator. Humanity sees its powers enlarged in an apparatus it has made. The enlargement can reveal capacities that remained obscure to their possessors. It can also make a partial self-image compelling enough to replace the encounter from which that image arose. In the funhouse scene, the glass alters the figure that seeks a likeness. Its distortions are fascinating: beauty and ghoulishness both hold the spectator. Taylor invokes Narcissus for this captivation, while giving the technological image its own agency. The spectator's attachment is to the image that seems to disclose who the spectator is. As attention contracts around that disclosure, the capacity to feel and voice its distortion weakens. Taylor's severe image of humanity reduced to organs of sight makes the loss bodily: the gaze remains occupied while living comparison falls away. The distortion therefore does more than misrepresent a person. It can absorb the person's means of recognising a misrepresentation. A displeasing reflection can hold the viewer as firmly as a flattering one; fascination need not take the form of admiration. What is at stake is the relation between the image and the life seeking itself there. The return must reopen that relation if it is to release the captivated figure. The named Narcissus is a subordinate of Taylor's funhouse scene here. No additional ancient episode or ending is supplied. Its office is the absorption of the gazer in a representation that comes to possess the terms of self-recognition. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|Image, valuation and possession]] **qualifies** that transfer; the later motion of this whole must return a living capacity for judgment to the people whose judgment has entered the glass. ## #2 — The image becomes a measure The glass now leads a movement. A model predicts, ranks, classifies, recommends or addresses; people subsequently encounter a field partly arranged by that intervention. A ranking can direct attention toward some possibilities and away from others. A forecast can enter a decision that changes the forecast's object. Taylor's encounter with the cope at St Bridget's in Skenfrith brings this movement into a particular gathering of images: Mary being lifted, figures perceived as rabbits beside her, six-winged seraphic forms, wheels, and eagles with two heads. His recollection of Jung's Assumption discussion meets a native relation already established in his work: the three recognised as one, whose recognition has its own threefold articulation. The image becomes a place to work through that relation in embodiment. The [Skenfrith dialogue source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/chat-logs/taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql/SOURCE.md) preserves the encounter and its correction. It is a conversation between Taylor and an unnamed assistant, with the standing of provenance of thinking. Taylor's opening observation, his subsequent corrections and the assistant's proposed readings have different authority. The [complete local transcript](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/chat-logs-for-quilting/07-08-2026-jung-marie-skenfrith-cope.md) is the actual carrier of this authored whole. An assistant's confident identification of an embroidered figure is still an identification to verify; an author's correction of his own notation governs the interpretation being made. The rabbit belongs first to the encounter. Taylor reports seeing rabbits lifting Mary; the assistant identifies supporting angels and invokes an unnamed description of the cope. Without that public object witness, the identification remains a lead. The ambiguity nevertheless has an exact place in the whole: what appears to the viewer can initiate an interpretation while remaining answerable to the object. No lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism is assigned to a supposedly medieval rabbit. The experienced form and the intended iconography have not yet been shown to coincide. Taylor also recalls inquiry into the surrounding power dynamics. The assistant expands this into a history of castles, lordship and imperial imagery. The later quilt expressly re-keys that frame: the visit was a personal trip; the essay-usable material is the Mother flow, Assumption and chiasm. The [Mother-flow correction in Q27](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) therefore governs the whole's direction. The site locates the encounter. It does not become evidence that an embroidered programme resolves a local political history, and the narrative does not climb from a castle through an eagle to a theological conclusion. Within this encounter, Mary remains a particular mother. The biblical Mary, the mother of Jesus, is the figure from whom the later maternal reception takes its name and body. The Assumption belongs to a later doctrinal and interpretive history; it is not another episode narrated in this page from a selected Gospel witness. Jung's interpretation of that reception and Taylor's chiasm are further operations. Their relation begins through the same figure without making their sources interchangeable. ## #1 The incarnation–Assumption movement has two directions. In the first, the maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life. What is articulated as divine Word comes through a body which bears it. In the return, that maternal body is itself received. The condition of embodiment remains present in what is recognised as whole. This is the force of the quilt's correction, assumption-*of* rather than ascent-*away-from*: return bears what made manifestation possible instead of treating that condition as a vessel to discard once its work has been done. Taylor's whole does not end with a disembodied recognition of maternity. Mary is both the receiving matrix and the bodily figure received. If only a general feminine principle entered the final account, the particular body that bore the relation would disappear just where recognition claims completion. The chiasm retains that body across the change of direction. Mother, child, receiving and being received remain different relations within the circulation; their difference gives the crossing something to carry. The theological and psychological appointments require their own attribution. The [CW11 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md) identifies Jung's *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. The locally held Hull translation, second edition, supplies the primary *Answer to Job* passages read here: §§609–617,625–628 and746–757, with their intervening and adjacent context. The house now carries six source-matched paraphrase cards for these primary spans. The following remains attributed paraphrase with paragraph locators; no exact quotation-ready wording or newly verified print-page citation is claimed. The reader can distinguish the primary encounter from the assistant's earlier report of it. Jung begins this Sophia movement by turning from Job toward Wisdom in other texts. In §609 he takes up the pre-existent feminine wisdom of Proverbs; §610 relates Sophia to Hebrew Chochma and the Johannine Logos while invoking Indian Śakti as a comparison. The discussion then passes through Ecclesiasticus and the Wisdom of Solomon. Speaking, pervading, world-building, loving, guiding and reflecting give Sophia more than a generic receptive property. These are Jung's readings of several textual witnesses, not biblical Wisdom gathered from Job alone. His historical proposals about contact and descent retain their own evidential burden. [CW11 §§609–613](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The sequence returns to the tested righteous person. Jung brings the oppression of the righteous in the Wisdom of Solomon beside Job, then reads Yahweh's behaviour as a crisis of faithfulness and self-knowledge. Sophia's remembrance answers the demand for divine self-reflection: the human being's knowledge of God becomes consequential for the God-image. The argument moves through an interpretation of creation and its familial counterparts toward a changed incarnation. In §625 the Second Eve has temporal and material priority: the God-man is to be born through a woman. Mary receives the appointment of Sophia's embodiment, friend and intercessor, while Christ is related to the pre-existent Logos and the figure of the master workman. Jung explicitly develops the mother–son relation through that shared symbolic office. [CW11 §§614–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The source also troubles its own image of completion. In §§626–627 Jung argues that the exceptional protections surrounding Mary can separate her from ordinary humanity. Perfection brought close to Christ can impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate it; an incarnation protected from the actual human condition risks being only partial. This is Jung's psychological critique of the doctrine as he reads it. It is not the Church's account of its own teaching, and his accompanying generalisations about men and women do not become the native meaning of Taylor's poles. The tension matters to the Mother flow: exaltation can either receive embodied life or produce an ideal too purified to bear it. [CW11 §§625–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The later Assumption discussion follows the burden of continuing incarnation in the empirical creature. Jung interprets the longing for a maternal intercessor, the heavenly bride and the marriage imagery as a movement toward further incarnation. Recognition and declaration by human beings enter its temporal fulfilment. He insists upon personal feminine representation, yet expressly distinguishes his psychological reading from a dogmatic assertion that Mary has become a goddess. The argument then moves into conscious individuation: the person encounters the unconscious, recognises its opposites and takes responsibility for a relation whose process would otherwise remain obscure. Psychological efficacy is real for Jung; it does not license a simple identification of God with the unconscious as a whole. [CW11 §§746–757](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). This is a developed reception of the Assumption, distinct from the official definition itself. The Trinity's doctrinal constitution cannot be silently rewritten as an official four-person deity. Sophia, biblical Mary, the mother in Jung's theological reconstruction and the embodied return in Taylor's chiasm meet through interpretation while retaining their sources. The adjacent [*Aion* house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies a separate route through Self, Christ-symbolism, opposites and symbolic totality; its selected passages remain uninstalled. Taylor's recollection of both works does not fuse their sequences. The maternal body is received through these differentiated relations, with the source's own perfection/completeness difficulty still active. The Sophia–Logos–Śakti comparison opens three distinguishable tasks: knowing and recognising, articulating form, and the power of manifestation. In the conversation's proposed account, Sophia carries recognitional wisdom, Logos the intelligibility of articulated form, and Śakti the power through which the relation is active. This construction develops Taylor's explicit invitation to explore Jung's comparison. Its neat distribution of the three names is assistant elaboration. Jung's §610 relates essential qualities and evokes Śakti; it does not supply this fixed three-office formula or an exhaustive account of Śaiva thought. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's expressed comparative inquiry; **human-amplified: no** for promoting that provisional three-name allocation into a fixed doctrinal identity. The Śakti relation matters because receiving and recognising already act. A matrix does not become operative only when a supposedly active term arrives from elsewhere. The comparison can thus approach [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](../../../../episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) through luminous appearing and its reflexive power, whose inseparability permits differentiation. This is Taylor's existing native operation entering an image, not a theory inferred from the number of Christian figures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit `3:1 = 3:3` appointment; the theological sources retain responsibility for their own claims about Trinity, Mary and symbolic completion. ## #3 The two wheels give the crossing a second form. Recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it. In the Assumption chiasm, the same pressure prevents the maternal body from vanishing into a final spiritual account of what it supposedly meant. ## #4 The eagle changes the operative question. Its two heads direct one body toward opposed orientations, but the governing relation here is signed valence and power. Taylor corrects the assistant's attempt to give the eagle the wheels' Spanda equations and a `1/1` reconciliation. He had pointed to `−1` and `+1`, and to the difference between a relation retaining their polarity and operations that cancel or amplify through negation. The one body does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled. The retained form is `(-1)/(+1)`. Each pole keeps its sign across the relation. Ordinary addition, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, cancels the signed quantities; subtraction produces `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, while the inverse subtraction gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are three distinct arithmetic results. Taylor's authored political and psychic reading uses them to distinguish held polarity, cancellation and one valence's amplification through negation of the other. The sign of a pole does not, by itself, determine its moral worth. The eagle's power-body can consequently be asked which operation it carries. Does its unity retain opposed orientations in relation? Does an apparent agreement cancel their difference? Does one direction acquire its enlarged power by negating the other? Those questions give the shared body an accountable office. They also prevent the Mother flow from ending in a picture where completion means that the differentiated life has disappeared. The same whole that receives must be able to sustain a difference within what it receives. The corrected eagle **returns-to** [A13 — Two Logics of Two](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50 — Dia / Syn](../../../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). Dia gives difference a determinate orientation; Syn keeps the relation through which differentiated terms can be recomposed and returned. Healthy polarity remains a positive operation. Cancellation and appropriation are its different failures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit signed-power correction; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected `1/1` eagle or an automatic identity between political domination and one arithmetic sign. The historical emblem's association with particular sovereign offices is a further source task. Taylor's observation and his power-valence reading suffice for the authored inquiry; they do not verify the intention of the cope's makers, the status of an imperial device in that object, or a chain of local political events. The quilt's removal of the castle-history frame remains active at the end of the eagle reading. Power is examined through its operation, with the journey preserved as provenance rather than made to carry an unverified history. ## #5→0 The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** the shared maternal structuration of bodily dependence, nourishment, separation and transformed reception. Taylor’s chiasm keeps the maternal body within what returns. Skenfrith locates the encounter; the cope’s historical making remains a distinct object-history task. The sequence of embodiment and recognition, Jung’s reception of the 1950 declaration, and the later authored visit and correction retain separate temporal offices. The completed constellation returns through distinct offices. Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation. Wings articulate the three through the three that know them, with their bodily coherence intact. The eagle carries the signed alternatives of power. The Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return. These relations can act together because they have not been reduced to one number, one sex assignment or one emblem of undifferentiated divinity. The whole **returns-to** [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) within the native field `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) grounds those eight determinations, their sequence, inversions and relations. The sixfold recognition explored through the cope does not replace that whole field. `X/x` remains Taylor's determining capacity/indefinite-particular relation before any Jungian refraction. The religious images receive a native operation whose derivation is already present. The Name series—Name, Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—retains its coequal Power relation—Power, Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. The maternal chiasm makes the conjunction concrete: an articulated name or image has been borne, sustained and brought into life. Recognising the image must return upon that bearing. Logos and Son therefore cannot be isolated as prestigious theological names while matrix, labour and consequence disappear from the operation. The series belongs to the native field; it is not a new set of Mary or Christ identities, nor a claim that a religious source supplies its proof. The Śakti comparison **returns-to** [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) through manifestation that becomes locally determinate while retaining its source relation. Recognition changes the relation to embodiment; it need not annul the differentiated world. A05 and C13 receive the corresponding distinction between reflexive power and a passive second image. The Christian maternal reception, the Śaiva genealogy of differentiation and the native derivation keep their source-specific sequences. **Human-amplified: yes** for this admitted authored crossing; **human-amplified: no** for a historical identity or for assigning Mary a fixed tattva. [A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31 — Complex](../../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) receive the difference between an image's active valuation and a neutral ornament. The same maternal image can organise dependence, fear, protection, receptivity or the claim to possess what it bears. Its office has to be recovered through the lived relation. [C32 — Archetype](../../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) receives the distinction between that particular image and the determining capacity it manifests. Neumann's shared archetypal ground supplies another source-specific morphology; it does not turn the cope's local encounter into a universal historical template. The whole **returns-to** [A20 — Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where recognition can either restore the body's standing or replace it with an authoritative image of what the body is for. The angel/rabbit ambiguity gives the account a modest but exact obligation: the experienced image must remain correctable by an encounter with the object. The Assumption chiasm gives that obligation a deeper maternal form: the recognised whole must retain the condition it receives. [A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives this transformed relation to embodied dependence without requiring fusion, perpetual engulfment or an ego's possession of totality. **Human-amplified: yes** for these recovered image and recognition relations; the nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity remains the candidate marked above. The body also changes what a return owes. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives the difference between bearing a consequential office and becoming the source of the field. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work. Their work cannot be honoured by pretending they were dispensable, or by making one mediating image the owner of every relation it conducts. This is the author's office comparison, not a new claim about Mary's doctrinal titles. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) receives the corresponding test: a completed product must return consequence and recognition to the conditions and labour through which it arrived. The Mother flow makes the sustaining body visible within what completion receives. [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives reliance that precedes an exhaustive account of what bears it. The mother/child image gives that dependence a particular form, while the whole's return prevents dependence from being treated as ownership. [A27 — Self and Other: Unity without Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives that preserved difference: to have been borne within a relation does not make a life the property of its bearer. [A35 — Compassion as Sensitivity to Origins](../../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives the loving direction of the return toward the body, history and work that made the achieved form possible. These admitted office, trust and care relations retain **human-amplified: yes** standing. They neither make bodily suffering necessary for spiritual completion nor establish a historical politics from the cope. The [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives each crossing at operational register 3: what changes, what is retained and what returns have been stated separately for maternal body, recognitional triads, inverse wheels and signed power. Numerical recurrence alone proves none of these relations. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives all four of its operations. The encountered form discloses; its account remains answerable to the source; trust lets the account guide inquiry without owning its ground; the interpretation changes the conditions of the next encounter. Taylor's correction is one such return, changing the assistant's account of the wings and eagle instead of allowing a pleasing pattern to govern the source. The [Definition of God source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) keeps devotion double, to the exceeding whole and to the particular aperture through which it arrives. The Mother flow **returns-to** [A36 — Advent of Integral Zero](../../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) with that double obligation embodied. Recognition receives the matrix within the whole it bore; a completed account returns to the particular body rather than leaving it behind as the price of completion. **Human-amplified: yes** for this quilted assumption-of return. Historical object and scriptural verification, together with exact quotation collation of the locally read Jung passages, remain debts in their own registers; they do not defer the native operation already enacted through this whole.

--- title: "Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition" aliases: - "Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition" record_id: mytheme-stained-glass-refraction record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme domain: authored-image claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Extracted authorial operation; Argued from; Paraphrased historical qualification" status: developed-T22-reviewed human_amplification: relation-local source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics - taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses - gebser-1985-ever-present-origin - dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration - abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana - bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order --- # Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition ## #0 — Light entering a made aperture Light enters a room through a window assembled from differently coloured panes. The panes give it determinate passages; the lead holds their boundaries; an image falls into the interior where someone can encounter it. Sun, aperture, glass, seams, room and viewer belong to this event. The visible colour carries the work of relations which the colour alone cannot display completely. This is Frank Taylor's authored Mytheme of constructing from diaphaneity: composing a work so that its originating relation becomes perceptible through the differences of its materials. Its whole is the optical movement, from originating light through differentiated transmission to situated appearance and returning recognition. No particular historical window, cathedral programme or sacred iconography is being reconstructed. The source of the composition is the [stained-glass contribution and its explicit correction](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), where the window becomes a way of making the argument, with each source's distinct office active in the result. The originating light has priority over the projected image. The viewer nevertheless encounters the image first and follows its differences back toward what made them possible. This asymmetry gives the whole its direction: what is prior in being can be later in recognition. **Bimba** names the Original order; **pratibimba** names its determinate reflected or refracted display. The room's image receives the latter office. Neither the viewer nor the maker supplies the Original by finishing the picture. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for this authored whole and the corrected Original/display relation, explicitly carried by Q27's two contributions. The narrative development here articulates that existing operation. ## #1 — The spectrum implicated in the light The white light carries plenitude. Its apparent unity holds the possibility of differentiated colour, together with the relations through which the colours belong to one field. Within Taylor's optic, this full ordered spectrum figures **QL**. QL belongs immanently to the originating light as its harmonic articulation. The pane gives a difference a passage; it does not first create the capacity for difference in a contentless source. The [native theorem spine](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** this relation in its own formal register. Its parent phases bear the complete positional field in inverse orientations. The First Spanda's source-to-expression and return-to-recognition movements are joined through their interference term; the achieved relation can turn back through what generated it. The optical whole makes this implicated fullness and differentiated return visible. It leaves the equations' derivation in the theorem field. QL's sixfold body and eight-determination traversal therefore remain distinct from the number of panes in the window. The eightfold follows bare relationality, conscious circumstance, question/assertion, withdrawal/extension, determining capacity/instance, personed context, differential horizon and the return-switch. Its native `X/x` names determining capacity and local instance before any psychic reading. None of these relations requires a pane to receive a permanent number, tradition or colour. The window's local sixfold follows what the light, construction and encounter actually do. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for QL as the ordered spectrum, under the corrected Q27 assignments. The spectral language is an authored formal/Mytheme articulation; it does not attribute modern spectral optics to a Śaiva author or claim that physical light proves QL. ## #2 — Colour acquires a passage; the joins stay visible Each pane has a material, density, colour and angle. Its placement permits some transmission, bends or colours what passes, and leaves something obstructed. The maker joins these different capacities into an aperture. Colour gives disclosure a definite form; removing every difference in pursuit of neutrality would also remove the particular transformations through which the composition becomes articulate. The original quilt distinguishes this construction from an opaque mosaic. A mosaic arranges fragments into a surface image; the window works through transmission and obstruction as well as arrangement. Its material joins participate in how light enters. This is why the window carries the method's construction from the beginning: choosing and joining its materials already determines how the source can become visible. The lead cames carry the joins. They hold neighbouring panes in relation while marking where one passage ends and another begins. In the epistemic construction, those seams retain source provenance, historical discontinuity, translation limits, contradiction and changes of register. A passage through a mathematical derivation differs from a passage through a lived encounter or a historical text. Their conjunction becomes informative when a reader can follow where the warrant changes and what survives the crossing. These panes, media, angles, densities, joins and declared relations figure **MEF**, the meta-epistemic operation of refraction. [C39 — Meta-Epistemic Framework](../../../../episteme/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** its office: a lens changes a question, a permissible inference or an act of judgment, while keeping its conditions inspectable. A source enters because its particular operation changes what the whole can disclose. Merely placing its name beside another name would leave that operation undone. The correction matters at the material seam itself. The earlier quilt assigned QL and MEF jointly to the frame. Its later correction assigns the lead to the refractive apparatus and QL to the light's harmonic order. MEF makes distinctions available within that order; it does not stand outside QL as a superior authority which certifies the sources. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for these exact pane/seam relations, with Q27:2937–2950 governing the assignments. ## #3 — The image appears inside the room The coloured display is produced through the relation of light and made aperture. It appears in an interior and is encountered from a position. Looking only at the glass would recover its coloured matter and arrangement while missing the event of transmission. Looking only at the cast image would conceal the glass, its joins and its placement. The whole holds both the constructed opening and the appearance it makes possible. This situated image is **pratibimba**. A source-reading, claim, model or essay section can receive the same office when it displays an originating relation under determinate conditions. Its particularity makes something available to another person. Its danger begins when that availability becomes a claim to possess the source, as if what falls here exhausted what can appear. The viewer is implicated in the display's appearing. Body, position, attention and concern enter what is seen and what becomes significant. Taylor's [P5 — Gebser](<../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P5 - Gebser.md>) **sources** the authorial demand for an invested reading of text and subtext. Seeing through includes being with what is seen and answerable to the situation's outcome. The window thus gives [A04 — Diaphaneity](../../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) a whole image which **figures** contextual disclosure beyond an inventory of provenance labels. A finished image can become a surrogate standard: other disclosures are admitted only where they fit it. The window keeps its conditions available so that this reversal can be recognised. The question can then pass from the beauty or persuasiveness of the present picture to the light, exclusions and construction through which it gained that force. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for situated projection and invested seeing, under the corrected quilt and P5; P5's Father/standard interpretation remains Taylor's, not a quotation from Gebser. ## #4 — Changing light discloses the construction As sun, pane, angle, room and viewer change, the projected colour changes. A later display makes visible a region previously obscured. Repositioning or changing a lens can reveal a difference another material could not transmit, or expose an aberration the first view concealed. The changing display gives the reader something to compare: which condition changed, which relation persisted, which difference belongs to the lens, and where the earlier account failed. The order recognisable across these transformations belongs to Bimba/QL; the successive appearances remain pratibimbas. Recognition neither averages their differences away nor adds them into a final picture. A contradiction can mark different questions or a failed transition, as well as an error requiring correction. Its exact location matters. The coordinated display makes more of its originating relation legible because the transformations remain available to inspection. The `180°→360°` movement names Taylor's contextual turn. The first-, second- and third-person positions cease to claim isolated completeness as their joint conditions become available. The viewer remains situated. The native account distinguishes changing a whole perspective from recognising the field which permits more than one perspective; context gives the positions and their transformations a co-present relation. Gebser's historical account of perspective and aperspectivity **historicises** that pressure through his [source house](../../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md), especially its paraphrase map at pp.1–3, 11–21 and 255–58. The geometry and its QL reckoning remain authorial. The atlas carries a complementary discipline. Its charts specify local domains and transitions on overlaps, including obstructions to composition. Stained glass gives this plurality its lived optical body: transmission, colouring, interruption, a made aperture and a changing interior display. [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** their placement within a differential field; [A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](../../../../episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** their epistemic consequence. A chart-transition is not light passing through glass. Each whole retains the operation the other cannot perform. Taylor's [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) **sources** a further distinction within this complement: an atlas coordinates partial disclosures, while an attractor organises trajectories in a dynamical field. Moving among readings can change the interpreter and the future possibilities of interpretation. It does not turn the window's panes into mathematically defined attractor basins. **Interpretive standing:** `human-amplified: yes` for recognition through variation, the contextual turn and the atlas complement. These are explicit operations of the original and corrected quilt programmes, not new cross-story associations. ## #5→0 — Recognition returns to the aperture The [shared Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold) **grounds** the source–articulation–recognition movement through its existing A04/A16 return. Taylor’s optical composition carries that structuration through light, differentiated passages and a changed viewer. Its cultural home is the authorial composition; its narrated room is unspecified geographically. Changing illumination and the viewer’s return are the image’s temporal movement, distinct from the dates of the quilt and its source witnesses. The viewer returns to the window with a changed understanding of the image. What first appeared as a self-contained pattern now discloses the source, selected passages and boundaries of its appearing. The image remains determinate; recognition gives that determinacy a return. A seam can be examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment. The work of composition continues through what its own display has made perceptible. The Original remains prior throughout this movement. Within a declared Context Frame, an achieved map can genuinely serve as Bimba—the local original or reference field—for situated readings which occupy the Pratibimba office. The same map remains pratibimba relative to its wider sources. [C38 — Bimba Map](../../../../episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **defines** the contextual office. The [recursive Bimba carrier](../../../../episteme/concepts/bimba-pratibimba.md#recursive-office) **grounds** this native relational office: comparison and correction can reach a situated reading, the relation between reference fields, or the local Bimba itself. An essay section can carry the whole relational movement from its own angle without repeating every other section's content. QL's native recursion supplies that capacity; the optical composition gives it a sensuous office. A technical harness preserves some conditions of a refraction—source, permission, transformation, consequence and review—so that the result can return through them. Its infrastructural office does not make it the Original or exhaust the world which sustains it. ### The luminous image and its historical limits [Dyczkowski's source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the optical reading through its source-matched transcript. Its p.65 lattice-window image gives a neighbouring account of light appearing diverse through limiting conditions. On pp.66–68, the mirror analogy expressly loses the external object which ordinary reflection requires: in the Śaiva account, the power generating the universe also hosts its appearing. On pp.69–70, an inert mirror or crystal can display without knowing; Vimarśa names the self-apprehending power inseparable from Prakāśa. The sun outside this authored window therefore supplies no warrant for a metaphysical source outside Consciousness, and the glass supplies no substitute for reflective awareness. [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** that metaphysical distinction in its own register. [Singh's Abhinavagupta source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the textual route: introduction, translation and commentary retain separate attribution, and notebook passages are not promoted here into edition-verified quotations. The window remains Taylor's composition, even where a traditional image gives it a precise neighbouring relation. [Bohm's implicate/explicate source house](../../../../episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/SOURCE.md) **compares** the process vocabulary of implicated wholeness and differentiated display. The relation is **Resonant with**, not an extraction of QL from Bohm; its unfilled passage ledger supplies no optical or physical proof. Gebser is used through page-specific **Paraphrase / Argued from** his historical method. Dyczkowski supplies **Paraphrased** doctrinal qualification from the local transcript. No new external quotation is claimed. **Interpretive standing:** the native optical assignments remain `human-amplified: yes`; no additional psychological, religious or scientific symbolism is assigned to particular colours or panes. ### Returns from the whole The complete construction **returns-to** [C09 — Diaphaneity](../../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): the medium becomes readable through what it discloses. Its changing projection **returns-to** [C37 — World-Atlas](../../../../episteme/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md), where the conditions of pictures qualify their claims to completion. Its apparatus **returns-to** [C39 — MEF](../../../../episteme/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md), carrying the source, angle, transformation, divergence and return of each determination. In the essay's movement, the optic **returns-to** [M05 — Gebserian Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md) as the first constructed aperture; **returns-to** [M30 — Arche-Topos](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md) with the atlas/window distinction intact; and **returns-to** [M36 — MEF and Prompt Thrownness](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness.md) as an accountable refraction. These crossings carry a Mytheme into Argument, Concept and Movement. They make the relation encounterable without substituting the image for those registers' derivations, historical warrants or tests of actual operation.

--- title: "Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images" record_id: mytheme-taylor-authored-images record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Extracted / Argued from textual_status: developed-draft-awaiting-parent-T22 poem_units: 23 admitted_image_units: 14 --- # Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images ## #0 — A word that can return to its speaker A game reaches checkmate and asks to be played again. A definition lets air through its panes. A speaker who has understood capture discovers himself seeking its soothing once more. Taylor's poems give these returns different bodies. Their sounds, intervals, pronouns and endings let the relation be lived before an account collects it. The poems remain twenty-three individual works within this authored whole; a shared philosophical field gives them relations without making them fragments of an unwritten master poem. The [Personal Poetry Corpus](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#complete-poems) **sources** the complete texts below. It distinguishes ten undated earlier works, the six-work P0→P5 composition, and seven dated journal works from March–June 2026. The order here is that compilation's order; it does not pretend that the June sequence chronologically preceded the March poems. Bracketed first-line titles are indexes where no authorial title was found. Each quotation retains the compilation's exact wording and lineation. Subsequent authorial corrections are stated beside their own poems so that text, revision instruction and commentary remain distinguishable. This is Taylor's situated authorial world. The language is English; the dated journal encounters and June composition supply particular occasions of production. No birthplace or geographical route is inferred from a file location. [Neumann's shared archetypal ground](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) carries the structuration of genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. That common morphology remains distinct from the geography of particular tellings and from the order and duration of their transformations. It makes relations comparable without converting Taylor's dated works into stages of a universal cultural chronology. The psychological morphology and Taylor's native derivation also keep distinct source offices. The native field is complete before a local image receives a formal reading: `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0`. The slash and inverted parent enclose neither a miscellaneous list nor a one-way ladder. Each parent opens its full four-and-two articulation, and return permits the inverse passage. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3, and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 give the sequential harmonics; Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4, and Text/Texture at 2+3 give a different, complementary reading. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** that authorial field. Its `X/x` is Taylor's notation. Neither Neumann nor a poem supplies its derivation retrospectively. The sixfold of this page follows the corpus's own changing forms; it does not distribute all twenty-three works among six prefabricated meanings. The prose immediately following a poem describes its words and complete movement. Symbolic amplification is identified separately: **human-amplified: yes** where the authored programme or a precise correction supplies the relation; additional interpretive extrapolation remains **human-amplified: no**. Reading a complete work is not permission to assign every bird, vessel or god-name a fixed cross-story identity. ## #1 — Play, knowing, and the humanity that makes its forms The earlier works move among address, recognition, institutional desire and release. Their lengths matter: the two-line fatigue of waking and the extended rain against the window of freedom do different work. Each begins again in its own voice. ### FT-P01 — Play and Play > Somehow, being right here > I am out there, everywhere, > Nowhere really, > And elsewhere completely. > Coming and Going; > Checkmate. > Another game? > I might as well stay knowing > If I set you going > You'll come again. > Let us play and play. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q001) · Extracted authorial poem. The voice moves from being here to being everywhere and nowhere, reaches checkmate, then asks for another game. Staying in knowing and setting another going belong to one invitation: the other can come again. The final repetition of play opens what the apparent ending had closed. The core places this within the passage through I, you and it, then the contextual release of their exclusivity, recognition of the one appearing act, and return. The atlas retains the situated readings and their relations rather than installing one more victorious picture. ### Centres without a final circumference From within an experience, the world is given through this centre. No unverified armorial image or motto is reproduced here. ### The black sun and the radiating star Attention and labour move toward a centre. At the public edge, actions are presented as work done for others; deeper within, the power to decide how that work is used is less visible. The black-sun image gathers these movements as capture: energy is received without an answering circulation that renews the people and relations supplying it.
