You’re right: the pairwise “vertical” mapping I introduced should be dropped. **The canonical harmonic pairings are**

(0,5),\qquad(1,4),\qquad(2,3),

with their 5:3:1 whole-tone spans—totality, tritone, epogdoon. Only 1\leftrightarrow4 happens to cross between the two 3{:}3 blocks. There is no established harmonic warrant for 2\leftrightarrow5 or 3\leftrightarrow0, so the relation between 1\!-\!2\!-\!3 and 4\!-\!5\!-\!0 should be read **blockwise and recursively**, not as three invented columns.  

## **The two wheels as the conjugate Spanda pair**

Yes, the cleanest conception is:

\frac01 \;\longrightarrow\; \frac10 \;\longrightarrow\; \frac{\frac01}{\frac10}.

Let the two wheels be:

W_b=\frac01, \qquad W_p=\frac10.

The first is the bimba orientation: standing identity, illumination carried as scalar-over-vector. The second is its conjugate inversion: pratibimba, recognition acting back as vector-over-scalar. The movement from the first wheel to the second is the slash-flip:

\frac01\xrightarrow{q\mapsto q^*}\frac10.

The paired image then makes explicit something that the temporal arrow alone does not: **the relation between the inverse phases itself**:

W_b/W_p = \frac{\frac01}{\frac10}.

That outer slash is not ordinary numerical division. It is the live bar of self-difference through which bimba and pratibimba remain conjugate rather than collapsing into identity. In the existing derivation, this is exactly the movement from self-identity, through self-inversion, into operative self-difference: the two helices are one substrate encountered from its two faces.  

The wheel is particularly apt because it presents **identity through continuous positional reversal**. Every point changes orientation while the circular whole persists. One wheel therefore need not mean “zero”; it can mean a complete 0/1 orientation. The other is its phase-conjugate 1/0. Their pairing is the first Spanda given simultaneous visual body.

And given that you saw **two wheel-bearing six-winged seraphic forms**, the whole arrangement opens further:

\frac01 \longmapsto 6, \qquad \frac10 \longmapsto 6',

so that the cope offers an allusional image of the conjugate musical form:

6+6'=12.

One wheel carries one sixfold articulation; the inverse wheel carries its conjugate sixfold articulation. This is far more exact than simply saying “six wings resemble QL.” It is potentially:

\boxed{ \frac01\!:\!6 \quad\Big/\quad \frac10\!:\!6' }

—the two whole-tone helices bodily figured as two wheel-seraph complexes. Each sixfold is internally:

(1,2,3):(4,5,0),

while the second is the primed recognition of the same structure:

(1',2',3'):(4',5',0').

## **The six wings and the true** 3{:}3

The important reading is therefore not an arbitrary wing-to-wing pairing. It is:

6=3:3=3:1,

where the second three are the unfolded content of the one that knows, contains or unifies the first three.

More precisely:

(1,2,3) : (4,5,0),

with

0\equiv6\equiv1+2+3.

The 0 position is not merely the last item in the second trinity. It is the first trinity returned as unified anchor. The existing harmonic derivation renders the second pole as 4:5:6, where its final term literally contains 1+2+3 as its sum-content. Thus the second triad is the recognition-body of the first:

4\!-\!5\!-\!0 = \text{the One-of-the-Three internally articulated}.

That is the exact sense in which:

3:1=3:3.

The seraph’s single body holding six wings is already a suitable icon of this: the unity is not outside the wings as a seventh item. It is their bodily condition of coherence. Yet that bodily unity can itself be discerned through the second triad—void, unity, and their paradoxical 0/1 oneness.

## **Sophia, Logos and Śakti**

Jung’s conjunction here is extremely close to the central Epi-Logos move. In paragraphs 609–613 of _Answer to Job_, Sophia is a pre-existent feminine pneuma, coeternal with God and active before creation. Jung says she shares essential qualities with the Johannine Logos and reaches so far beyond the Hebrew Chokmah that she evokes the Indian Śakti. He then characterises her as cosmogonic pneuma, world-building power, divine self-expression and the subtle intelligence passing through all things.  

The crucial point is that **Sophia, Logos and Śakti are not merely three names for one featureless substance**. They disclose three inseparable aspects of the same world-forming act:

\begin{aligned} \textbf{Sophia}&:\quad \text{the wisdom that knows and contains the form};\\ \textbf{Logos}&:\quad \text{the form articulated, spoken and made intelligible};\\ \textbf{Śakti}&:\quad \text{the power through which knowing becomes manifestation}. \end{aligned}

Or more compactly:

\boxed{ \text{Sophia knows} \;:\; \text{Logos articulates} \;:\; \text{Śakti actualises} }

They are epistemic, formal and dynamic faces of one generative intelligence.

Jung goes further: Sophia becomes necessary because Yahweh must become capable of self-reflection. Job’s knowledge of God forces a corresponding divine self-knowledge; Yahweh must remember Sophia because wisdom is the power by which the unreflected God becomes conscious of his own oppositeness. Jung later states directly that Sophia signifies God’s self-reflection.  

This situates Sophia with extraordinary precision in the QL recognitional pole:

4\!-\!5\!-\!0.

Not because Sophia is passively “mental,” but because she is the **power through which manifested content is returned to itself as known totality**. She is the one in the 3{:}1: not a numerical extra, but the unitive-recognitive condition through which the three are held as three-and-one.

Logos, meanwhile, has a natural affinity with the articulated 1\!-\!2\!-\!3: the intelligible procession, differentiated order, determinate formation. Śakti names the operative inseparability of the two poles—the power by which Sophia’s recognitional containment and Logos’s articulated manifestation are not separate systems.

Hence:

\text{Sophia} : \text{Logos} \quad\sim\quad (4,5,0) : (1,2,3),

while Śakti is the live operative crossing:

\boxed{ \text{Śakti} = \frac{(1,2,3)}{(4,5,0)} \ \text{in active conjugation} }

—not as literal quotient, but as their inseparable world-building relation.

Jung then says that Mary is an earthly-historical copy of Sophia, while Christ, the son of Mary, is the Logos and—like Sophia—the master workman. He even remarks upon the mythic identity of mother and son.   This gives a remarkable circuit:

\text{Sophia} \rightarrow \text{Mary} \rightarrow \text{Christ/Logos},

in which eternal feminine wisdom becomes the matrix through which the masculine Logos acquires body.

## **The masculine–feminine chiasm**

This helps clarify the apparent inversion we have in QL.

Functionally:

1\!-\!2\!-\!3 = \text{masculine articulation},

because it projects, differentiates and explicates.

4\!-\!5\!-\!0 = \text{feminine recognition},

because it receives, contains, reflects and gathers.

Yet according to the older substantive symbolism:

1\!-\!2\!-\!3 = \text{physical/matter/nature} = \text{feminine},

while

4\!-\!5\!-\!0 = \text{mental/spirit} = \text{masculine}.

The two readings therefore cross:

\boxed{ 1\!-\!2\!-\!3 = \frac{\text{masculine operation}} {\text{feminine field}} }

\boxed{ 4\!-\!5\!-\!0 = \frac{\text{feminine operation}} {\text{masculine field}} }

That is not a defect requiring one attribution to defeat the other. It is the overdetermined chiasm of the structure. Each pole contains a conjugate gender-valence depending on whether we are reading **what it does** or **what domain it bears**.

The Christian figures themselves traverse this crossing:

- **Christ–Logos** is masculine spiritual articulation becoming physical body.
- **Mary–Sophia** is feminine physical matrix revealed as heavenly wisdom and divine self-reflection.

So the Incarnation moves:

\text{masculine spirit} \longrightarrow \text{physical embodiment},

while the Assumption moves:

\text{feminine embodiment} \longrightarrow \text{spiritual recognition}.

Together they form a conjugate circulation rather than a one-way hierarchy.

## **The Assumption as** 3{:}1=3{:}3

Jung reads the 1950 dogma as the heavenly bride taking her place alongside the Trinity, the hieros gamos of bride and bridegroom, and the beginning of a continuing incarnation whose fulfilment must be perceived, recognised and declared by humanity. He later insists that the feminine requires an equally personal metaphysical representation and describes Mary as mediatrix, functionally corresponding to Christ as mediator.  

QL sharpens what that “fourth” structurally does:

\text{Trinity} : \text{Mary} = 3:1.

But Mary’s one is Sophia’s unitive self-reflection: the condition by which the divine three are known as a whole. Therefore the one cannot remain an unarticulated monad. Its internal recognitional constitution unfolds:

1 \longrightarrow (0,1,0/1) \longrightarrow (4,5,0).

Thus:

\boxed{ 3:1 = (1,2,3):(4,5,0) = 3:3 }

The Assumption is especially apt because it does not only introduce Sophia as abstract divine Wisdom. It carries **Mary’s body** into the divine constitution. The feminine recognitional pole and the physical embodied pole are thereby crossed and reunited. Mary is both the matrix that receives the Logos into matter and the bodily figure received into heaven.

So the Assumption completes the Christian archetype by revealing the one as:

\text{matrix} + \text{mediatrix} + \text{recognition of the whole}.

## **The double-headed eagle as dia-ballein power**

Here the Spanda equations should indeed stay in the background. The eagle belongs directly to the signed, valent register:

-1/+1.

The two heads face opposed directions from a single imperial power-body. Their primary logic is not originary nonduality but **differentiated polarity, valuation and control**.

The healthy dia-ballein form is:

\boxed{ \frac{-1}{+1} }

The slash maintains separation-across-relation. Each pole retains its valence; neither has to absorb or annihilate the other. The imperial body holds the tension as one power-field without pretending the two orientations are identical.

The alternative operations expose the unstable possibilities internal to power:

(-1)+(+1)=0,

mutual cancellation or neutralisation;

(-1)-(+1)=-2,

the negative pole doubling itself through negation of the positive;

and, in reverse orientation,

(+1)-(-1)=+2,

the positive pole doubling itself through negation of the negative.

Collectively:

\boxed{ (-1)\pm(+1) \longrightarrow \{0,\pm2\} }

This is an excellent compact algebra of power:

\begin{aligned} \frac{-1}{+1} &=\text{held polarity};\\ 0 &=\text{cancellation or depoliticised neutralisation};\\ \pm2 &=\text{dominance, escalation or monopolised valence}. \end{aligned}

The shared eagle-body is therefore not necessarily a 1/1 reconciliation. It is the **seat of power that determines which operator governs the poles**. It can maintain them in ratio, cancel them, or empower one through the negation of the other.

## **Clean seal of the motifs**

\boxed{ \begin{array}{rcl} \textbf{Two wheels} &:& \dfrac01 \rightarrow \dfrac10 \rightarrow \dfrac{\frac01}{\frac10} \\[10pt] && \text{conjugate phase, inversion, recognised relation} \\[16pt] \textbf{Two six-winged seraphs} &:& \left[(1,2,3):(4,5,0)\right] \Big/ \left[(1',2',3'):(4',5',0')\right] \\[8pt] && 6+6'=12,\quad 3:1=3:3 \\[16pt] \textbf{Assumption of Mary} &:& \text{Sophia–Śakti–Logos} \rightarrow \text{Mary–Christ} \\[6pt] && 3:1 = (1,2,3):(4,5,0) \\[6pt] && \text{the feminine One recognises, embodies and completes the Three} \\[16pt] \textbf{Double-headed eagle} &:& \dfrac{-1}{+1} \quad\text{or}\quad (-1)\pm(+1)\rightarrow\{0,\pm2\} \\[8pt] && \text{dia-ballein, valence, sovereignty and power} \end{array} }

The cope’s QL allusional field is therefore not one vague sixfold resemblance. It is much more articulated:

\boxed{ \text{conjugate binary wheels} \;\rightarrow\; \text{conjugate sixfold angelic bodies} \;\rightarrow\; \text{feminine recognitional completion} }

while the eagles hold the distinct downstream register of signed division, valuation and worldly power.

whole_evidence.text: --- title: Mother, Assumption and chiasm record_id: mytheme-mother-assumption-chiasm record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authorial chiasm recovered from corrected dialogue and quilt; historical and Jungian attribution debts distinguished" source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql - jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11 - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness --- # Mother, Assumption and chiasm ## #0 The Mother flow begins with a body received, a body bearing another, and the receiving body itself returned. Taylor's encounter with the cope at St Bridget's in Skenfrith brings this movement into a particular gathering of images: Mary being lifted, figures perceived as rabbits beside her, six-winged seraphic forms, wheels, and eagles with two heads. His recollection of Jung's Assumption discussion meets a native relation already established in his work: the three recognised as one, whose recognition has its own threefold articulation. The image becomes a place to work through that relation in embodiment. The [Skenfrith dialogue source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/chat-logs/taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql/SOURCE.md) preserves the encounter and its correction. It is a conversation between Taylor and an unnamed assistant, with the standing of provenance of thinking. Taylor's opening observation, his subsequent corrections and the assistant's proposed readings have different authority. The [complete local transcript](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/chat-logs-for-quilting/07-08-2026-jung-marie-skenfrith-cope.md) is the actual carrier of this authored whole. An assistant's confident identification of an embroidered figure is still an identification to verify; an author's correction of his own notation governs the interpretation being made. The rabbit belongs first to the encounter. Taylor reports seeing rabbits lifting Mary; the assistant identifies supporting angels and invokes an unnamed description of the cope. Without that public object witness, the identification remains a lead. The ambiguity nevertheless has an exact place in the whole: what appears to the viewer can initiate an interpretation while remaining answerable to the object. No lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism is assigned to a supposedly medieval rabbit. The experienced form and the intended iconography have not yet been shown to coincide. Taylor also recalls inquiry into the surrounding power dynamics. The assistant expands this into a history of castles, lordship and imperial imagery. The later quilt expressly re-keys that frame: the visit was a personal trip; the essay-usable material is the Mother flow, Assumption and chiasm. The [Mother-flow correction in Q27](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) therefore governs the whole's direction. The site locates the encounter. It does not become evidence that an embroidered programme resolves a local political history, and the narrative does not climb from a castle through an eagle to a theological conclusion. Within this encounter, Mary remains a particular mother. The biblical Mary, the mother of Jesus, is the figure from whom the later maternal reception takes its name and body. The Assumption belongs to a later doctrinal and interpretive history; it is not another episode narrated in this page from a selected Gospel witness. Jung's interpretation of that reception and Taylor's chiasm are further operations. Their relation begins through the same figure without making their sources interchangeable. ## #1 The incarnation–Assumption movement has two directions. In the first, the maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life. What is articulated as divine Word comes through a body which bears it. In the return, that maternal body is itself received. The condition of embodiment remains present in what is recognised as whole. This is the force of the quilt's correction, assumption-*of* rather than ascent-*away-from*: return bears what made manifestation possible instead of treating that condition as a vessel to discard once its work has been done. Taylor's whole does not end with a disembodied recognition of maternity. Mary is both the receiving matrix and the bodily figure received. If only a general feminine principle entered the final account, the particular body that bore the relation would disappear just where recognition claims completion. The chiasm retains that body across the change of direction. Mother, child, receiving and being received remain different relations within the circulation; their difference gives the crossing something to carry. The theological and psychological appointments require their own attribution. The [CW11 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md) identifies Jung's *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. The locally held Hull translation, second edition, supplies the primary *Answer to Job* passages read here: §§609–617,625–628 and746–757, with their intervening and adjacent context. The house now carries six source-matched paraphrase cards for these primary spans. The following remains attributed paraphrase with paragraph locators; no exact quotation-ready wording or newly verified print-page citation is claimed. The reader can distinguish the primary encounter from the assistant's earlier report of it. Jung begins this Sophia movement by turning from Job toward Wisdom in other texts. In §609 he takes up the pre-existent feminine wisdom of Proverbs; §610 relates Sophia to Hebrew Chochma and the Johannine Logos while invoking Indian Śakti as a comparison. The discussion then passes through Ecclesiasticus and the Wisdom of Solomon. Speaking, pervading, world-building, loving, guiding and reflecting give Sophia more than a generic receptive property. These are Jung's readings of several textual witnesses, not biblical Wisdom gathered from Job alone. His historical proposals about contact and descent retain their own evidential burden. [CW11 §§609–613](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The sequence returns to the tested righteous person. Jung brings the oppression of the righteous in the Wisdom of Solomon beside Job, then reads Yahweh's behaviour as a crisis of faithfulness and self-knowledge. Sophia's remembrance answers the demand for divine self-reflection: the human being's knowledge of God becomes consequential for the God-image. The argument moves through an interpretation of creation and its familial counterparts toward a changed incarnation. In §625 the Second Eve has temporal and material priority: the God-man is to be born through a woman. Mary receives the appointment of Sophia's embodiment, friend and intercessor, while Christ is related to the pre-existent Logos and the figure of the master workman. Jung explicitly develops the mother–son relation through that shared symbolic office. [CW11 §§614–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The source also troubles its own image of completion. In §§626–627 Jung argues that the exceptional protections surrounding Mary can separate her from ordinary humanity. Perfection brought close to Christ can impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate it; an incarnation protected from the actual human condition risks being only partial. This is Jung's psychological critique of the doctrine as he reads it. It is not the Church's account of its own teaching, and his accompanying generalisations about men and women do not become the native meaning of Taylor's poles. The tension matters to the Mother flow: exaltation can either receive embodied life or produce an ideal too purified to bear it. [CW11 §§625–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The later Assumption discussion follows the burden of continuing incarnation in the empirical creature. Jung interprets the longing for a maternal intercessor, the heavenly bride and the marriage imagery as a movement toward further incarnation. Recognition and declaration by human beings enter its temporal fulfilment. He insists upon personal feminine representation, yet expressly distinguishes his psychological reading from a dogmatic assertion that Mary has become a goddess. The argument then moves into conscious individuation: the person encounters the unconscious, recognises its opposites and takes responsibility for a relation whose process would otherwise remain obscure. Psychological efficacy is real for Jung; it does not license a simple identification of God with the unconscious as a whole. [CW11 §§746–757](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). This is a developed reception of the Assumption, distinct from the official definition itself. The Trinity's doctrinal constitution cannot be silently rewritten as an official four-person deity. Sophia, biblical Mary, the mother in Jung's theological reconstruction and the embodied return in Taylor's chiasm meet through interpretation while retaining their sources. The adjacent [*Aion* house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies a separate route through Self, Christ-symbolism, opposites and symbolic totality; its installed sixteen-entry passage map records contextual paraphrases from the consulted 1979 paperback. Collation against the selected 1978 hardcover printing and verification of any quotation remain Open. Taylor's recollection of both works does not fuse their sequences. The maternal body is received through these differentiated relations, with the source's own perfection/completeness difficulty still active. The Sophia–Logos–Śakti comparison opens three distinguishable tasks: knowing and recognising, articulating form, and the power of manifestation. In the conversation's proposed account, Sophia carries recognitional wisdom, Logos the intelligibility of articulated form, and Śakti the power through which the relation is active. This construction develops Taylor's explicit invitation to explore Jung's comparison. Its neat distribution of the three names is assistant elaboration. Jung's §610 relates essential qualities and evokes Śakti; it does not supply this fixed three-office formula or an exhaustive account of Śaiva thought. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's expressed comparative inquiry; **human-amplified: no** for promoting that provisional three-name allocation into a fixed doctrinal identity. The Śakti relation matters because receiving and recognising already act. A matrix does not become operative only when a supposedly active term arrives from elsewhere. The comparison can thus approach [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](../../../../episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) through luminous appearing and its reflexive power, whose inseparability permits differentiation. Their source-specific metaphysics remains with that argument and concept. The Mother whole receives the relation as an authored crossing, without making Mary a Sanskrit category or requiring Śaiva sources to validate native QL. ## #2 Taylor's correction identifies the live pressure: the functional masculine and feminine reading crosses the previously given physical and mental poles. Articulation, differentiation and explication give the `1–2–3` block a masculine operation in this reading. Receiving, containing, reflecting and gathering give `4–5–0` a feminine operation. Yet the older symbolic assignment being examined associates physical matter and nature with the feminine, and mental or spiritual life with the masculine. Reading what a pole does and reading the field it bears produce different gender valences. The chiasm preserves both relations as the object of inquiry. The first block can be read as masculine articulation in a feminine material field; the second as feminine recognition in a masculine mental field. These are symbolic assignments whose crossing is being developed, not determinations of what men and women essentially are. They cannot be stabilised by treating one assignment as the literal meaning of the numbers. Each pole's operation already reaches into the field conventionally attributed to the other. Christ–Logos and Mary give this crossing a body in the authored construction. Spiritual articulation becomes embodied; the embodied mother is received into spiritual recognition. The directions remain distinguishable even as each makes the other intelligible. If embodiment were only a descent to be reversed, the return would undo the very relation it completes. If recognition merely retained an image of the mother while leaving her bodily condition outside, the proclaimed whole would again omit what bore it. The Mother flow's return is therefore bodily and recognitional together. **Human-amplified: yes** for the chiasm and assumption-of movement recovered through Taylor's correction and the later quilt. The [Neumann source and protected encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) provide shared archetypal structuration behind this maternal pressure: bodily dependence, nourishment, engulfment, separation and the transformation of the relation to the mother. They do not supply the historical telling of Mary's Assumption. Neumann's source-specific developmental morphology and Taylor's native field retain their own orders. The maternal image can bear the relation between sustaining a life and consuming it without making every mother, every goddess and every feminine symbol instances of one already settled story. Q27 marks the further join between the Mother's nourishing/devouring faces and the Levinasian need/Desire relation as a candidate. It can ask whether a return permits another life to remain other or consumes that life within its own satisfaction. The question is locally material to a body received rather than discarded. **Human-amplified: no** for a newly ratified identity between the two source fields: the candidate is retained as an opening, not installed as their common doctrine. The completed chiasm does not need that stronger equation to perform its own operation. The native `3:1 = 3:3` gives recognition its articulated office. Taylor states at the opening that the one in `3:1` is the three encapsulated or recognised. The first block, `1–2–3`, is known through `4–5–0`: void, unity and their paradoxical `0/1` oneness. The one is thus the unitive condition of the three, whose recognitional constitution can itself be unfolded. It is neither an extra count appended without relation nor a featureless terminus. The second three disclose what the recognising one does. The Mother image makes this operation felt through matrix, mediation and recognition. Receiving gives the articulated life somewhere to arise; bearing sustains its differentiation; recognition receives that differentiation as belonging to a whole. The body's persistence on return prevents the recognitional pole from becoming an external observer looking at what it never had to bear. This is Taylor's existing native operation entering an image, not a theory inferred from the number of Christian figures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit `3:1 = 3:3` appointment; the theological sources retain responsibility for their own claims about Trinity, Mary and symbolic completion. ## #3 The two wheels give the crossing a second form. Taylor directs attention to the full sequence `0/1 → 1/0 → (0/1)/(1/0)`. A first orientation meets its inverse; their relation becomes explicit. The wheel need not be reduced to an isolated zero. The complete orientation already relates the singular One and manifest All, and its inverse changes how that relation is encountered. The outer slash retains the orientations in operative self-difference. It does not divide numerical quantities by zero. As an encountered image, a wheel permits changing orientation while its whole form persists. Two wheels can then bear conjugate orientations without becoming two independent sources. The movement through one view and its inverse is distinguishable from holding their relation together. This is why the final compound matters: the whole has acquired the capacity to carry the reversal it underwent. The wheels **returns-to** [A11 — The Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and [C49](../../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) with One and All still differentiated, and to [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) with orientation as a relation through which positions become possible. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's explicit wheel sequence. No geometric theorem is proved by the embroidery. The seraphic forms give that orientation a sixfold articulation. Taylor reports six wings and asks after `3:3`; the assistant develops two wheel-bearing six-winged forms as a conjugate pair. The whole visual reading can hold one sixfold and its primed counterpart, `6` and `6′`, while each retains the two blocks `(1,2,3):(4,5,0)`. A single body is the condition through which the wings belong together. It does not add a seventh wing, and a second body does not make the first six a series of unrelated numbered items. The proposed `6+6′` develops two articulations in relation; exact historical details of the cope still require their object witness. The dialogue's first attempt to map the wings into vertical pairs is explicitly corrected. Taylor rejects `2↔5` and `3↔0`; only `1↔4` belongs to the established pairings in that proposed arrangement. The native complementary folds are `0↔5`, `1↔4` and `2↔3`. They have their own harmonic work and cannot be manufactured by placing the two recognitional blocks into adjacent columns. The body can sustain both the `3:3` reading and the native complementary relations without pretending they are the same partition. The important operation here is blockwise and recursive recognition. The assistant's invocation of Isaiah's wing functions and Ezekiel's intersecting wheels is a distinct textual proposal. Selected primary passages and an object description must establish those scriptural and iconographic relations before their exact wording or historical combination can be attributed. The present whole develops Taylor's encountered wing-and-wheel relation without borrowing an unverified biblical quotation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the reported sixfold encounter and corrected blockwise recognition; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected pairings and for treating every subsequent assistant elaboration as an accepted iconographic programme. This return to the wheel and wing preserves the Mother movement. The body that bears the differentiation remains its condition when the differentiation is recognised. Recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it. In the Assumption chiasm, the same pressure prevents the maternal body from vanishing into a final spiritual account of what it supposedly meant. ## #4 The eagle changes the operative question. Its two heads direct one body toward opposed orientations, but the governing relation here is signed valence and power. Taylor corrects the assistant's attempt to give the eagle the wheels' Spanda equations and a `1/1` reconciliation. He had pointed to `−1` and `+1`, and to the difference between a relation retaining their polarity and operations that cancel or amplify through negation. The one body does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled. The retained form is `(-1)/(+1)`. Each pole keeps its sign across the relation. Ordinary addition, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, cancels the signed quantities; subtraction produces `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, while the inverse subtraction gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are three distinct arithmetic results. Taylor's authored political and psychic reading uses them to distinguish held polarity, cancellation and one valence's amplification through negation of the other. The sign of a pole does not, by itself, determine its moral worth. The eagle's power-body can consequently be asked which operation it carries. Does its unity retain opposed orientations in relation? Does an apparent agreement cancel their difference? Does one direction acquire its enlarged power by negating the other? Those questions give the shared body an accountable office. They also prevent the Mother flow from ending in a picture where completion means that the differentiated life has disappeared. The same whole that receives must be able to sustain a difference within what it receives. The corrected eagle **returns-to** [A13 — Two Logics of Two](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50 — Dia / Syn](../../../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). Dia gives difference a determinate orientation; Syn keeps the relation through which differentiated terms can be recomposed and returned. Healthy polarity remains a positive operation. Cancellation and appropriation are its different failures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit signed-power correction; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected `1/1` eagle or an automatic identity between political domination and one arithmetic sign. The historical emblem's association with particular sovereign offices is a further source task. Taylor's observation and his power-valence reading suffice for the authored inquiry; they do not verify the intention of the cope's makers, the status of an imperial device in that object, or a chain of local political events. The quilt's removal of the castle-history frame remains active at the end of the eagle reading. Power is examined through its operation, with the journey preserved as provenance rather than made to carry an unverified history. ## #5→0 The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** the shared maternal structuration of bodily dependence, nourishment, separation and transformed reception. Taylor’s chiasm keeps the maternal body within what returns. Skenfrith locates the encounter; the cope’s historical making remains a distinct object-history task. The sequence of embodiment and recognition, Jung’s reception of the 1950 declaration, and the later authored visit and correction retain separate temporal offices. The completed constellation returns through distinct offices. Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation. Wings articulate the three through the three that know them, with their bodily coherence intact. The eagle carries the signed alternatives of power. The Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return. These relations can act together because they have not been reduced to one number, one sex assignment or one emblem of undifferentiated divinity. The whole **returns-to** [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) within the native field `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) grounds those eight determinations, their sequence, inversions and relations. The sixfold recognition explored through the cope does not replace that whole field. `X/x` remains Taylor's determining capacity/indefinite-particular relation before any Jungian refraction. The religious images receive a native operation whose derivation is already present. The Name series—Name, Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—retains its coequal Power relation—Power, Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. The maternal chiasm makes the conjunction concrete: an articulated name or image has been borne, sustained and brought into life. Recognising the image must return upon that bearing. Logos and Son therefore cannot be isolated as prestigious theological names while matrix, labour and consequence disappear from the operation. The series belongs to the native field; it is not a new set of Mary or Christ identities, nor a claim that a religious source supplies its proof. The Śakti comparison **returns-to** [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) through manifestation that becomes locally determinate while retaining its source relation. Recognition changes the relation to embodiment; it need not annul the differentiated world. A05 and C13 receive the corresponding distinction between reflexive power and a passive second image. The Christian maternal reception, the Śaiva genealogy of differentiation and the native derivation keep their source-specific sequences. **Human-amplified: yes** for this admitted authored crossing; **human-amplified: no** for a historical identity or for assigning Mary a fixed tattva. [A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31 — Complex](../../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) receive the difference between an image's active valuation and a neutral ornament. The same maternal image can organise dependence, fear, protection, receptivity or the claim to possess what it bears. Its office has to be recovered through the lived relation. [C32 — Archetype](../../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) receives the distinction between that particular image and the determining capacity it manifests. Neumann's shared archetypal ground supplies another source-specific morphology; it does not turn the cope's local encounter into a universal historical template. The whole **returns-to** [A20 — Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where recognition can either restore the body's standing or replace it with an authoritative image of what the body is for. The angel/rabbit ambiguity gives the account a modest but exact obligation: the experienced image must remain correctable by an encounter with the object. The Assumption chiasm gives that obligation a deeper maternal form: the recognised whole must retain the condition it receives. [A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives this transformed relation to embodied dependence without requiring fusion, perpetual engulfment or an ego's possession of totality. **Human-amplified: yes** for these recovered image and recognition relations; the nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity remains the candidate marked above. The body also changes what a return owes. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives the difference between bearing a consequential office and becoming the source of the field. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work. Their work cannot be honoured by pretending they were dispensable, or by making one mediating image the owner of every relation it conducts. This is the author's office comparison, not a new claim about Mary's doctrinal titles. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) receives the corresponding test: a completed product must return consequence and recognition to the conditions and labour through which it arrived. The Mother flow makes the sustaining body visible within what completion receives. [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives reliance that precedes an exhaustive account of what bears it. The mother/child image gives that dependence a particular form, while the whole's return prevents dependence from being treated as ownership. [A27 — Self and Other: Unity without Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives that preserved difference: to have been borne within a relation does not make a life the property of its bearer. [A35 — Compassion as Sensitivity to Origins](../../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives the loving direction of the return toward the body, history and work that made the achieved form possible. These admitted office, trust and care relations retain **human-amplified: yes** standing. They neither make bodily suffering necessary for spiritual completion nor establish a historical politics from the cope. The [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives each crossing at operational register 3: what changes, what is retained and what returns have been stated separately for maternal body, recognitional triads, inverse wheels and signed power. Numerical recurrence alone proves none of these relations. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives all four of its operations. The encountered form discloses; its account remains answerable to the source; trust lets the account guide inquiry without owning its ground; the interpretation changes the conditions of the next encounter. Taylor's correction is one such return, changing the assistant's account of the wings and eagle instead of allowing a pleasing pattern to govern the source. The [Definition of God source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) keeps devotion double, to the exceeding whole and to the particular aperture through which it arrives. The Mother flow **returns-to** [A36 — Advent of Integral Zero](../../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) with that double obligation embodied. Recognition receives the matrix within the whole it bore; a completed account returns to the particular body rather than leaving it behind as the price of completion. **Human-amplified: yes** for this quilted assumption-of return. Historical object and scriptural verification, together with exact quotation collation of the locally read Jung passages, remain debts in their own registers; they do not defer the native operation already enacted through this whole.

You’re right: the pairwise “vertical” mapping I introduced should be dropped. **The canonical harmonic pairings are**

(0,5),\qquad(1,4),\qquad(2,3),

with their 5:3:1 whole-tone spans—totality, tritone, epogdoon. Only 1\leftrightarrow4 happens to cross between the two 3{:}3 blocks. There is no established harmonic warrant for 2\leftrightarrow5 or 3\leftrightarrow0, so the relation between 1\!-\!2\!-\!3 and 4\!-\!5\!-\!0 should be read **blockwise and recursively**, not as three invented columns.  

## **The two wheels as the conjugate Spanda pair**

Yes, the cleanest conception is:

\frac01 \;\longrightarrow\; \frac10 \;\longrightarrow\; \frac{\frac01}{\frac10}.

Let the two wheels be:

W_b=\frac01, \qquad W_p=\frac10.

The first is the bimba orientation: standing identity, illumination carried as scalar-over-vector. The second is its conjugate inversion: pratibimba, recognition acting back as vector-over-scalar. The movement from the first wheel to the second is the slash-flip:

\frac01\xrightarrow{q\mapsto q^*}\frac10.

The paired image then makes explicit something that the temporal arrow alone does not: **the relation between the inverse phases itself**:

W_b/W_p = \frac{\frac01}{\frac10}.

That outer slash is not ordinary numerical division. It is the live bar of self-difference through which bimba and pratibimba remain conjugate rather than collapsing into identity. In the existing derivation, this is exactly the movement from self-identity, through self-inversion, into operative self-difference: the two helices are one substrate encountered from its two faces.  

The wheel is particularly apt because it presents **identity through continuous positional reversal**. Every point changes orientation while the circular whole persists. One wheel therefore need not mean “zero”; it can mean a complete 0/1 orientation. The other is its phase-conjugate 1/0. Their pairing is the first Spanda given simultaneous visual body.

And given that you saw **two wheel-bearing six-winged seraphic forms**, the whole arrangement opens further:

\frac01 \longmapsto 6, \qquad \frac10 \longmapsto 6',

so that the cope offers an allusional image of the conjugate musical form:

6+6'=12.

One wheel carries one sixfold articulation; the inverse wheel carries its conjugate sixfold articulation. This is far more exact than simply saying “six wings resemble QL.” It is potentially:

\boxed{ \frac01\!:\!6 \quad\Big/\quad \frac10\!:\!6' }

—the two whole-tone helices bodily figured as two wheel-seraph complexes. Each sixfold is internally:

(1,2,3):(4,5,0),

while the second is the primed recognition of the same structure:

(1',2',3'):(4',5',0').

## **The six wings and the true** 3{:}3

whole_evidence.text: --- title: Mother, Assumption and chiasm record_id: mytheme-mother-assumption-chiasm record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authorial chiasm recovered from corrected dialogue and quilt; historical and Jungian attribution debts distinguished" source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql - jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11 - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness --- # Mother, Assumption and chiasm ## #0 The Mother flow begins with a body received, a body bearing another, and the receiving body itself returned. Taylor's encounter with the cope at St Bridget's in Skenfrith brings this movement into a particular gathering of images: Mary being lifted, figures perceived as rabbits beside her, six-winged seraphic forms, wheels, and eagles with two heads. His recollection of Jung's Assumption discussion meets a native relation already established in his work: the three recognised as one, whose recognition has its own threefold articulation. The image becomes a place to work through that relation in embodiment. The [Skenfrith dialogue source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/chat-logs/taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql/SOURCE.md) preserves the encounter and its correction. It is a conversation between Taylor and an unnamed assistant, with the standing of provenance of thinking. Taylor's opening observation, his subsequent corrections and the assistant's proposed readings have different authority. The [complete local transcript](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/chat-logs-for-quilting/07-08-2026-jung-marie-skenfrith-cope.md) is the actual carrier of this authored whole. An assistant's confident identification of an embroidered figure is still an identification to verify; an author's correction of his own notation governs the interpretation being made. The rabbit belongs first to the encounter. Taylor reports seeing rabbits lifting Mary; the assistant identifies supporting angels and invokes an unnamed description of the cope. Without that public object witness, the identification remains a lead. The ambiguity nevertheless has an exact place in the whole: what appears to the viewer can initiate an interpretation while remaining answerable to the object. No lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism is assigned to a supposedly medieval rabbit. The experienced form and the intended iconography have not yet been shown to coincide. Taylor also recalls inquiry into the surrounding power dynamics. The assistant expands this into a history of castles, lordship and imperial imagery. The later quilt expressly re-keys that frame: the visit was a personal trip; the essay-usable material is the Mother flow, Assumption and chiasm. The [Mother-flow correction in Q27](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) therefore governs the whole's direction. The site locates the encounter. It does not become evidence that an embroidered programme resolves a local political history, and the narrative does not climb from a castle through an eagle to a theological conclusion. Within this encounter, Mary remains a particular mother. The biblical Mary, the mother of Jesus, is the figure from whom the later maternal reception takes its name and body. The Assumption belongs to a later doctrinal and interpretive history; it is not another episode narrated in this page from a selected Gospel witness. Jung's interpretation of that reception and Taylor's chiasm are further operations. Their relation begins through the same figure without making their sources interchangeable. ## #1 The incarnation–Assumption movement has two directions. In the first, the maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life. What is articulated as divine Word comes through a body which bears it. In the return, that maternal body is itself received. The condition of embodiment remains present in what is recognised as whole. This is the force of the quilt's correction, assumption-*of* rather than ascent-*away-from*: return bears what made manifestation possible instead of treating that condition as a vessel to discard once its work has been done. Taylor's whole does not end with a disembodied recognition of maternity. Mary is both the receiving matrix and the bodily figure received. If only a general feminine principle entered the final account, the particular body that bore the relation would disappear just where recognition claims completion. The chiasm retains that body across the change of direction. Mother, child, receiving and being received remain different relations within the circulation; their difference gives the crossing something to carry. The theological and psychological appointments require their own attribution. The [CW11 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md) identifies Jung's *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. The locally held Hull translation, second edition, supplies the primary *Answer to Job* passages read here: §§609–617,625–628 and746–757, with their intervening and adjacent context. The house now carries six source-matched paraphrase cards for these primary spans. The following remains attributed paraphrase with paragraph locators; no exact quotation-ready wording or newly verified print-page citation is claimed. The reader can distinguish the primary encounter from the assistant's earlier report of it. Jung begins this Sophia movement by turning from Job toward Wisdom in other texts. In §609 he takes up the pre-existent feminine wisdom of Proverbs; §610 relates Sophia to Hebrew Chochma and the Johannine Logos while invoking Indian Śakti as a comparison. The discussion then passes through Ecclesiasticus and the Wisdom of Solomon. Speaking, pervading, world-building, loving, guiding and reflecting give Sophia more than a generic receptive property. These are Jung's readings of several textual witnesses, not biblical Wisdom gathered from Job alone. His historical proposals about contact and descent retain their own evidential burden. [CW11 §§609–613](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The sequence returns to the tested righteous person. Jung brings the oppression of the righteous in the Wisdom of Solomon beside Job, then reads Yahweh's behaviour as a crisis of faithfulness and self-knowledge. Sophia's remembrance answers the demand for divine self-reflection: the human being's knowledge of God becomes consequential for the God-image. The argument moves through an interpretation of creation and its familial counterparts toward a changed incarnation. In §625 the Second Eve has temporal and material priority: the God-man is to be born through a woman. Mary receives the appointment of Sophia's embodiment, friend and intercessor, while Christ is related to the pre-existent Logos and the figure of the master workman. Jung explicitly develops the mother–son relation through that shared symbolic office. [CW11 §§614–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The source also troubles its own image of completion. In §§626–627 Jung argues that the exceptional protections surrounding Mary can separate her from ordinary humanity. Perfection brought close to Christ can impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate it; an incarnation protected from the actual human condition risks being only partial. This is Jung's psychological critique of the doctrine as he reads it. It is not the Church's account of its own teaching, and his accompanying generalisations about men and women do not become the native meaning of Taylor's poles. The tension matters to the Mother flow: exaltation can either receive embodied life or produce an ideal too purified to bear it. [CW11 §§625–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The later Assumption discussion follows the burden of continuing incarnation in the empirical creature. Jung interprets the longing for a maternal intercessor, the heavenly bride and the marriage imagery as a movement toward further incarnation. Recognition and declaration by human beings enter its temporal fulfilment. He insists upon personal feminine representation, yet expressly distinguishes his psychological reading from a dogmatic assertion that Mary has become a goddess. The argument then moves into conscious individuation: the person encounters the unconscious, recognises its opposites and takes responsibility for a relation whose process would otherwise remain obscure. Psychological efficacy is real for Jung; it does not license a simple identification of God with the unconscious as a whole. [CW11 §§746–757](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). This is a developed reception of the Assumption, distinct from the official definition itself. The Trinity's doctrinal constitution cannot be silently rewritten as an official four-person deity. Sophia, biblical Mary, the mother in Jung's theological reconstruction and the embodied return in Taylor's chiasm meet through interpretation while retaining their sources. The adjacent [*Aion* house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies a separate route through Self, Christ-symbolism, opposites and symbolic totality; its installed sixteen-entry passage map records contextual paraphrases from the consulted 1979 paperback. Collation against the selected 1978 hardcover printing and verification of any quotation remain Open. Taylor's recollection of both works does not fuse their sequences. The maternal body is received through these differentiated relations, with the source's own perfection/completeness difficulty still active. The Sophia–Logos–Śakti comparison opens three distinguishable tasks: knowing and recognising, articulating form, and the power of manifestation. In the conversation's proposed account, Sophia carries recognitional wisdom, Logos the intelligibility of articulated form, and Śakti the power through which the relation is active. This construction develops Taylor's explicit invitation to explore Jung's comparison. Its neat distribution of the three names is assistant elaboration. Jung's §610 relates essential qualities and evokes Śakti; it does not supply this fixed three-office formula or an exhaustive account of Śaiva thought. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's expressed comparative inquiry; **human-amplified: no** for promoting that provisional three-name allocation into a fixed doctrinal identity. The Śakti relation matters because receiving and recognising already act. A matrix does not become operative only when a supposedly active term arrives from elsewhere. The comparison can thus approach [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](../../../../episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) through luminous appearing and its reflexive power, whose inseparability permits differentiation. Their source-specific metaphysics remains with that argument and concept. The Mother whole receives the relation as an authored crossing, without making Mary a Sanskrit category or requiring Śaiva sources to validate native QL. ## #2 Taylor's correction identifies the live pressure: the functional masculine and feminine reading crosses the previously given physical and mental poles. Articulation, differentiation and explication give the `1–2–3` block a masculine operation in this reading. Receiving, containing, reflecting and gathering give `4–5–0` a feminine operation. Yet the older symbolic assignment being examined associates physical matter and nature with the feminine, and mental or spiritual life with the masculine. Reading what a pole does and reading the field it bears produce different gender valences. The chiasm preserves both relations as the object of inquiry. The first block can be read as masculine articulation in a feminine material field; the second as feminine recognition in a masculine mental field. These are symbolic assignments whose crossing is being developed, not determinations of what men and women essentially are. They cannot be stabilised by treating one assignment as the literal meaning of the numbers. Each pole's operation already reaches into the field conventionally attributed to the other. Christ–Logos and Mary give this crossing a body in the authored construction. Spiritual articulation becomes embodied; the embodied mother is received into spiritual recognition. The directions remain distinguishable even as each makes the other intelligible. If embodiment were only a descent to be reversed, the return would undo the very relation it completes. If recognition merely retained an image of the mother while leaving her bodily condition outside, the proclaimed whole would again omit what bore it. The Mother flow's return is therefore bodily and recognitional together. **Human-amplified: yes** for the chiasm and assumption-of movement recovered through Taylor's correction and the later quilt. The [Neumann source and protected encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) provide shared archetypal structuration behind this maternal pressure: bodily dependence, nourishment, engulfment, separation and the transformation of the relation to the mother. They do not supply the historical telling of Mary's Assumption. Neumann's source-specific developmental morphology and Taylor's native field retain their own orders. The maternal image can bear the relation between sustaining a life and consuming it without making every mother, every goddess and every feminine symbol instances of one already settled story. Q27 marks the further join between the Mother's nourishing/devouring faces and the Levinasian need/Desire relation as a candidate. It can ask whether a return permits another life to remain other or consumes that life within its own satisfaction. The question is locally material to a body received rather than discarded. **Human-amplified: no** for a newly ratified identity between the two source fields: the candidate is retained as an opening, not installed as their common doctrine. The completed chiasm does not need that stronger equation to perform its own operation. The native `3:1 = 3:3` gives recognition its articulated office. Taylor states at the opening that the one in `3:1` is the three encapsulated or recognised. The first block, `1–2–3`, is known through `4–5–0`: void, unity and their paradoxical `0/1` oneness. The one is thus the unitive condition of the three, whose recognitional constitution can itself be unfolded. It is neither an extra count appended without relation nor a featureless terminus. The second three disclose what the recognising one does. The Mother image makes this operation felt through matrix, mediation and recognition. Receiving gives the articulated life somewhere to arise; bearing sustains its differentiation; recognition receives that differentiation as belonging to a whole. The body's persistence on return prevents the recognitional pole from becoming an external observer looking at what it never had to bear. This is Taylor's existing native operation entering an image, not a theory inferred from the number of Christian figures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit `3:1 = 3:3` appointment; the theological sources retain responsibility for their own claims about Trinity, Mary and symbolic completion. ## #3 The two wheels give the crossing a second form. Taylor directs attention to the full sequence `0/1 → 1/0 → (0/1)/(1/0)`. A first orientation meets its inverse; their relation becomes explicit. The wheel need not be reduced to an isolated zero. The complete orientation already relates the singular One and manifest All, and its inverse changes how that relation is encountered. The outer slash retains the orientations in operative self-difference. It does not divide numerical quantities by zero. As an encountered image, a wheel permits changing orientation while its whole form persists. Two wheels can then bear conjugate orientations without becoming two independent sources. The movement through one view and its inverse is distinguishable from holding their relation together. This is why the final compound matters: the whole has acquired the capacity to carry the reversal it underwent. The wheels **returns-to** [A11 — The Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and [C49](../../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) with One and All still differentiated, and to [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) with orientation as a relation through which positions become possible. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's explicit wheel sequence. No geometric theorem is proved by the embroidery. The seraphic forms give that orientation a sixfold articulation. Taylor reports six wings and asks after `3:3`; the assistant develops two wheel-bearing six-winged forms as a conjugate pair. The whole visual reading can hold one sixfold and its primed counterpart, `6` and `6′`, while each retains the two blocks `(1,2,3):(4,5,0)`. A single body is the condition through which the wings belong together. It does not add a seventh wing, and a second body does not make the first six a series of unrelated numbered items. The proposed `6+6′` develops two articulations in relation; exact historical details of the cope still require their object witness. The native complementary folds are `0↔5`, `1↔4` and `2↔3`. They have their own harmonic work and cannot be manufactured by placing the two recognitional blocks into adjacent columns. The body can sustain both the `3:3` reading and the native complementary relations without pretending they are the same partition. The important operation here is blockwise and recursive recognition. The assistant's invocation of Isaiah's wing functions and Ezekiel's intersecting wheels is a distinct textual proposal. Selected primary passages and an object description must establish those scriptural and iconographic relations before their exact wording or historical combination can be attributed. The present whole develops Taylor's encountered wing-and-wheel relation without borrowing an unverified biblical quotation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the reported sixfold encounter and corrected blockwise recognition; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected pairings and for treating every subsequent assistant elaboration as an accepted iconographic programme. This return to the wheel and wing preserves the Mother movement. The body that bears the differentiation remains its condition when the differentiation is recognised. Recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it. In the Assumption chiasm, the same pressure prevents the maternal body from vanishing into a final spiritual account of what it supposedly meant. ## #4 The eagle changes the operative question. Its two heads direct one body toward opposed orientations, but the governing relation here is signed valence and power. Taylor corrects the assistant's attempt to give the eagle the wheels' Spanda equations and a `1/1` reconciliation. He had pointed to `−1` and `+1`, and to the difference between a relation retaining their polarity and operations that cancel or amplify through negation. The one body does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled. The retained form is `(-1)/(+1)`. Each pole keeps its sign across the relation. Ordinary addition, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, cancels the signed quantities; subtraction produces `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, while the inverse subtraction gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are three distinct arithmetic results. Taylor's authored political and psychic reading uses them to distinguish held polarity, cancellation and one valence's amplification through negation of the other. The sign of a pole does not, by itself, determine its moral worth. The eagle's power-body can consequently be asked which operation it carries. Does its unity retain opposed orientations in relation? Does an apparent agreement cancel their difference? Does one direction acquire its enlarged power by negating the other? Those questions give the shared body an accountable office. They also prevent the Mother flow from ending in a picture where completion means that the differentiated life has disappeared. The same whole that receives must be able to sustain a difference within what it receives. The corrected eagle **returns-to** [A13 — Two Logics of Two](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50 — Dia / Syn](../../../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). Dia gives difference a determinate orientation; Syn keeps the relation through which differentiated terms can be recomposed and returned. Healthy polarity remains a positive operation. Cancellation and appropriation are its different failures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit signed-power correction; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected `1/1` eagle or an automatic identity between political domination and one arithmetic sign. The historical emblem's association with particular sovereign offices is a further source task. Taylor's observation and his power-valence reading suffice for the authored inquiry; they do not verify the intention of the cope's makers, the status of an imperial device in that object, or a chain of local political events. The quilt's removal of the castle-history frame remains active at the end of the eagle reading. Power is examined through its operation, with the journey preserved as provenance rather than made to carry an unverified history. ## #5→0 The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** the shared maternal structuration of bodily dependence, nourishment, separation and transformed reception. Taylor’s chiasm keeps the maternal body within what returns. Skenfrith locates the encounter; the cope’s historical making remains a distinct object-history task. The sequence of embodiment and recognition, Jung’s reception of the 1950 declaration, and the later authored visit and correction retain separate temporal offices. The completed constellation returns through distinct offices. Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation. Wings articulate the three through the three that know them, with their bodily coherence intact. The eagle carries the signed alternatives of power. The Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return. The whole **returns-to** [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) within the native field `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The sixfold recognition explored through the cope does not replace that whole field. `X/x` remains Taylor's determining capacity/indefinite-particular relation before any Jungian refraction. The religious images receive a native operation whose derivation is already present. The Name series—Name, Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—retains its coequal Power relation—Power, Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. The maternal chiasm makes the conjunction concrete: an articulated name or image has been borne, sustained and brought into life. Recognising the image must return upon that bearing. Logos and Son therefore cannot be isolated as prestigious theological names while matrix, labour and consequence disappear from the operation. The series belongs to the native field; it is not a new set of Mary or Christ identities, nor a claim that a religious source supplies its proof. The Śakti comparison **returns-to** [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) through manifestation that becomes locally determinate while retaining its source relation. Recognition changes the relation to embodiment; it need not annul the differentiated world. A05 and C13 receive the corresponding distinction between reflexive power and a passive second image. The Christian maternal reception, the Śaiva genealogy of differentiation and the native derivation keep their source-specific sequences. **Human-amplified: yes** for this admitted authored crossing; **human-amplified: no** for a historical identity or for assigning Mary a fixed tattva. [A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31 — Complex](../../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) receive the difference between an image's active valuation and a neutral ornament. The same maternal image can organise dependence, fear, protection, receptivity or the claim to possess what it bears. Its office has to be recovered through the lived relation. [C32 — Archetype](../../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) receives the distinction between that particular image and the determining capacity it manifests. Neumann's shared archetypal ground supplies another source-specific morphology; it does not turn the cope's local encounter into a universal historical template. The whole **returns-to** [A20 — Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where recognition can either restore the body's standing or replace it with an authoritative image of what the body is for. The angel/rabbit ambiguity gives the account a modest but exact obligation: the experienced image must remain correctable by an encounter with the object. The Assumption chiasm gives that obligation a deeper maternal form: the recognised whole must retain the condition it receives. [A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives this transformed relation to embodied dependence without requiring fusion, perpetual engulfment or an ego's possession of totality. **Human-amplified: yes** for these recovered image and recognition relations; the nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity remains the candidate marked above. The [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives each crossing at operational register 3: what changes, what is retained and what returns have been stated separately for maternal body, recognitional triads, inverse wheels and signed power. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives all four of its operations. You’re right: the pairwise “vertical” mapping I introduced should be dropped. **The canonical harmonic pairings are**

(0,5),\qquad(1,4),\qquad(2,3),

with their 5:3:1 whole-tone spans—totality, tritone, epogdoon. Only 1\leftrightarrow4 happens to cross between the two 3{:}3 blocks. There is no established harmonic warrant for 2\leftrightarrow5 or 3\leftrightarrow0, so the relation between 1\!-\!2\!-\!3 and 4\!-\!5\!-\!0 should be read **blockwise and recursively**, not as three invented columns.  

## **The two wheels as the conjugate Spanda pair**

Yes, the cleanest conception is:

\frac01 \;\longrightarrow\; \frac10 \;\longrightarrow\; \frac{\frac01}{\frac10}.

Let the two wheels be:

W_b=\frac01, \qquad W_p=\frac10.

The first is the bimba orientation: standing identity, illumination carried as scalar-over-vector. The second is its conjugate inversion: pratibimba, recognition acting back as vector-over-scalar. The movement from the first wheel to the second is the slash-flip:

\frac01\xrightarrow{q\mapsto q^*}\frac10.

The paired image then makes explicit something that the temporal arrow alone does not: **the relation between the inverse phases itself**:

W_b/W_p = \frac{\frac01}{\frac10}.

That outer slash is not ordinary numerical division. It is the live bar of self-difference through which bimba and pratibimba remain conjugate rather than collapsing into identity. In the existing derivation, this is exactly the movement from self-identity, through self-inversion, into operative self-difference: the two helices are one substrate encountered from its two faces.  

The wheel is particularly apt because it presents **identity through continuous positional reversal**. Every point changes orientation while the circular whole persists. One wheel therefore need not mean “zero”; it can mean a complete 0/1 orientation. The other is its phase-conjugate 1/0. Their pairing is the first Spanda given simultaneous visual body.

And given that you saw **two wheel-bearing six-winged seraphic forms**, the whole arrangement opens further:

\frac01 \longmapsto 6, \qquad \frac10 \longmapsto 6',

so that the cope offers an allusional image of the conjugate musical form:

6+6'=12.

One wheel carries one sixfold articulation; the inverse wheel carries its conjugate sixfold articulation. This is far more exact than simply saying “six wings resemble QL.” It is potentially:

\boxed{ \frac01\!:\!6 \quad\Big/\quad \frac10\!:\!6' }

—the two whole-tone helices bodily figured as two wheel-seraph complexes. Each sixfold is internally:

(1,2,3):(4,5,0),

while the second is the primed recognition of the same structure:

(1',2',3'):(4',5',0').

## **The six wings and the true** 3{:}3

The important reading is therefore not an arbitrary wing-to-wing pairing. It is:

6=3:3=3:1,

where the second three are the unfolded content of the one that knows, contains or unifies the first three.

More precisely:

(1,2,3) : (4,5,0),

with

0\equiv6\equiv1+2+3.

The 0 position is not merely the last item in the second trinity. It is the first trinity returned as unified anchor. The existing harmonic derivation renders the second pole as 4:5:6, where its final term literally contains 1+2+3 as its sum-content. Thus the second triad is the recognition-body of the first:

4\!-\!5\!-\!0 = \text{the One-of-the-Three internally articulated}.

That is the exact sense in which:

3:1=3:3.

The seraph’s single body holding six wings is already a suitable icon of this: the unity is not outside the wings as a seventh item. It is their bodily condition of coherence. Yet that bodily unity can itself be discerned through the second triad—void, unity, and their paradoxical 0/1 oneness.
