whole_evidence.text: --- title: Mother, Assumption and chiasm record_id: mytheme-mother-assumption-chiasm record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authorial chiasm recovered from corrected dialogue and quilt; historical and Jungian attribution debts distinguished" source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql - jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11 - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness --- # Mother, Assumption and chiasm ## #0 The Mother flow begins with a body received, a body bearing another, and the receiving body itself returned. Taylor's encounter with the cope at St Bridget's in Skenfrith brings this movement into a particular gathering of images: Mary being lifted, figures perceived as rabbits beside her, six-winged seraphic forms, wheels, and eagles with two heads. His recollection of Jung's Assumption discussion meets a native relation already established in his work: the three recognised as one, whose recognition has its own threefold articulation. The image becomes a place to work through that relation in embodiment. The [Skenfrith dialogue source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/chat-logs/taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql/SOURCE.md) preserves the encounter and its correction. It is a conversation between Taylor and an unnamed assistant, with the standing of provenance of thinking. Taylor's opening observation, his subsequent corrections and the assistant's proposed readings have different authority. The [complete local transcript](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/chat-logs-for-quilting/07-08-2026-jung-marie-skenfrith-cope.md) is the actual carrier of this authored whole. An assistant's confident identification of an embroidered figure is still an identification to verify; an author's correction of his own notation governs the interpretation being made. The rabbit belongs first to the encounter. Taylor reports seeing rabbits lifting Mary; the assistant identifies supporting angels and invokes an unnamed description of the cope. Without that public object witness, the identification remains a lead. The ambiguity nevertheless has an exact place in the whole: what appears to the viewer can initiate an interpretation while remaining answerable to the object. No lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism is assigned to a supposedly medieval rabbit. The experienced form and the intended iconography have not yet been shown to coincide. Taylor also recalls inquiry into the surrounding power dynamics. The assistant expands this into a history of castles, lordship and imperial imagery. The later quilt expressly re-keys that frame: the visit was a personal trip; the essay-usable material is the Mother flow, Assumption and chiasm. The [Mother-flow correction in Q27](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) therefore governs the whole's direction. The site locates the encounter. It does not become evidence that an embroidered programme resolves a local political history, and the narrative does not climb from a castle through an eagle to a theological conclusion. Within this encounter, Mary remains a particular mother. The biblical Mary, the mother of Jesus, is the figure from whom the later maternal reception takes its name and body. The Assumption belongs to a later doctrinal and interpretive history; it is not another episode narrated in this page from a selected Gospel witness. Jung's interpretation of that reception and Taylor's chiasm are further operations. Their relation begins through the same figure without making their sources interchangeable. ## #1 The incarnation–Assumption movement has two directions. In the first, the maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life. What is articulated as divine Word comes through a body which bears it. In the return, that maternal body is itself received. The condition of embodiment remains present in what is recognised as whole. This is the force of the quilt's correction, assumption-*of* rather than ascent-*away-from*: return bears what made manifestation possible instead of treating that condition as a vessel to discard once its work has been done. Taylor's whole does not end with a disembodied recognition of maternity. Mary is both the receiving matrix and the bodily figure received. If only a general feminine principle entered the final account, the particular body that bore the relation would disappear just where recognition claims completion. The chiasm retains that body across the change of direction. Mother, child, receiving and being received remain different relations within the circulation; their difference gives the crossing something to carry. The theological and psychological appointments require their own attribution. The [CW11 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md) identifies Jung's *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. The locally held Hull translation, second edition, supplies the primary *Answer to Job* passages read here: §§609–617,625–628 and746–757, with their intervening and adjacent context. The house now carries six source-matched paraphrase cards for these primary spans. The following remains attributed paraphrase with paragraph locators; no exact quotation-ready wording or newly verified print-page citation is claimed. The reader can distinguish the primary encounter from the assistant's earlier report of it. Jung begins this Sophia movement by turning from Job toward Wisdom in other texts. In §609 he takes up the pre-existent feminine wisdom of Proverbs; §610 relates Sophia to Hebrew Chochma and the Johannine Logos while invoking Indian Śakti as a comparison. The discussion then passes through Ecclesiasticus and the Wisdom of Solomon. Speaking, pervading, world-building, loving, guiding and reflecting give Sophia more than a generic receptive property. These are Jung's readings of several textual witnesses, not biblical Wisdom gathered from Job alone. His historical proposals about contact and descent retain their own evidential burden. [CW11 §§609–613](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The sequence returns to the tested righteous person. Jung brings the oppression of the righteous in the Wisdom of Solomon beside Job, then reads Yahweh's behaviour as a crisis of faithfulness and self-knowledge. Sophia's remembrance answers the demand for divine self-reflection: the human being's knowledge of God becomes consequential for the God-image. The argument moves through an interpretation of creation and its familial counterparts toward a changed incarnation. In §625 the Second Eve has temporal and material priority: the God-man is to be born through a woman. Mary receives the appointment of Sophia's embodiment, friend and intercessor, while Christ is related to the pre-existent Logos and the figure of the master workman. Jung explicitly develops the mother–son relation through that shared symbolic office. [CW11 §§614–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The source also troubles its own image of completion. In §§626–627 Jung argues that the exceptional protections surrounding Mary can separate her from ordinary humanity. Perfection brought close to Christ can impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate it; an incarnation protected from the actual human condition risks being only partial. This is Jung's psychological critique of the doctrine as he reads it. It is not the Church's account of its own teaching, and his accompanying generalisations about men and women do not become the native meaning of Taylor's poles. The tension matters to the Mother flow: exaltation can either receive embodied life or produce an ideal too purified to bear it. [CW11 §§625–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The later Assumption discussion follows the burden of continuing incarnation in the empirical creature. Jung interprets the longing for a maternal intercessor, the heavenly bride and the marriage imagery as a movement toward further incarnation. Recognition and declaration by human beings enter its temporal fulfilment. He insists upon personal feminine representation, yet expressly distinguishes his psychological reading from a dogmatic assertion that Mary has become a goddess. The argument then moves into conscious individuation: the person encounters the unconscious, recognises its opposites and takes responsibility for a relation whose process would otherwise remain obscure. Psychological efficacy is real for Jung; it does not license a simple identification of God with the unconscious as a whole. [CW11 §§746–757](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). This is a developed reception of the Assumption, distinct from the official definition itself. The Trinity's doctrinal constitution cannot be silently rewritten as an official four-person deity. Sophia, biblical Mary, the mother in Jung's theological reconstruction and the embodied return in Taylor's chiasm meet through interpretation while retaining their sources. The adjacent [*Aion* house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies a separate route through Self, Christ-symbolism, opposites and symbolic totality; its installed sixteen-entry passage map records contextual paraphrases from the consulted 1979 paperback. Collation against the selected 1978 hardcover printing and verification of any quotation remain Open. Taylor's recollection of both works does not fuse their sequences. The maternal body is received through these differentiated relations, with the source's own perfection/completeness difficulty still active. The Sophia–Logos–Śakti comparison opens three distinguishable tasks: knowing and recognising, articulating form, and the power of manifestation. In the conversation's proposed account, Sophia carries recognitional wisdom, Logos the intelligibility of articulated form, and Śakti the power through which the relation is active. This construction develops Taylor's explicit invitation to explore Jung's comparison. Its neat distribution of the three names is assistant elaboration. Jung's §610 relates essential qualities and evokes Śakti; it does not supply this fixed three-office formula or an exhaustive account of Śaiva thought. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's expressed comparative inquiry; **human-amplified: no** for promoting that provisional three-name allocation into a fixed doctrinal identity. The Śakti relation matters because receiving and recognising already act. A matrix does not become operative only when a supposedly active term arrives from elsewhere. The comparison can thus approach [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](../../../../episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) through luminous appearing and its reflexive power, whose inseparability permits differentiation. Their source-specific metaphysics remains with that argument and concept. The Mother whole receives the relation as an authored crossing, without making Mary a Sanskrit category or requiring Śaiva sources to validate native QL. ## #2 Taylor's correction identifies the live pressure: the functional masculine and feminine reading crosses the previously given physical and mental poles. Articulation, differentiation and explication give the `1–2–3` block a masculine operation in this reading. Receiving, containing, reflecting and gathering give `4–5–0` a feminine operation. Yet the older symbolic assignment being examined associates physical matter and nature with the feminine, and mental or spiritual life with the masculine. Reading what a pole does and reading the field it bears produce different gender valences. The chiasm preserves both relations as the object of inquiry. The first block can be read as masculine articulation in a feminine material field; the second as feminine recognition in a masculine mental field. These are symbolic assignments whose crossing is being developed, not determinations of what men and women essentially are. They cannot be stabilised by treating one assignment as the literal meaning of the numbers. Each pole's operation already reaches into the field conventionally attributed to the other. Christ–Logos and Mary give this crossing a body in the authored construction. Spiritual articulation becomes embodied; the embodied mother is received into spiritual recognition. The directions remain distinguishable even as each makes the other intelligible. If embodiment were only a descent to be reversed, the return would undo the very relation it completes. If recognition merely retained an image of the mother while leaving her bodily condition outside, the proclaimed whole would again omit what bore it. The Mother flow's return is therefore bodily and recognitional together. **Human-amplified: yes** for the chiasm and assumption-of movement recovered through Taylor's correction and the later quilt. The [Neumann source and protected encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) provide shared archetypal structuration behind this maternal pressure: bodily dependence, nourishment, engulfment, separation and the transformation of the relation to the mother. They do not supply the historical telling of Mary's Assumption. Neumann's source-specific developmental morphology and Taylor's native field retain their own orders. The maternal image can bear the relation between sustaining a life and consuming it without making every mother, every goddess and every feminine symbol instances of one already settled story. Q27 marks the further join between the Mother's nourishing/devouring faces and the Levinasian need/Desire relation as a candidate. It can ask whether a return permits another life to remain other or consumes that life within its own satisfaction. The question is locally material to a body received rather than discarded. **Human-amplified: no** for a newly ratified identity between the two source fields: the candidate is retained as an opening, not installed as their common doctrine. The completed chiasm does not need that stronger equation to perform its own operation. The native `3:1 = 3:3` gives recognition its articulated office. Taylor states at the opening that the one in `3:1` is the three encapsulated or recognised. The first block, `1–2–3`, is known through `4–5–0`: void, unity and their paradoxical `0/1` oneness. The one is thus the unitive condition of the three, whose recognitional constitution can itself be unfolded. It is neither an extra count appended without relation nor a featureless terminus. The second three disclose what the recognising one does. The Mother image makes this operation felt through matrix, mediation and recognition. Receiving gives the articulated life somewhere to arise; bearing sustains its differentiation; recognition receives that differentiation as belonging to a whole. The body's persistence on return prevents the recognitional pole from becoming an external observer looking at what it never had to bear. This is Taylor's existing native operation entering an image, not a theory inferred from the number of Christian figures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit `3:1 = 3:3` appointment; the theological sources retain responsibility for their own claims about Trinity, Mary and symbolic completion. ## #3 The two wheels give the crossing a second form. Taylor directs attention to the full sequence `0/1 → 1/0 → (0/1)/(1/0)`. A first orientation meets its inverse; their relation becomes explicit. The wheel need not be reduced to an isolated zero. The complete orientation already relates the singular One and manifest All, and its inverse changes how that relation is encountered. The outer slash retains the orientations in operative self-difference. It does not divide numerical quantities by zero. As an encountered image, a wheel permits changing orientation while its whole form persists. Two wheels can then bear conjugate orientations without becoming two independent sources. The movement through one view and its inverse is distinguishable from holding their relation together. This is why the final compound matters: the whole has acquired the capacity to carry the reversal it underwent. The wheels **returns-to** [A11 — The Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and [C49](../../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) with One and All still differentiated, and to [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) with orientation as a relation through which positions become possible. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's explicit wheel sequence. No geometric theorem is proved by the embroidery. The seraphic forms give that orientation a sixfold articulation. Taylor reports six wings and asks after `3:3`; the assistant develops two wheel-bearing six-winged forms as a conjugate pair. The whole visual reading can hold one sixfold and its primed counterpart, `6` and `6′`, while each retains the two blocks `(1,2,3):(4,5,0)`. A single body is the condition through which the wings belong together. It does not add a seventh wing, and a second body does not make the first six a series of unrelated numbered items. The proposed `6+6′` develops two articulations in relation; exact historical details of the cope still require their object witness. The dialogue's first attempt to map the wings into vertical pairs is explicitly corrected. Taylor rejects `2↔5` and `3↔0`; only `1↔4` belongs to the established pairings in that proposed arrangement. The native complementary folds are `0↔5`, `1↔4` and `2↔3`. They have their own harmonic work and cannot be manufactured by placing the two recognitional blocks into adjacent columns. The body can sustain both the `3:3` reading and the native complementary relations without pretending they are the same partition. The important operation here is blockwise and recursive recognition. The assistant's invocation of Isaiah's wing functions and Ezekiel's intersecting wheels is a distinct textual proposal. Selected primary passages and an object description must establish those scriptural and iconographic relations before their exact wording or historical combination can be attributed. The present whole develops Taylor's encountered wing-and-wheel relation without borrowing an unverified biblical quotation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the reported sixfold encounter and corrected blockwise recognition; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected pairings and for treating every subsequent assistant elaboration as an accepted iconographic programme. This return to the wheel and wing preserves the Mother movement. The body that bears the differentiation remains its condition when the differentiation is recognised. Recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it. In the Assumption chiasm, the same pressure prevents the maternal body from vanishing into a final spiritual account of what it supposedly meant. ## #4 The eagle changes the operative question. Its two heads direct one body toward opposed orientations, but the governing relation here is signed valence and power. Taylor corrects the assistant's attempt to give the eagle the wheels' Spanda equations and a `1/1` reconciliation. He had pointed to `−1` and `+1`, and to the difference between a relation retaining their polarity and operations that cancel or amplify through negation. The one body does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled. The retained form is `(-1)/(+1)`. Each pole keeps its sign across the relation. Ordinary addition, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, cancels the signed quantities; subtraction produces `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, while the inverse subtraction gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are three distinct arithmetic results. Taylor's authored political and psychic reading uses them to distinguish held polarity, cancellation and one valence's amplification through negation of the other. The sign of a pole does not, by itself, determine its moral worth. The eagle's power-body can consequently be asked which operation it carries. Does its unity retain opposed orientations in relation? Does an apparent agreement cancel their difference? Does one direction acquire its enlarged power by negating the other? Those questions give the shared body an accountable office. They also prevent the Mother flow from ending in a picture where completion means that the differentiated life has disappeared. The same whole that receives must be able to sustain a difference within what it receives. The corrected eagle **returns-to** [A13 — Two Logics of Two](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50 — Dia / Syn](../../../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). Dia gives difference a determinate orientation; Syn keeps the relation through which differentiated terms can be recomposed and returned. Healthy polarity remains a positive operation. Cancellation and appropriation are its different failures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit signed-power correction; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected `1/1` eagle or an automatic identity between political domination and one arithmetic sign. The historical emblem's association with particular sovereign offices is a further source task. Taylor's observation and his power-valence reading suffice for the authored inquiry; they do not verify the intention of the cope's makers, the status of an imperial device in that object, or a chain of local political events. The quilt's removal of the castle-history frame remains active at the end of the eagle reading. Power is examined through its operation, with the journey preserved as provenance rather than made to carry an unverified history. ## #5→0 The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** the shared maternal structuration of bodily dependence, nourishment, separation and transformed reception. Taylor’s chiasm keeps the maternal body within what returns. Skenfrith locates the encounter; the cope’s historical making remains a distinct object-history task. The sequence of embodiment and recognition, Jung’s reception of the 1950 declaration, and the later authored visit and correction retain separate temporal offices. The completed constellation returns through distinct offices. Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation. Wings articulate the three through the three that know them, with their bodily coherence intact. The eagle carries the signed alternatives of power. The Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return. These relations can act together because they have not been reduced to one number, one sex assignment or one emblem of undifferentiated divinity. The whole **returns-to** [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) within the native field `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) grounds those eight determinations, their sequence, inversions and relations. The sixfold recognition explored through the cope does not replace that whole field. `X/x` remains Taylor's determining capacity/indefinite-particular relation before any Jungian refraction. The religious images receive a native operation whose derivation is already present. The Name series—Name, Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—retains its coequal Power relation—Power, Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. The maternal chiasm makes the conjunction concrete: an articulated name or image has been borne, sustained and brought into life. Recognising the image must return upon that bearing. Logos and Son therefore cannot be isolated as prestigious theological names while matrix, labour and consequence disappear from the operation. The series belongs to the native field; it is not a new set of Mary or Christ identities, nor a claim that a religious source supplies its proof. The Śakti comparison **returns-to** [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) through manifestation that becomes locally determinate while retaining its source relation. Recognition changes the relation to embodiment; it need not annul the differentiated world. A05 and C13 receive the corresponding distinction between reflexive power and a passive second image. The Christian maternal reception, the Śaiva genealogy of differentiation and the native derivation keep their source-specific sequences. **Human-amplified: yes** for this admitted authored crossing; **human-amplified: no** for a historical identity or for assigning Mary a fixed tattva. [A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31 — Complex](../../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) receive the difference between an image's active valuation and a neutral ornament. The same maternal image can organise dependence, fear, protection, receptivity or the claim to possess what it bears. Its office has to be recovered through the lived relation. [C32 — Archetype](../../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) receives the distinction between that particular image and the determining capacity it manifests. Neumann's shared archetypal ground supplies another source-specific morphology; it does not turn the cope's local encounter into a universal historical template. The whole **returns-to** [A20 — Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where recognition can either restore the body's standing or replace it with an authoritative image of what the body is for. The angel/rabbit ambiguity gives the account a modest but exact obligation: the experienced image must remain correctable by an encounter with the object. The Assumption chiasm gives that obligation a deeper maternal form: the recognised whole must retain the condition it receives. [A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives this transformed relation to embodied dependence without requiring fusion, perpetual engulfment or an ego's possession of totality. **Human-amplified: yes** for these recovered image and recognition relations; the nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity remains the candidate marked above. The body also changes what a return owes. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives the difference between bearing a consequential office and becoming the source of the field. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work. Their work cannot be honoured by pretending they were dispensable, or by making one mediating image the owner of every relation it conducts. This is the author's office comparison, not a new claim about Mary's doctrinal titles. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) receives the corresponding test: a completed product must return consequence and recognition to the conditions and labour through which it arrived. The Mother flow makes the sustaining body visible within what completion receives. [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives reliance that precedes an exhaustive account of what bears it. The mother/child image gives that dependence a particular form, while the whole's return prevents dependence from being treated as ownership. [A27 — Self and Other: Unity without Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives that preserved difference: to have been borne within a relation does not make a life the property of its bearer. [A35 — Compassion as Sensitivity to Origins](../../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives the loving direction of the return toward the body, history and work that made the achieved form possible. These admitted office, trust and care relations retain **human-amplified: yes** standing. They neither make bodily suffering necessary for spiritual completion nor establish a historical politics from the cope. The [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives each crossing at operational register 3: what changes, what is retained and what returns have been stated separately for maternal body, recognitional triads, inverse wheels and signed power. Numerical recurrence alone proves none of these relations. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives all four of its operations. The encountered form discloses; its account remains answerable to the source; trust lets the account guide inquiry without owning its ground; the interpretation changes the conditions of the next encounter. Taylor's correction is one such return, changing the assistant's account of the wings and eagle instead of allowing a pleasing pattern to govern the source. The [Definition of God source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) keeps devotion double, to the exceeding whole and to the particular aperture through which it arrives. The Mother flow **returns-to** [A36 — Advent of Integral Zero](../../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) with that double obligation embodied. Recognition receives the matrix within the whole it bore; a completed account returns to the particular body rather than leaving it behind as the price of completion. **Human-amplified: yes** for this quilted assumption-of return. Historical object and scriptural verification, together with exact quotation collation of the locally read Jung passages, remain debts in their own registers; they do not defer the native operation already enacted through this whole.

## **The double-headed eagle as dia-ballein power**

Here the Spanda equations should indeed stay in the background. The eagle belongs directly to the signed, valent register:

-1/+1.

The two heads face opposed directions from a single imperial power-body. Their primary logic is not originary nonduality but **differentiated polarity, valuation and control**.

The healthy dia-ballein form is:

\boxed{ \frac{-1}{+1} }

The slash maintains separation-across-relation. Each pole retains its valence; neither has to absorb or annihilate the other. The imperial body holds the tension as one power-field without pretending the two orientations are identical.

The alternative operations expose the unstable possibilities internal to power:

(-1)+(+1)=0,

mutual cancellation or neutralisation;

(-1)-(+1)=-2,

the negative pole doubling itself through negation of the positive;

and, in reverse orientation,

(+1)-(-1)=+2,

the positive pole doubling itself through negation of the negative.

Collectively:

\boxed{ (-1)\pm(+1) \longrightarrow \{0,\pm2\} }

This is an excellent compact algebra of power:

\begin{aligned} \frac{-1}{+1} &=\text{held polarity};\\ 0 &=\text{cancellation or depoliticised neutralisation};\\ \pm2 &=\text{dominance, escalation or monopolised valence}. \end{aligned}

The shared eagle-body is therefore not necessarily a 1/1 reconciliation. It is the **seat of power that determines which operator governs the poles**. It can maintain them in ratio, cancel them, or empower one through the negation of the other.

## **Clean seal of the motifs**

\boxed{ \begin{array}{rcl} \textbf{Two wheels} &:& \dfrac01 \rightarrow \dfrac10 \rightarrow \dfrac{\frac01}{\frac10} \\[10pt] && \text{conjugate phase, inversion, recognised relation} \\[16pt] \textbf{Two six-winged seraphs} &:& \left[(1,2,3):(4,5,0)\right] \Big/ \left[(1',2',3'):(4',5',0')\right] \\[8pt] && 6+6'=12,\quad 3:1=3:3 \\[16pt] \textbf{Assumption of Mary} &:& \text{Sophia–Śakti–Logos} \rightarrow \text{Mary–Christ} \\[6pt] && 3:1 = (1,2,3):(4,5,0) \\[6pt] && \text{the feminine One recognises, embodies and completes the Three} \\[16pt] \textbf{Double-headed eagle} &:& \dfrac{-1}{+1} \quad\text{or}\quad (-1)\pm(+1)\rightarrow\{0,\pm2\} \\[8pt] && \text{dia-ballein, valence, sovereignty and power} \end{array} }

The cope’s QL allusional field is therefore not one vague sixfold resemblance. It is much more articulated:

\boxed{ \text{conjugate binary wheels} \;\rightarrow\; \text{conjugate sixfold angelic bodies} \;\rightarrow\; \text{feminine recognitional completion} }

while the eagles hold the distinct downstream register of signed division, valuation and worldly power.

whole_evidence.text: --- title: Mother, Assumption and chiasm record_id: mytheme-mother-assumption-chiasm record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authorial chiasm recovered from corrected dialogue and quilt; historical and Jungian attribution debts distinguished" source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql - jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11 - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness --- # Mother, Assumption and chiasm ## #0 The Mother flow begins with a body received, a body bearing another, and the receiving body itself returned. Taylor's encounter with the cope at St Bridget's in Skenfrith brings this movement into a particular gathering of images: Mary being lifted, figures perceived as rabbits beside her, six-winged seraphic forms, wheels, and eagles with two heads. His recollection of Jung's Assumption discussion meets a native relation already established in his work: the three recognised as one, whose recognition has its own threefold articulation. The image becomes a place to work through that relation in embodiment. The [Skenfrith dialogue source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/chat-logs/taylor-2026-skenfrith-cope-jung-ql/SOURCE.md) preserves the encounter and its correction. It is a conversation between Taylor and an unnamed assistant, with the standing of provenance of thinking. Taylor's opening observation, his subsequent corrections and the assistant's proposed readings have different authority. The [complete local transcript](../../../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/chat-logs-for-quilting/07-08-2026-jung-marie-skenfrith-cope.md) is the actual carrier of this authored whole. An assistant's confident identification of an embroidered figure is still an identification to verify; an author's correction of his own notation governs the interpretation being made. The rabbit belongs first to the encounter. Taylor reports seeing rabbits lifting Mary; the assistant identifies supporting angels and invokes an unnamed description of the cope. Without that public object witness, the identification remains a lead. The ambiguity nevertheless has an exact place in the whole: what appears to the viewer can initiate an interpretation while remaining answerable to the object. No lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism is assigned to a supposedly medieval rabbit. The experienced form and the intended iconography have not yet been shown to coincide. Taylor also recalls inquiry into the surrounding power dynamics. The assistant expands this into a history of castles, lordship and imperial imagery. The later quilt expressly re-keys that frame: the visit was a personal trip; the essay-usable material is the Mother flow, Assumption and chiasm. The [Mother-flow correction in Q27](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) therefore governs the whole's direction. The site locates the encounter. It does not become evidence that an embroidered programme resolves a local political history, and the narrative does not climb from a castle through an eagle to a theological conclusion. Within this encounter, Mary remains a particular mother. The biblical Mary, the mother of Jesus, is the figure from whom the later maternal reception takes its name and body. The Assumption belongs to a later doctrinal and interpretive history; it is not another episode narrated in this page from a selected Gospel witness. Jung's interpretation of that reception and Taylor's chiasm are further operations. Their relation begins through the same figure without making their sources interchangeable. ## #1 The incarnation–Assumption movement has two directions. In the first, the maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life. What is articulated as divine Word comes through a body which bears it. In the return, that maternal body is itself received. The condition of embodiment remains present in what is recognised as whole. This is the force of the quilt's correction, assumption-*of* rather than ascent-*away-from*: return bears what made manifestation possible instead of treating that condition as a vessel to discard once its work has been done. Taylor's whole does not end with a disembodied recognition of maternity. Mary is both the receiving matrix and the bodily figure received. If only a general feminine principle entered the final account, the particular body that bore the relation would disappear just where recognition claims completion. The chiasm retains that body across the change of direction. Mother, child, receiving and being received remain different relations within the circulation; their difference gives the crossing something to carry. The theological and psychological appointments require their own attribution. The [CW11 source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md) identifies Jung's *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. The locally held Hull translation, second edition, supplies the primary *Answer to Job* passages read here: §§609–617,625–628 and746–757, with their intervening and adjacent context. The house now carries six source-matched paraphrase cards for these primary spans. The following remains attributed paraphrase with paragraph locators; no exact quotation-ready wording or newly verified print-page citation is claimed. The reader can distinguish the primary encounter from the assistant's earlier report of it. Jung begins this Sophia movement by turning from Job toward Wisdom in other texts. In §609 he takes up the pre-existent feminine wisdom of Proverbs; §610 relates Sophia to Hebrew Chochma and the Johannine Logos while invoking Indian Śakti as a comparison. The discussion then passes through Ecclesiasticus and the Wisdom of Solomon. Speaking, pervading, world-building, loving, guiding and reflecting give Sophia more than a generic receptive property. These are Jung's readings of several textual witnesses, not biblical Wisdom gathered from Job alone. His historical proposals about contact and descent retain their own evidential burden. [CW11 §§609–613](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The sequence returns to the tested righteous person. Jung brings the oppression of the righteous in the Wisdom of Solomon beside Job, then reads Yahweh's behaviour as a crisis of faithfulness and self-knowledge. Sophia's remembrance answers the demand for divine self-reflection: the human being's knowledge of God becomes consequential for the God-image. The argument moves through an interpretation of creation and its familial counterparts toward a changed incarnation. In §625 the Second Eve has temporal and material priority: the God-man is to be born through a woman. Mary receives the appointment of Sophia's embodiment, friend and intercessor, while Christ is related to the pre-existent Logos and the figure of the master workman. Jung explicitly develops the mother–son relation through that shared symbolic office. [CW11 §§614–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The source also troubles its own image of completion. In §§626–627 Jung argues that the exceptional protections surrounding Mary can separate her from ordinary humanity. Perfection brought close to Christ can impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate it; an incarnation protected from the actual human condition risks being only partial. This is Jung's psychological critique of the doctrine as he reads it. It is not the Church's account of its own teaching, and his accompanying generalisations about men and women do not become the native meaning of Taylor's poles. The tension matters to the Mother flow: exaltation can either receive embodied life or produce an ideal too purified to bear it. [CW11 §§625–628](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). The later Assumption discussion follows the burden of continuing incarnation in the empirical creature. Jung interprets the longing for a maternal intercessor, the heavenly bride and the marriage imagery as a movement toward further incarnation. Recognition and declaration by human beings enter its temporal fulfilment. He insists upon personal feminine representation, yet expressly distinguishes his psychological reading from a dogmatic assertion that Mary has become a goddess. The argument then moves into conscious individuation: the person encounters the unconscious, recognises its opposites and takes responsibility for a relation whose process would otherwise remain obscure. Psychological efficacy is real for Jung; it does not license a simple identification of God with the unconscious as a whole. [CW11 §§746–757](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md). This is a developed reception of the Assumption, distinct from the official definition itself. The Trinity's doctrinal constitution cannot be silently rewritten as an official four-person deity. Sophia, biblical Mary, the mother in Jung's theological reconstruction and the embodied return in Taylor's chiasm meet through interpretation while retaining their sources. The adjacent [*Aion* house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies a separate route through Self, Christ-symbolism, opposites and symbolic totality; its installed sixteen-entry passage map records contextual paraphrases from the consulted 1979 paperback. Collation against the selected 1978 hardcover printing and verification of any quotation remain Open. Taylor's recollection of both works does not fuse their sequences. The maternal body is received through these differentiated relations, with the source's own perfection/completeness difficulty still active. The Sophia–Logos–Śakti comparison opens three distinguishable tasks: knowing and recognising, articulating form, and the power of manifestation. In the conversation's proposed account, Sophia carries recognitional wisdom, Logos the intelligibility of articulated form, and Śakti the power through which the relation is active. This construction develops Taylor's explicit invitation to explore Jung's comparison. Its neat distribution of the three names is assistant elaboration. Jung's §610 relates essential qualities and evokes Śakti; it does not supply this fixed three-office formula or an exhaustive account of Śaiva thought. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's expressed comparative inquiry; **human-amplified: no** for promoting that provisional three-name allocation into a fixed doctrinal identity. The Śakti relation matters because receiving and recognising already act. A matrix does not become operative only when a supposedly active term arrives from elsewhere. The comparison can thus approach [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](../../../../episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) through luminous appearing and its reflexive power, whose inseparability permits differentiation. Their source-specific metaphysics remains with that argument and concept. The Mother whole receives the relation as an authored crossing, without making Mary a Sanskrit category or requiring Śaiva sources to validate native QL. ## #2 Taylor's correction identifies the live pressure: the functional masculine and feminine reading crosses the previously given physical and mental poles. Articulation, differentiation and explication give the `1–2–3` block a masculine operation in this reading. Receiving, containing, reflecting and gathering give `4–5–0` a feminine operation. Yet the older symbolic assignment being examined associates physical matter and nature with the feminine, and mental or spiritual life with the masculine. Reading what a pole does and reading the field it bears produce different gender valences. The chiasm preserves both relations as the object of inquiry. The first block can be read as masculine articulation in a feminine material field; the second as feminine recognition in a masculine mental field. These are symbolic assignments whose crossing is being developed, not determinations of what men and women essentially are. They cannot be stabilised by treating one assignment as the literal meaning of the numbers. Each pole's operation already reaches into the field conventionally attributed to the other. Christ–Logos and Mary give this crossing a body in the authored construction. Spiritual articulation becomes embodied; the embodied mother is received into spiritual recognition. The directions remain distinguishable even as each makes the other intelligible. If embodiment were only a descent to be reversed, the return would undo the very relation it completes. If recognition merely retained an image of the mother while leaving her bodily condition outside, the proclaimed whole would again omit what bore it. The Mother flow's return is therefore bodily and recognitional together. **Human-amplified: yes** for the chiasm and assumption-of movement recovered through Taylor's correction and the later quilt. The [Neumann source and protected encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) provide shared archetypal structuration behind this maternal pressure: bodily dependence, nourishment, engulfment, separation and the transformation of the relation to the mother. They do not supply the historical telling of Mary's Assumption. Neumann's source-specific developmental morphology and Taylor's native field retain their own orders. The maternal image can bear the relation between sustaining a life and consuming it without making every mother, every goddess and every feminine symbol instances of one already settled story. Q27 marks the further join between the Mother's nourishing/devouring faces and the Levinasian need/Desire relation as a candidate. It can ask whether a return permits another life to remain other or consumes that life within its own satisfaction. The question is locally material to a body received rather than discarded. **Human-amplified: no** for a newly ratified identity between the two source fields: the candidate is retained as an opening, not installed as their common doctrine. The completed chiasm does not need that stronger equation to perform its own operation. The native `3:1 = 3:3` gives recognition its articulated office. Taylor states at the opening that the one in `3:1` is the three encapsulated or recognised. The first block, `1–2–3`, is known through `4–5–0`: void, unity and their paradoxical `0/1` oneness. The one is thus the unitive condition of the three, whose recognitional constitution can itself be unfolded. It is neither an extra count appended without relation nor a featureless terminus. The second three disclose what the recognising one does. The Mother image makes this operation felt through matrix, mediation and recognition. Receiving gives the articulated life somewhere to arise; bearing sustains its differentiation; recognition receives that differentiation as belonging to a whole. The body's persistence on return prevents the recognitional pole from becoming an external observer looking at what it never had to bear. This is Taylor's existing native operation entering an image, not a theory inferred from the number of Christian figures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit `3:1 = 3:3` appointment; the theological sources retain responsibility for their own claims about Trinity, Mary and symbolic completion. ## #3 The two wheels give the crossing a second form. Taylor directs attention to the full sequence `0/1 → 1/0 → (0/1)/(1/0)`. A first orientation meets its inverse; their relation becomes explicit. The wheel need not be reduced to an isolated zero. The complete orientation already relates the singular One and manifest All, and its inverse changes how that relation is encountered. The outer slash retains the orientations in operative self-difference. It does not divide numerical quantities by zero. As an encountered image, a wheel permits changing orientation while its whole form persists. Two wheels can then bear conjugate orientations without becoming two independent sources. The movement through one view and its inverse is distinguishable from holding their relation together. This is why the final compound matters: the whole has acquired the capacity to carry the reversal it underwent. The wheels **returns-to** [A11 — The Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and [C49](../../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) with One and All still differentiated, and to [A16 — Arche-Topos](../../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) with orientation as a relation through which positions become possible. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's explicit wheel sequence. No geometric theorem is proved by the embroidery. The seraphic forms give that orientation a sixfold articulation. Taylor reports six wings and asks after `3:3`; the assistant develops two wheel-bearing six-winged forms as a conjugate pair. The whole visual reading can hold one sixfold and its primed counterpart, `6` and `6′`, while each retains the two blocks `(1,2,3):(4,5,0)`. A single body is the condition through which the wings belong together. It does not add a seventh wing, and a second body does not make the first six a series of unrelated numbered items. The proposed `6+6′` develops two articulations in relation; exact historical details of the cope still require their object witness. The dialogue's first attempt to map the wings into vertical pairs is explicitly corrected. Taylor rejects `2↔5` and `3↔0`; only `1↔4` belongs to the established pairings in that proposed arrangement. The native complementary folds are `0↔5`, `1↔4` and `2↔3`. They have their own harmonic work and cannot be manufactured by placing the two recognitional blocks into adjacent columns. The body can sustain both the `3:3` reading and the native complementary relations without pretending they are the same partition. The important operation here is blockwise and recursive recognition. The assistant's invocation of Isaiah's wing functions and Ezekiel's intersecting wheels is a distinct textual proposal. Selected primary passages and an object description must establish those scriptural and iconographic relations before their exact wording or historical combination can be attributed. The present whole develops Taylor's encountered wing-and-wheel relation without borrowing an unverified biblical quotation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the reported sixfold encounter and corrected blockwise recognition; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected pairings and for treating every subsequent assistant elaboration as an accepted iconographic programme. This return to the wheel and wing preserves the Mother movement. The body that bears the differentiation remains its condition when the differentiation is recognised. Recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it. In the Assumption chiasm, the same pressure prevents the maternal body from vanishing into a final spiritual account of what it supposedly meant. ## #4 The eagle changes the operative question. Its two heads direct one body toward opposed orientations, but the governing relation here is signed valence and power. Taylor corrects the assistant's attempt to give the eagle the wheels' Spanda equations and a `1/1` reconciliation. He had pointed to `−1` and `+1`, and to the difference between a relation retaining their polarity and operations that cancel or amplify through negation. The one body does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled. The retained form is `(-1)/(+1)`. Each pole keeps its sign across the relation. Ordinary addition, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, cancels the signed quantities; subtraction produces `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, while the inverse subtraction gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are three distinct arithmetic results. Taylor's authored political and psychic reading uses them to distinguish held polarity, cancellation and one valence's amplification through negation of the other. The sign of a pole does not, by itself, determine its moral worth. The eagle's power-body can consequently be asked which operation it carries. Does its unity retain opposed orientations in relation? Does an apparent agreement cancel their difference? Does one direction acquire its enlarged power by negating the other? Those questions give the shared body an accountable office. They also prevent the Mother flow from ending in a picture where completion means that the differentiated life has disappeared. The same whole that receives must be able to sustain a difference within what it receives. The corrected eagle **returns-to** [A13 — Two Logics of Two](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) and [C50 — Dia / Syn](../../../../episteme/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md). Dia gives difference a determinate orientation; Syn keeps the relation through which differentiated terms can be recomposed and returned. Healthy polarity remains a positive operation. Cancellation and appropriation are its different failures. **Human-amplified: yes** for the explicit signed-power correction; **human-amplified: no** for the rejected `1/1` eagle or an automatic identity between political domination and one arithmetic sign. The historical emblem's association with particular sovereign offices is a further source task. Taylor's observation and his power-valence reading suffice for the authored inquiry; they do not verify the intention of the cope's makers, the status of an imperial device in that object, or a chain of local political events. The quilt's removal of the castle-history frame remains active at the end of the eagle reading. Power is examined through its operation, with the journey preserved as provenance rather than made to carry an unverified history. ## #5→0 The [complete Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-metabolism) **grounds** the shared maternal structuration of bodily dependence, nourishment, separation and transformed reception. Taylor’s chiasm keeps the maternal body within what returns. Skenfrith locates the encounter; the cope’s historical making remains a distinct object-history task. The sequence of embodiment and recognition, Jung’s reception of the 1950 declaration, and the later authored visit and correction retain separate temporal offices. The completed constellation returns through distinct offices. Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation. Wings articulate the three through the three that know them, with their bodily coherence intact. The eagle carries the signed alternatives of power. The Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return. These relations can act together because they have not been reduced to one number, one sex assignment or one emblem of undifferentiated divinity. The whole **returns-to** [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) within the native field `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) grounds those eight determinations, their sequence, inversions and relations. The sixfold recognition explored through the cope does not replace that whole field. `X/x` remains Taylor's determining capacity/indefinite-particular relation before any Jungian refraction. The religious images receive a native operation whose derivation is already present. The Name series—Name, Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—retains its coequal Power relation—Power, Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. The maternal chiasm makes the conjunction concrete: an articulated name or image has been borne, sustained and brought into life. Recognising the image must return upon that bearing. Logos and Son therefore cannot be isolated as prestigious theological names while matrix, labour and consequence disappear from the operation. The series belongs to the native field; it is not a new set of Mary or Christ identities, nor a claim that a religious source supplies its proof. The Śakti comparison **returns-to** [A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) through manifestation that becomes locally determinate while retaining its source relation. Recognition changes the relation to embodiment; it need not annul the differentiated world. A05 and C13 receive the corresponding distinction between reflexive power and a passive second image. The Christian maternal reception, the Śaiva genealogy of differentiation and the native derivation keep their source-specific sequences. **Human-amplified: yes** for this admitted authored crossing; **human-amplified: no** for a historical identity or for assigning Mary a fixed tattva. [A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31 — Complex](../../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) receive the difference between an image's active valuation and a neutral ornament. The same maternal image can organise dependence, fear, protection, receptivity or the claim to possess what it bears. Its office has to be recovered through the lived relation. [C32 — Archetype](../../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) receives the distinction between that particular image and the determining capacity it manifests. Neumann's shared archetypal ground supplies another source-specific morphology; it does not turn the cope's local encounter into a universal historical template. The whole **returns-to** [A20 — Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where recognition can either restore the body's standing or replace it with an authoritative image of what the body is for. The angel/rabbit ambiguity gives the account a modest but exact obligation: the experienced image must remain correctable by an encounter with the object. The Assumption chiasm gives that obligation a deeper maternal form: the recognised whole must retain the condition it receives. [A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives this transformed relation to embodied dependence without requiring fusion, perpetual engulfment or an ego's possession of totality. **Human-amplified: yes** for these recovered image and recognition relations; the nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity remains the candidate marked above. The body also changes what a return owes. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives the difference between bearing a consequential office and becoming the source of the field. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work. Their work cannot be honoured by pretending they were dispensable, or by making one mediating image the owner of every relation it conducts. This is the author's office comparison, not a new claim about Mary's doctrinal titles. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) receives the corresponding test: a completed product must return consequence and recognition to the conditions and labour through which it arrived. The Mother flow makes the sustaining body visible within what completion receives. [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives reliance that precedes an exhaustive account of what bears it. The mother/child image gives that dependence a particular form, while the whole's return prevents dependence from being treated as ownership. [A27 — Self and Other: Unity without Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives that preserved difference: to have been borne within a relation does not make a life the property of its bearer. [A35 — Compassion as Sensitivity to Origins](../../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives the loving direction of the return toward the body, history and work that made the achieved form possible. These admitted office, trust and care relations retain **human-amplified: yes** standing. They neither make bodily suffering necessary for spiritual completion nor establish a historical politics from the cope. The [Homology / Analogy field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives each crossing at operational register 3: what changes, what is retained and what returns have been stated separately for maternal body, recognitional triads, inverse wheels and signed power. Numerical recurrence alone proves none of these relations. The [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) receives all four of its operations. The encountered form discloses; its account remains answerable to the source; trust lets the account guide inquiry without owning its ground; the interpretation changes the conditions of the next encounter. Taylor's correction is one such return, changing the assistant's account of the wings and eagle instead of allowing a pleasing pattern to govern the source. The [Definition of God source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) keeps devotion double, to the exceeding whole and to the particular aperture through which it arrives. Been at st Bridget's church in skenfrith in Wales today, saw the cope and dug into some stuff around power dynamics in the surrounding area, but I was enticed by remembering my readings in Jung and the assumption of Marie in answer to job and Aion, and also was struck that the seraphim had 6 wings (what feels like an odd archetypal nod to the 6fold), and that Marie had rabbits about here as they lifted her up... Also the two headed eagles there... What you think about these allusional pointers to QL in 3:3 and 0/1 or -1/+1 forms, and indeed about Jung's notion of the assumption of Mary bringing the missing 4th, via the feminine, into the archetypal constitution of Christianity? Remember that in QL 3:3 is actually formed by a 3:1 where the 1 is the 3 encapsulated or recognised, the 1-2-3 known via 4/5/0 as void, unity, then their paradoxical oneness (I.e, 0, then 1 then 0/1)?

Yes—there is a remarkably coherent QL constellation there, especially when the images are read **relationally rather than as isolated numerical coincidences**. The strongest sequence is:

\text{two orientations in one body} \;\longrightarrow\; \text{three paired functions / two reflected trinities} \;\longrightarrow\; \text{the three gathered and bodily completed by the fourth}.

One small but rather delightful correction first: the rabbit-like beings beside Mary are actually the two angels supporting her Assumption. One description of the cope explicitly warns, “Do not mistake the angels … for rabbits,” so you evidently encountered the precise visual ambiguity others have encountered too. The cope appears to date from roughly 1450–1500; its central field contains the Assumption, seraphs with three pairs of wings poised upon wheels, fleurs-de-lis and double-headed eagles.  

Your rabbit-perception can still belong to the **personal allusional register**—the psyche’s spontaneous reading of the deteriorated image—but it should not be retrojected as the intended medieval iconography. In a way that distinction is itself extremely QL: the bimba is angel; the encountered pratibimba was rabbit; the symbol is the form capable of carrying both without their simply becoming factually identical.

source_or_authorial_carrier_evidence.text: - Technology has become the mirror of humanity. Now, it seems, the mirror image moves before the figure who gazes into it, those who are represented by it. The mirror, through arcane manipulations and distortions akin to those we find at a funhouse, has come to precede in its co-dependent motions the humanity that seeks to see itself therein, and the docility of modern humanity, the "gazification" of Man that makes of us bodiless organs of a pallid, ailing sight, ensures that we cannot feel, or vocalise our observance of, the distortion of the mirror, for we have nothing real in ourselves anymore to compare the image to, so totally absorbed as we are, like Narcissus, in the image that poses as (and possesses) our Being. Unlike Narcissus (or maybe not so differently) it is both our beauty and ghoulishness that keeps us captivated.

The thread's real discovery is not the smokescreen; it is the invariant the smokescreen hides: **a determinate local formation installs itself at the zero that made it possible.** Castle on Merlin's mound; the Skenfrith Cope hidden at the Reformation; the Masonic lodge over the social field; the Royal Mint furnace at Redbrook; the bunker in the Bath stone; the fountain over the drained swamp; Monument over the Great Fire; the Domesday grid at Hastings. Sword, altar, lodge, furnace, bunker, screen — eight media, one operation. The "complete stack" (geology, terrain, folklore) is one node seen from three sides: extraction, occupation, and monument; the monument is the part that forgets.

The sharpest exhibit is **Old Sarum**: the Rotten Borough — a seat of power with its population evacuated still sending two MPs; a `1` with its `0` emptied, pure form voting. The Reform Act ending it is the return of the ground. The **Grosvenor fountain** is the same operation in stone: four explicate faces over the suppressed water of the old Five Fields, Saint Michael capping the system as the boundary-keeper — a `4+2` mandala built to keep the zero from rising.

The **smokescreen** (Berwyn 1974, Broad Haven 1977, RAF Rudloe Manor/S4) is the same operation weaponised: the institution that owns the gauge actively cultivates the false ground (the UFO folklore) so the real zero (tectonic strain plus classified low-level flight testing) stays occupied. The two-sidedness is constitutive: the military occupation of the zero is documented; the direct encounter is not reducible to it. Each reading carries the other subdominantly — the two-dot structure itself. Gemini's "power always anchors itself to the strongest nodes" is corrected to: power anchors to the strongest nodes *because nodes are where the zero is most alive* — fault lines, water, trade routes, thresholds, seams. The essay's settled sentence is sharper: power asks **who may occupy or distribute the floor**; the lodge, the bunker, and the gauge are that question's local answers.

The house of liberation then meets rain at its window. By the end, wind, eye and message pass beyond the pigeonhole that would classify their arrival. This is a movement in the experience of freedom, not a legislative claim that every particular action is exempt from consequence.

The opening pair gives Knowing and Being parallel releases from defence and pretence. The following pair pursues what each release makes possible: war loses its occasion in one, while slighting cannot soil sense in the other. The last line tests its claim in sound, letting slighting approach slightly without letting injury acquire the final authority to determine what is real. ## #2 — Two roads, six works, and the return through the loop The P0→P5 order belongs to this composition. P3 and P4 are a consequential pair: one unfolds the productive play of distinction, the other addresses its severing misuse. Their complementary lean is **human-amplified: yes** in the authored six-route programme. A return through the sequence does not create a seventh poem.

whole_evidence.text: ### FT-P15 — P4: There’s one underlying issue in our age > There’s one underlying issue in our age. One could say, One is the underlying issue of our age… Let me rephrase, how the One is to one, this underscores and is setting our stage. Collectively we haven’t a frame open enough to let the evening wane or the one air in through released panes, to be breathed all the same. Are you one? Are we one whole together? Galaxies, planets, seasons, angels, demons, bodies, bots, the weather? Where between each one is One’s tether? Two is the first sign that one must endeavour, married to the bond by a lifetime of together, time dividing not for war but for dreaming towards forever. The one issue; we forgot that one really is two. We almost always see to two as two, because mind must split, divide and polarise, to know is to sever. What amounts, by all accounts, isn’t very clever. Firstly, it is completely derived. So late on the scene did this thinking arise, yet its high water mark is hubris despite; each apotheosis a reason to demonise. Secondly it measures by limiting a sky, by making a cloud where an aeon could fly, blocking light to reify. Third it seals with patterned definition, neither side holds the other, nor self recognition. Alive is a logic landing humility as provision, as primary and axiomatic, as prerequisite of precision. We start with the sky open wide, with the one truth for which thought has no vision, ever aloof, zero-and-one as one impossible act of re-cognition. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q015) · Extracted authorial poem. The poem opens with an issue in our age and turns one into One before widening the scene through panes, air, planets, bodies and weather. Two makes the bond perceptible; time can divide for a shared future. The critique of severance then gives three reasons: the cutting mind is derived, its measure limits the sky, and its definitions seal each side away from the other. Humility enters as a prerequisite of precision. Read with P3, this preserves productive differentiation while exposing the cut that forgets its bond; the open sky at the end answers the blocked frame at the beginning.

whole_evidence.text: ### FT-P16 — P5: God is not a thing to argue over > God is not a thing to argue over, to believe in or deny; it is a word with many contexts, evolutions and definitions, that points somewhere no word can stand. Every word is born of difference, hold the different ones in hand; left and right run away from each other, but together master the span. We define God in terms that require no belief; we use numbers as symbols to express what words alone couldn't reach. Before All, God has always been the One, and yet we're beached, 2000+ years and the formula unimpeached. Number is the language of demonstrative proof, not age-doctored doctrines distilled from real visionary excretes. We offer a coherent and evolving account of God, one that includes it's own release; whereof one must be silent, there one shouldn't speak. And yet the essence of the project is to find the limit, so, to speak. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q016) · Extracted authorial poem. God moves from a proposed object of dispute into a word whose pointing exceeds the place words can occupy. Left and right master a span together; symbolic number enters the account, and the account includes its own release. The close turns an injunction to silence through three small pauses, so, to, speak. Those pauses make finding the limit an act of language. The historical duration and doctrinal polemic inside the verse remain Taylor's utterance; quoting the complete poem does not turn them into independently established history. ## #3 — Dated encounters and the speaker changed by speaking The journal poems return to a speaker who undergoes what he can articulate. March gives contradiction a social and bodily pressure; May develops the unnamed referent, difference and feeling; June lets a fitting form be returned. The changes happen within particular works and dates, not in an imposed developmental ranking.

whole_evidence.text: ### FT-P18 — [The scratching is the itch] > The scratching is the itch, what a stitch up! > I could see from an early age the world rearrange the way a wish cut, > such that our basic needs became the feed of our own eventual disgust, > beyond that which we discuss, > the feed stock of what makes ugly the lives, half-dead, that we live-up, > and I could never live it down, so taking to task the takedown > I did propound in my heart the twisted means by which desires abound > and thus could let one outmatch their amount, > yet I was swallowed up nonetheless, > in need of soothing my distress, > the winds of change and the naivety razed left me, despite knowing better from best, one and the same with the washing of the brain, > My failed test, another expiremental success, > Only now split within, between the kid and sin, > two hearts in one breast as the great ones did hint, > but by dint of this duality my reality did rescind - > I am blessed to know those who can hold open the door to my own way, > mostly they live in the realm that is no-way, the regions of life to which modernity has no say, > bar those whose role in the game is to curtail for their own sake. > But time has conspired to set the pot ablaze, fired to let the colours bake into the vessel of a new age, > set against and upon the stage that is built of impotences own rage, funnily enough it's saving grace. > I could lament my not having acted sooner, my having kept the cards close to my chest but then I'd have been another assumer, another reporter or truther, another speaking from, not to, distress. > Time has conspired because time is all our breathing, > and I am a bitter pill, sweet coating, relieving, > I am a symbol unbelieving, of the hauling and the heaving, > and I must be on the line if I am to bait the nourishment for our healing. > I was told today that a choice must be made between what sooths me to sleep and what let's me entrain > those very forces whose captured uptake has left the cleft wide open without the voice of the age... > And how has it left me? Returning to the same old pattern, recapitulating the stagnation > I rail against in what happens to simply be the inertia of the everyday "I must have (x)". But it's not eradication I seek, for underneath the sense of me has handed over to the action's own speech, of which my entire soul as aperture is a mouth to be breached, > and I know that what will settle is a natural mettle, and an incoussiant valuation of what takes me from my station to my peak. > But without the choice I am idle, with it I'm besseched. > It is no trite accretion of the image of the anointed, nor bland convalescence to the inversion appointed, but a true reconciliation in me of the brothers, > for how else can I become the right light unto others? [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q018) · Extracted authorial poem. The attempt to understand manufactured desire is itself swallowed by the need for soothing. The speaker's knowledge does not spare him the capture he describes. Kid and sin become two hearts in one breast; the opened door and the firing of a vessel then make a different use of the same forces imaginable. The later distinction between speaking from distress and speaking to it changes the speaker's office. Time, breath and the bitter pill bring that change toward a choice between soothing sleep and entrainment. Even after this choice appears, stagnation returns. The last movement explicitly seeks no eradication: reconciliation of the brothers within must make the speaker capable of becoming a right light to others. The final revised witness preserves this aftermath, which an excerpt ending at the kiln would lose.

The sentence first makes a differential field from the infinite and infinitesimal, then follows four first-person clauses: being the same, knowing difference, having that knowledge, and seeking sameness. The repetitions and changes of verb matter as much as the two opening quantities. Taylor's subsequent correction requires both a static and a processual reading: a thing and its thinging, definite identity and the activity through which it is specified. Multiplication carries expansive plenitude together with precise differentiation. He then calls for a second, divisional reading. The first passage must complete 0/1, its 4+2 field and 5→0 return before the inversion to 1/0 opens a full 4′+2′ and 5′→0′ passage back to 0/1. Division does not replace the original word multiplied in the verse, and the inverse half cannot be compressed into the first return. This authorial reading restores the ordered movement around the sentence; it does not declare an indeterminate product or quotient a valid calculus identity. Independent mathematical claims require the native matheme's derivation and their own mathematical conditions. **Human-amplified: yes** for the two-pass, noun/verb correction.
