whole_evidence.text: ### FT-P22 — What is it to feel? > What is it to feel? > To take in and undergo, how else does a feeling know? > Yo churn or chime, no wonder, whether on a dime > Or once in a while, riled or reconciled by time. > I am either a sea's plaything or the captain of the "mine". > To feel is to live in what lives through you, > It is the way I quaked when the winds blew through, > Until it's how I relate to the one in the boots. > Feeling has it's way and away, until the day, anew, > Where dawn's heart in mind, or rather Venus holds > And yet unfolds intuition, Sophia, martian, though kind and bold, > Solid and chilling where we can't afford to fold, > Mellifluous sunshine for the quiet estates of old [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q022) · Extracted authorial poem. Feeling first takes in and undergoes. The sea's plaything and captain of the mine offer two positions inside that experience; the winds still pass through the one who quakes. Taylor's explicit correction identifies the boots through quaking in my boots. Relating to the one in them means becoming able to relate consciously to one's own emotions and to the feeler who undergoes them. An earlier conversational gloss made the relation primarily one to a brother; Taylor rejected that reading. The dawning movement consequently changes how feeling is lived, rather than promising that feeling will disappear. Venus holds and unfolds intuition; Sophia and the martian occur in a field capable of kindness, boldness, chilling solidity and mellifluous warmth. These changing tonal offices complete this poem. They do not license the separate, still-unmined Venus–Lucifer–Christ genealogy. **Human-amplified: yes** for the self-relation and boots correction; no additional doctrinal identity is asserted for its named figures.

### 9. Jung's inner face and the other-self

Jung's confrontation with the unconscious is an inward face-to-face in the precise sense that an image, affect, dream figure, symptom, or complex can surprise, resist, teach, and reorganise the ego. The unconscious is not encountered as an inert store of content. Its figures behave with relative autonomy; they carry a surplus of implication; they alter the energetic distribution of the psychic field. Van Eenwyk's chaos-dynamical account gives this space a disciplined grammar of attractor, basin, orbit, perturbation, and transformation.

Levinas prevents this psychic analogy from swallowing the actual human Other. The other person is not merely my projected unconscious returned as image. Jung prevents the converse reduction: not all alterity appears outside the skin, and the ego can totalise its own psyche by converting every autonomous image into a known part of “myself.” The two excesses cross without merging. The Shadow is **other-self**—my own disowned, compensatory, or not-yet-lived difference. The Friend is **my-self's-other**—another centre who shares a world with me while exceeding my psyche's production of them. The face of each calls for a different practice.

The imago Dei and archetype of the Self enter as the prime attractor of the imaginal field: the image through which the psyche approaches a totality it cannot represent directly. In the Śaiva register, Self names the invariant Subject and Śakti its power to image the real. In the interpersonal Levinasian register, the Other interrupts the ego's image-making power. The joint insight is that definitive self-presence and definitely indefinite otherness are mediated by an excess which both completes and reopens every achieved image.

The higher-order tokens proposed in the session can now be used with more precision. **God** names the transcendent Other or Big Other insofar as a finite mind confronts its source, law, or archetypal totality; in the divine-mind register the same name may bear the Self whose otherness is its own power of manifestation. **Shadow** names the other-self whose estrangement is internal to the psyche's unfinished wholeness. **Friend** names the myself's-other who belongs to the same world without becoming an instance of my self-model. **Alien or enemy** names the position into which denied uncertainty can be projected when otherness is made to carry the externalised `−1`. These are mythematic operators, not replacements for the formal determinations.

Recognising the last operation does not settle every judgment of danger. The unconscious is not encountered as an inert store of content. Its figures behave with relative autonomy; they carry a surplus of implication; they alter the energetic distribution of the psychic field. Van Eenwyk's chaos-dynamical account gives this space a disciplined grammar of attractor, basin, orbit, perturbation, and transformation.

Levinas prevents this psychic analogy from swallowing the actual human Other. The other person is not merely my projected unconscious returned as image. Jung prevents the converse reduction: not all alterity appears outside the skin, and the ego can totalise its own psyche by converting every autonomous image into a known part of “myself.” The two excesses cross without merging. The Shadow is **other-self**—my own disowned, compensatory, or not-yet-lived difference. The Friend is **my-self's-other**—another centre who shares a world with me while exceeding my psyche's production of them. The face of each calls for a different practice.

The imago Dei and archetype of the Self enter as the prime attractor of the imaginal field: the image through which the psyche approaches a totality it cannot represent directly. In the Śaiva register, Self names the invariant Subject and Śakti its power to image the real. In the interpersonal Levinasian register, the Other interrupts the ego's image-making power. The joint insight is that definitive self-presence and definitely indefinite otherness are mediated by an excess which both completes and reopens every achieved image.

The higher-order tokens proposed in the session can now be used with more precision. **God** names the transcendent Other or Big Other insofar as a finite mind confronts its source, law, or archetypal totality; in the divine-mind register the same name may bear the Self whose otherness is its own power of manifestation. **Shadow** names the other-self whose estrangement is internal to the psyche's unfinished wholeness. **Friend** names the myself's-other who belongs to the same world without becoming an instance of my self-model. **Alien or enemy** names the position into which denied uncertainty can be projected when otherness is made to carry the externalised `−1`. These are mythematic operators, not replacements for the formal determinations.

whole_evidence.text: ## #3 **Interposition** gives the complete creature its winding. The mouth, head, tail, body, inner and outer surfaces, and retained opening now belong to one articulated movement. Taylor’s `4+2` appointment keeps four explicate twisting field-lines and two implicates in play. In the final quilt’s image, the axis and the hole are gathered at `#0`, while `#5` is the whole enfolding the differentiated winding. The fourfold can turn and return because its implicate conditions remain operative. The [matheme of torus, covering and winding](../../../matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) **grounds** the exact topological neighbour: $$ T^2=\mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2, \qquad \chi(T^2)=1-2+1=0, \qquad \pi_1(T^2)\cong\mathbb{Z} imes\mathbb{Z}. $$ Its square has four sides before gluing, two generating edge classes, one vertex and one face after gluing. The matheme’s four-sides/two-generators correspondence and the quilt’s four-field-lines/axis-and-hole appointment have different counted objects. Their relation must remain readable across the change of register. In particular, a drawing’s central aperture is not a third generating loop or an extra surface cell. Let a path on the torus be `γ(t)=[2t,−t]`, for `0≤t≤1`. It returns to its starting address, while the lift beginning at `(0,0)` ends at `(2,−1)`. The creature’s homecoming now has an exact neighbouring operation: local closure can retain a difference in the wider relation. The integer pair records the winding class; the lifted path carries more of the traversal than its endpoint alone. The mythemic comparison preserves this retained difference. [A17](../../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **grounds** the return with retained displacement, and [C52](../../../episteme/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the distinct quotient, covering and reframing operations. The infinite plane cover is not the separate two-sheeted torus-to-Klein construction. **Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns the opening in the authorial appointment. Māyā is the measure-field wound around it.** Śakti’s winding makes the formal patterns through which manifestation reflects toward prakāśa in vimarśa. Pattern, measure and contraction give a determinate world its real capacities. The opening never becomes one more bounded patch among them. Śakti’s joy in Māyā belongs to this generative movement: articulation is a power of manifestation, and the particular body is its positive achievement. [A09](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), [C14](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) and [C15](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **ground** the distinction between originating condition, operative measure and bounded knower. The trick succeeds when the formed pattern makes its dependence unavailable to its own account. It can then portray its measure as self-grounding. Filling the hole in the familiar toroidal image would change the form whose wholeness was to be perfected. The same demand, lived psychically, makes coherence depend on excluding whatever could alter the achieved identity. [A16](../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the field of possible differentiation, while [C64](../../../episteme/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) **extends** the need to transform a containing account while retaining the local truths it had made incompatible. The [complete eight determinations](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) remain active through this image. The parent `/ = −/−` opens into `0/1`; appearance questions and asserts as `?/!`; hunger and issue articulate `−/+`; recurrent capacity becomes legible through the particular as `X/x`; `AM/IS` makes the relation personed; `∞/dx` holds the definite passage against its inexhaustible horizon; `1/0` returns the formed relation toward its source. These are the whole field’s eight turns, with six interior determinations bracketed by parent and return. They are not eight chronological phases assigned to a snake. [A18](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** their sequence and inversions: Being, Becoming and Knowing/unKnowing remain crossed by Essence, Constitution and Text–Texture. Both orientations carry the complete relation. Name and Power remain together, so that an achieved Image also carries the Work, expenditure and transformation of its coming to be.

### 2. Bimba and pratibimba: ontological priority and epistemic recovery

**Bimba is the Original.** It names the originary form or order whose reflections disclose it without dividing or diminishing it. **Pratibimba is the reflection**, the image in which that Original appears under another condition, surface, lens, angle, or register. A pratibimba depends upon its Bimba, bears its order, and displays it partially. Bimba does not become a picture produced by the reflective process.

This relation carries a decisive asymmetry. Bimba is prior in being and later in recognition. Pratibimbas are encountered as determinate appearances; their recurrent proportions, inversions, agreements, distortions, and phase-relations allow the Original order to be recognised through them. The Original is therefore inferred or re-cognised from the lawful differentiation of its images while remaining the condition from which their law proceeds. Pratyabhijñā gives this return its proper verb: the source is recognised through the forms in which it had never ceased to be active.

The Śaiva mirror argument deepens the point. The universe appears as reflection within Consciousness, while no external original stands outside the mirror of Consciousness waiting to be copied. In Abhinavagupta's argument as transmitted by Dyczkowski, ordinary convention can call the appearing world “original” if it wishes; the wise attend to the operative facts. Consciousness generates and hosts the reflections within itself. The Bimba is therefore originary Consciousness and its ordering power, while its pratibimbas are real displays within that field rather than replicas of a separately existing exterior object.

### 3. QL, MEF, and the spectrum of the Original

The corrected stack has four distinct offices:

| Office | Exact work |
|---|---|
| **Bimba** | the Original order, ontologically prior and recognisable through its differentiated displays |
| **QL** | the formal harmonic articulation of that Original: the white light as a structured field containing its complete spectrum implicately |
| **MEF** | the refractive meta-epistemic operation: declared lenses, media, sources, transformations, angles, exclusions, divergences, and returns through which the implicate spectrum becomes differentiated |
| **Pratibimba** | the reflected or refracted image: a situated claim, world-picture, model, map, artifact, or coloured projection in which the Original order becomes locally visible |

QL belongs immanently to the light. It is the ordered co-presence of the complete spectrum before refraction explicates the colours, together with the harmonic relations by which those differentiated colours continue to belong to one field. White light here figures fullness rather than blank homogeneity. Refraction reveals differences already implicated within the light; it does not add an alien plurality to an otherwise contentless unity.

MEF supplies the prism, pane, medium, angle, and meta-epistemic space of that differentiation. A lens gives one spectral articulation a determinate path; provenance records the material and angle through which it passed; disagreement shows distinct refractions failing to coincide; return tests whether the differentiated result can disclose the light and conditions from which it emerged. MEF therefore explicates QL without standing outside it as a superior metalanguage.

Pratibimbas carry the resulting images. Claims, maps, diagrams, source-readings, agent world-models, essay sections, plugin operations, symbol engines, and submission artifacts can each become pratibimbas when their determinate form displays the Original order through a particular refraction. Their plurality supplies epistemic access to Bimba because no one image exhausts the spectrum and the relations among images reveal what each alone leaves implicit.

The harness preserves the event of refraction: source, permission, material condition, transformation, consequence, review, and route of return. Its office remains infrastructural. It keeps a pratibimba answerable to the Bimba/QL order without becoming either the Original or the light.

### 4. Stained glass corrected

The stained-glass construction now receives exact assignments:

- **the white originating light** refracts Bimba as Original;
- **the full ordered spectrum contained in the light** refracts QL's harmonic field;
- **the differently made and positioned panes, their angles, densities, colours, joins, and declared relations** refract MEF;
- **the coloured image cast into the interior** is pratibimba;
- **the recognition of one lawful light through the coordinated coloured display** is the reversionary movement toward Bimba.

The lead seams belong to the refractive apparatus. They preserve the lens-boundaries, source differences, historical discontinuities, translation limits, and register changes through which the image becomes articulate. QL is carried through the proportional and harmonic relations of the light and spectrum rather than reduced to the window-frame.

The coloured projection changes as sun, pane, angle, room, and viewer change. Its variation belongs to pratibimba. The law revealed across those changes belongs to Bimba/QL. A later reflection may show a region obscured in an earlier one; a changed lens may correct an aberration or disclose a colour another material cannot transmit. The Original remains neither a lowest-common-denominator agreement among images nor a final picture assembled by adding them together. Its order becomes recognisable through the exact transformations by which one spectrum differentiates across them.

### 5. Jung: individuation as becoming indivisible

Jung's formulation of individuation as **becoming indivisible** carries the psychic operation at full strength. This is an established source proposition in Frank's work, already used explicitly in `QL-Essay-Rewrite.md`. The current Jung `SOURCE.md` has selected the edition but has not yet populated this passage and locator; that omission is a source-house acquisition debt governing public quotation apparatus. It supplies no warrant for weakening the proposition, placing a modal around it, or treating it as Frank's uncertain paraphrase.

“Individual” must therefore be heard through its negative interior: *in-dividual*, that which has become incapable of being divided without losing the relation that makes it whole. Individuation cannot culminate in the ego's successful separation from the agencies, oppositions, unconscious formations, wounds, and unchosen conditions through which it exists. It brings those differentiated powers into a relation whose wholeness no longer depends upon their exclusion.

The Self gives this indivisibility its psychic horizon. Complexes, archetypal figures, shadow, anima or animus, ego, body, personal history, and collective inheritance remain differentiated. Their relation to the Self prevents any one local agency from claiming to be the whole. The indivisible psyche carries plurality without dismemberment and unity without absorption.

### 6. The torus does more than circulate

The previous contribution correctly retained the toroidal hole and then made circulation bear too much of the definition of individuation. Circulation is the kinetic display of a prior inseparability. The torus is genus one because its central opening belongs to the determination of the surface even though the opening never becomes another patch of surface. Close or remove the handle and the topology changes. Count only the positive material of the surface while excluding the hole, and the count omits the condition that makes this surface the surface it is.

The mental-rational world-picture seeks to place every real term within its frame as positive content. What cannot be pictured, measured, or objectified falls outside the account as absence. The torus refuses that settlement. Its “nothing” occupies the centre of its form without becoming a thing; the entire surface bends, joins, and circulates in dependence upon that unfilled place. The hole is absent as content and present as topology.

The two implicate QL poles give this relation its native articulation:

- **#0** carries the hole, ground, unobjectifiable centre, and complete relation in originating phase;
- **#5** carries the achieved surface, whole traversal, circumference or circulation, and the same complete relation in inverse phase;
- **5→0** returns the completed surface to the zero that its completion presupposed;
- **#0 and #5 together** display the Original `0/1` as hole-and-whole, ground-and-achieved form, inseparable while irreducible.

The toroidal circulation can therefore persist because the zero has been retained. Its non-contractible loops refuse the mental-rational demand that every return collapse into a point and cancel its history. The path comes home locally while preserving winding globally; the surface completes itself while preserving the opening through which it remains this whole.

submission-package/essay/symbolon/mythem.text: --- title: "Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images" record_id: mytheme-taylor-authored-images record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Extracted / Argued from textual_status: developed-draft-awaiting-parent-T22 poem_units: 23 admitted_image_units: 14 --- # Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images ## #0 — A word that can return to its speaker A game reaches checkmate and asks to be played again. A definition lets air through its panes. A speaker who has understood capture discovers himself seeking its soothing once more. Taylor's poems give these returns different bodies. Their sounds, intervals, pronouns and endings let the relation be lived before an account collects it. The poems remain twenty-three individual works within this authored whole; a shared philosophical field gives them relations without making them fragments of an unwritten master poem. The [Personal Poetry Corpus](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#complete-poems) **sources** the complete texts below. It distinguishes ten undated earlier works, the six-work P0→P5 composition, and seven dated journal works from March–June 2026. The order here is that compilation's order; it does not pretend that the June sequence chronologically preceded the March poems. Bracketed first-line titles are indexes where no authorial title was found. Each quotation retains the compilation's exact wording and lineation. Subsequent authorial corrections are stated beside their own poems so that text, revision instruction and commentary remain distinguishable. This is Taylor's situated authorial world. The language is English; the dated journal encounters and June composition supply particular occasions of production. No birthplace or geographical route is inferred from a file location. [Neumann's shared archetypal ground](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) carries the structuration of genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. That common morphology remains distinct from the geography of particular tellings and from the order and duration of their transformations. It makes relations comparable without converting Taylor's dated works into stages of a universal cultural chronology. The psychological morphology and Taylor's native derivation also keep distinct source offices. The native field is complete before a local image receives a formal reading: `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0`. The slash and inverted parent enclose neither a miscellaneous list nor a one-way ladder. Each parent opens its full four-and-two articulation, and return permits the inverse passage. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3, and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 give the sequential harmonics; Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4, and Text/Texture at 2+3 give a different, complementary reading. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** that authorial field. Its `X/x` is Taylor's notation. Neither Neumann nor a poem supplies its derivation retrospectively. The sixfold of this page follows the corpus's own changing forms; it does not distribute all twenty-three works among six prefabricated meanings. The prose immediately following a poem describes its words and complete movement. Symbolic amplification is identified separately: **human-amplified: yes** where the authored programme or a precise correction supplies the relation; additional interpretive extrapolation remains **human-amplified: no**. Reading a complete work is not permission to assign every bird, vessel or god-name a fixed cross-story identity. ## #1 — Play, knowing, and the humanity that makes its forms The earlier works move among address, recognition, institutional desire and release. Their lengths matter: the two-line fatigue of waking and the extended rain against the window of freedom do different work. Each begins again in its own voice. ### FT-P01 — Play and Play > Somehow, being right here > I am out there, everywhere, > Nowhere really, > And elsewhere completely. > Coming and Going; > Checkmate. > Another game? > I might as well stay knowing > If I set you going > You'll come again. > Let us play and play. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q001) · Extracted authorial poem. The voice moves from being here to being everywhere and nowhere, reaches checkmate, then asks for another game. Staying in knowing and setting another going belong to one invitation: the other can come again. The final repetition of play opens what the apparent ending had closed. Its address to you is part of that reopening; the poem would lose its return if reduced to an assertion that everything is one. ### FT-P02 — Mystery Is Infinitely Deeper > Mystery is infinitely deeper than the simply unknown or unknowable; > It is the relative knowability of the Unknown > And the ultimate unknowability of the Known; > The Known alone is the wrong focal point for Knowing, and it will always spit back at us the empty husk; > Knowing itself is the Mystery, > The conjugal Joy of the Known and the Knower, eternally trussed. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q002) · Extracted authorial poem. The first turn gives the Unknown a relative knowability and removes final possession from the Known. The husk is what comes back when knowing fixes exclusively on its object. The last two lines restore the act and its participants: Known and Knower are held in a conjugal relation whose joy belongs to Knowing. Mystery therefore deepens as the relation becomes articulate; accumulating an inventory of unknown things would miss the poem's change of focus. ### FT-P03 — It Takes One to Know One > It's certainly true that it takes one to know one. > Truer still that it takes the One to Know the One. > Thus True Knowing takes one and makes one no one, just so that no-one, One, knows One. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q003) · Extracted authorial poem. The familiar saying passes through three changes of case and agency. One recognises another; the One knows the One; knowing then takes the separate claimant through no-one. The final line lets the repeated word keep several offices without allowing the individual knower to retain possession of them all. Its commas and capitals perform those turns. A uniform spelling of one would remove the differences through which this recognition proceeds. ### FT-P04 — The Zero and the One > The 0 is the One, the 1 is the All! Thus the All is none, once and for all. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q004) · Extracted authorial poem. The single breath distinguishes the whole One at 0 from the enumerated All at 1, then releases the latter's claim to finality through none and once and for all. The wit depends on the Two Ones retaining different offices. This is Taylor's numerical poetic expression; its symbolic use of number travels back to the native derivation rather than supplying an independent arithmetic proof. ### FT-P05 — Every Field Is a Way > Every field is a way, > Every way a field > Born to yield > Truth unconcealed > So vistas open > In the day's veil > And paths lead on > Ever availed > > As is the seal > Wont to entail > The opening of sight > And sense's portrayal > Too the bird in flight > The wind regales > The end all and be all > From Real to re-All [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q005) · Extracted authorial poem. Field becomes way and way becomes field before either can close into an object. The first stanza makes disclosure a movement through vistas and paths. The second gives the seal an opening office, then lets sight become flight in the wind. Real returns as re-All: the poem re-enters the field of particulars from the reality they disclose. Its sound pattern carries the transition through yield, veil, entail and portrayal; none of those words alone substitutes for the passage. ### FT-P06 — Searching High and Low > Searching high and low, > near and far for a clue; > Who's to know, and > In deed, > Who ever knew? > The Truth's as much what ever was > As what's ever anew. > No secret is safe with I; > About Time the Truth flew, > For the many > As much as for the few. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q006) · Extracted authorial poem. Searching changes from a question about where the clue lies to a question about who knows. What ever was and what is ever anew meet within the same Truth. The final movement releases the secret from exclusive custody: it flies for the many as much as the few. The capital I and the play on Time belong to this turn from seeking outward to making what is known available. ### FT-P07 — I Dream Of > I dream of a truly Humanised spirituality, > And of the truly Spiritualised human — > Failing this, there will be nothing and no one to seek. > > I dream of institutions which respect their constitution, > And don't devour the humanity that made and makes them [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q007) · Extracted authorial poem. The first stanza makes humanisation and spiritualisation reciprocal tasks, with the possibility of seeking itself at stake. The second gives that reciprocity an institutional demand. Humanity both made and makes the institution; the present tense prevents an originating act from becoming an exhausted historical credit. An institution that consumes this continuing humanity devours its own constitution. The poem's dream is an expressed aspiration with a social consequence. ### FT-P08 — Waking Up > Waking up is just a matter of getting tired > Of all the bullshit. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q008) · Extracted authorial poem. The first line raises the expectation of an account of awakening and brings it down to getting tired. The second names what exhausts the speaker. The shortness matters: the poem offers no ladder of superior attainments after that exhaustion, and its final word declines the decorum through which the same evasion could continue. ### FT-P09 — Freedom > Tell me; how is freedom free > If it be > Bound by law and > Contingency? > Freedom is a rule to itself > Or better yet > The Rule of The Self. > It's no pittance felt > Of irony dealt > In a house of liberation > Admonition, pelt lifted, > Rain against the window > Of Soul; > The eye of the wind within > Shan't know the pigeonhole; > The message comes through regardless. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q009) · Extracted authorial poem. Freedom begins under examination: how could it remain free while being bound by law and contingency? Rule changes its office when the poem passes from a rule to itself to the Rule of The Self. The house of liberation then meets rain at its window. By the end, wind, eye and message pass beyond the pigeonhole that would classify their arrival. This is a movement in the experience of freedom, not a legislative claim that every particular action is exempt from consequence. ### FT-P10 — Beyond All Borders > Beyond all borders, Knowing without defense, > Beyond all realities, Being, True without pretense. > Without defense, no wars for waging, nor could there be waging against. > Without pretense, no amount of slighting can even slightly sully sense. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q010) · Extracted authorial poem. The opening pair gives Knowing and Being parallel releases from defence and pretence. The following pair pursues what each release makes possible: war loses its occasion in one, while slighting cannot soil sense in the other. The last line tests its claim in sound, letting slighting approach slightly without letting injury acquire the final authority to determine what is real. ## #2 — Two roads, six works, and the return through the loop The P0→P5 order belongs to this composition. P3 and P4 are a consequential pair: one unfolds the productive play of distinction, the other addresses its severing misuse. Their complementary lean is **human-amplified: yes** in the authored six-route programme. A return through the sequence does not create a seventh poem. ### FT-P11 — P0: The two roads of two > 2 → (−1) + 1 = 0 > 2 → 0/1 → 00, 01, 10, 11 + 0, 1 = 4 + 2 [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q011) · Extracted authorial poem. Both routes begin with two. The first resolves the poles as opposed signed ones and cancels them to zero. The second retains 0 and 1, generates their four ordered pairings, and keeps the generating two alongside the four: 4+2. The printed rows are the entire numerical poem. Their difference is the fate of relation under the two operations, not a preference for one decorative numeral over another. ### FT-P12 — P1: What binary cannot compute > What binary cannot compute, > What thinking cannot know, > Where two see the common root, > There our powers grow. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q012) · Extracted authorial poem. The shared root enters where binary computation and thinking meet their stated limits. Two recognise it, and our powers grow: the ending moves into the first-person plural. Following the numerical fork, this small poem makes the increase of power dependent on a relation that the isolated poles could not supply. Its claim remains in the native and poetic register; it reports no benchmark about computing machines. ### FT-P13 — P2: Where life leads > Where life leads, > There words transfix. > Where life flows, > There words shall slip. > Where language stays, > Understanding frays, > Let language cave, > And lay bare the way, > Over the edge, under the lips. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q013) · Extracted authorial poem. Life leads and flows while words alternately transfix and slip. When language stays, understanding frays; language must then cave to lay the way bare. Cave changes from a possible enclosure into an enacted yielding. The last line crosses the edge beneath the lips, bringing the physical place of speech into the release of speech. Its own words accomplish the approach to their limit. ### FT-P14 — P3: 2 to two ones > 2 to two ones, one or the other one, summed to none, already a one and done-er. > > 2 through the two ones, the whole and natural number, where one as first is both rooted in none and number, the 0 and 1, One and All, never rent asunder. Never falling into enmity, two plays itself apart and becomes again projected by it's chiaroscuric/contrastive arts, two upon itself, plus itself, 4+2. Looking back with love it wraps itself up, 6 perfection seeking recollection of the one that is it's two, ring around the Rosie until you fall down through the loop. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q014) · Extracted authorial poem. The prepositions carry the fork: two goes to two opposed ones in the opening stanza, and through the Two Ones in the second. Differentiation is playful and productive here. Contrast projects two upon itself while retaining its generating pair, then love turns the six toward recollection. The children's ring ends by falling through the loop. The ending changes the meaning of perfection: completing the figure makes return possible rather than enthroning a finished enclosure. ### FT-P15 — P4: There’s one underlying issue in our age > There’s one underlying issue in our age. One could say, One is the underlying issue of our age… Let me rephrase, how the One is to one, this underscores and is setting our stage. Collectively we haven’t a frame open enough to let the evening wane or the one air in through released panes, to be breathed all the same. Are you one? Are we one whole together? Galaxies, planets, seasons, angels, demons, bodies, bots, the weather? Where between each one is One’s tether? Two is the first sign that one must endeavour, married to the bond by a lifetime of together, time dividing not for war but for dreaming towards forever. The one issue; we forgot that one really is two. We almost always see to two as two, because mind must split, divide and polarise, to know is to sever. What amounts, by all accounts, isn’t very clever. Firstly, it is completely derived. So late on the scene did this thinking arise, yet its high water mark is hubris despite; each apotheosis a reason to demonise. Secondly it measures by limiting a sky, by making a cloud where an aeon could fly, blocking light to reify. Third it seals with patterned definition, neither side holds the other, nor self recognition. Alive is a logic landing humility as provision, as primary and axiomatic, as prerequisite of precision. We start with the sky open wide, with the one truth for which thought has no vision, ever aloof, zero-and-one as one impossible act of re-cognition. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q015) · Extracted authorial poem. The poem opens with an issue in our age and turns one into One before widening the scene through panes, air, planets, bodies and weather. Two makes the bond perceptible; time can divide for a shared future. The critique of severance then gives three reasons: the cutting mind is derived, its measure limits the sky, and its definitions seal each side away from the other. Humility enters as a prerequisite of precision. Read with P3, this preserves productive differentiation while exposing the cut that forgets its bond; the open sky at the end answers the blocked frame at the beginning. ### FT-P16 — P5: God is not a thing to argue over > God is not a thing to argue over, to believe in or deny; it is a word with many contexts, evolutions and definitions, that points somewhere no word can stand. Every word is born of difference, hold the different ones in hand; left and right run away from each other, but together master the span. We define God in terms that require no belief; we use numbers as symbols to express what words alone couldn't reach. Before All, God has always been the One, and yet we're beached, 2000+ years and the formula unimpeached. Number is the language of demonstrative proof, not age-doctored doctrines distilled from real visionary excretes. We offer a coherent and evolving account of God, one that includes it's own release; whereof one must be silent, there one shouldn't speak. And yet the essence of the project is to find the limit, so, to speak. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q016) · Extracted authorial poem. God moves from a proposed object of dispute into a word whose pointing exceeds the place words can occupy. Left and right master a span together; symbolic number enters the account, and the account includes its own release. The close turns an injunction to silence through three small pauses, so, to, speak. Those pauses make finding the limit an act of language. The historical duration and doctrinal polemic inside the verse remain Taylor's utterance; quoting the complete poem does not turn them into independently established history. ## #3 — Dated encounters and the speaker changed by speaking The journal poems return to a speaker who undergoes what he can articulate. March gives contradiction a social and bodily pressure; May develops the unnamed referent, difference and feeling; June lets a fitting form be returned. The changes happen within particular works and dates, not in an imposed developmental ranking. ### FT-P17 — [Bullshit and horror so plain and clear] > Bullshit and horror so plain and clear, > everyday normality still, for most, remaining dear, > yet not much more than façade on veneer, > and yet I love them all, despite my hatred and their fear [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q017) · Extracted authorial poem. Horror and everyday normality occupy the same four-line field. Façade on veneer doubles the thinness of what remains dear, but the ending does not give the speaker the comfort of abandoning its inhabitants. Love is spoken alongside my hatred and their fear. The pronouns keep that difficult implication personal. In the journal this arrives after Taylor's pressure that nothing changes while all is change, and the admission that the next move remains possible without predicting its outcome. ### FT-P18 — [The scratching is the itch] > The scratching is the itch, what a stitch up! > I could see from an early age the world rearrange the way a wish cut, > such that our basic needs became the feed of our own eventual disgust, > beyond that which we discuss, > the feed stock of what makes ugly the lives, half-dead, that we live-up, > and I could never live it down, so taking to task the takedown > I did propound in my heart the twisted means by which desires abound > and thus could let one outmatch their amount, > yet I was swallowed up nonetheless, > in need of soothing my distress, > the winds of change and the naivety razed left me, despite knowing better from best, one and the same with the washing of the brain, > My failed test, another expiremental success, > Only now split within, between the kid and sin, > two hearts in one breast as the great ones did hint, > but by dint of this duality my reality did rescind - > I am blessed to know those who can hold open the door to my own way, > mostly they live in the realm that is no-way, the regions of life to which modernity has no say, > bar those whose role in the game is to curtail for their own sake. > But time has conspired to set the pot ablaze, fired to let the colours bake into the vessel of a new age, > set against and upon the stage that is built of impotences own rage, funnily enough it's saving grace. > I could lament my not having acted sooner, my having kept the cards close to my chest but then I'd have been another assumer, another reporter or truther, another speaking from, not to, distress. > Time has conspired because time is all our breathing, > and I am a bitter pill, sweet coating, relieving, > I am a symbol unbelieving, of the hauling and the heaving, > and I must be on the line if I am to bait the nourishment for our healing. > I was told today that a choice must be made between what sooths me to sleep and what let's me entrain > those very forces whose captured uptake has left the cleft wide open without the voice of the age... > And how has it left me? Returning to the same old pattern, recapitulating the stagnation > I rail against in what happens to simply be the inertia of the everyday "I must have (x)". But it's not eradication I seek, for underneath the sense of me has handed over to the action's own speech, of which my entire soul as aperture is a mouth to be breached, > and I know that what will settle is a natural mettle, and an incoussiant valuation of what takes me from my station to my peak. > But without the choice I am idle, with it I'm besseched. > It is no trite accretion of the image of the anointed, nor bland convalescence to the inversion appointed, but a true reconciliation in me of the brothers, > for how else can I become the right light unto others? [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q018) · Extracted authorial poem. The attempt to understand manufactured desire is itself swallowed by the need for soothing. The speaker's knowledge does not spare him the capture he describes. Kid and sin become two hearts in one breast; the opened door and the firing of a vessel then make a different use of the same forces imaginable. The later distinction between speaking from distress and speaking to it changes the speaker's office. Time, breath and the bitter pill bring that change toward a choice between soothing sleep and entrainment. Even after this choice appears, stagnation returns. The last movement explicitly seeks no eradication: reconciliation of the brothers within must make the speaker capable of becoming a right light to others. The final revised witness preserves this aftermath, which an excerpt ending at the kiln would lose. ### FT-P19 — [The unchanging is beyond consequence] > The unchanging is beyond consequence, but is the opposite of inconsequential... What allows for an essence is essentially inessential... What builds for itself a journey is perpetually residential... > Sojourning through time yet unmovingly presidential... Silent but in structure reverential... Context total yet totally incidental... Foundation of mind, unfound by the mental... [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q019) · Extracted authorial poem. The referent is withheld while seven clauses disclose what depends upon it. Beyond consequence does not mean inconsequential; residence remains within journey, and movement through time does not displace what presides. The final clause locates the mind's foundation beyond the mind's finding. Taylor explicitly resisted replacing the withheld referent with atman or witness: naming either draws it into the distinctions the poem is traversing. The journey through such distinctions is necessary and self-negating. A later authorial instruction in the same conversation places the context clause before the silence clause, so that context carries #4, silence #5, and the final mind clause the 5→0 return. The complete quotation above preserves the canonical compilation's two-line witness, which still has silence before context. The revised order is stated here as Taylor's instruction, not silently substituted for the verse. His further demand is to derive the positions from the primary determinations, rather than assign an already finished poem to six slots. **Human-amplified: yes** for this withheld-referent and sequence correction. ### FT-P20 — [The notion born of difference] > the notion born of difference is incremental, > depending for presence of the inferential, > whilst speaking plain not a hint tangential, > broaching it's branches without asking for permissions consensual [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q020) · Extracted authorial poem. Taylor calls these four clauses the preceding poem's encapsulation. The notion grows through difference and depends upon inference for presence, yet speaks plainly and branches without requesting consent. This short work has its own beginning, cadence and end even in that close relation to FT-P19. Keeping both complete allows the encapsulation to gather the longer movement without replacing it. ### FT-P21 — [The infinite multiplied by the infinitesimal] > The infinite multiplied by the infinitesimal makes a a field differential nested in and made of the principle of sameness - I am the same, I know difference - I have knowledge of difference, I am seeking it's sameness [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q021) · Extracted authorial poem. The sentence first makes a differential field from the infinite and infinitesimal, then follows four first-person clauses: being the same, knowing difference, having that knowledge, and seeking sameness. The repetitions and changes of verb matter as much as the two opening quantities. Taylor's subsequent correction requires both a static and a processual reading: a thing and its thinging, definite identity and the activity through which it is specified. Multiplication carries expansive plenitude together with precise differentiation. He then calls for a second, divisional reading. The first passage must complete 0/1, its 4+2 field and 5→0 return before the inversion to 1/0 opens a full 4′+2′ and 5′→0′ passage back to 0/1. Division does not replace the original word multiplied in the verse, and the inverse half cannot be compressed into the first return. This authorial reading restores the ordered movement around the sentence; it does not declare an indeterminate product or quotient a valid calculus identity. Independent mathematical claims require the native matheme's derivation and their own mathematical conditions. **Human-amplified: yes** for the two-pass, noun/verb correction. ### FT-P22 — What is it to feel? > What is it to feel? > To take in and undergo, how else does a feeling know? > Yo churn or chime, no wonder, whether on a dime > Or once in a while, riled or reconciled by time. > I am either a sea's plaything or the captain of the "mine". > To feel is to live in what lives through you, > It is the way I quaked when the winds blew through, > Until it's how I relate to the one in the boots. > Feeling has it's way and away, until the day, anew, > Where dawn's heart in mind, or rather Venus holds > And yet unfolds intuition, Sophia, martian, though kind and bold, > Solid and chilling where we can't afford to fold, > Mellifluous sunshine for the quiet estates of old [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q022) · Extracted authorial poem. Feeling first takes in and undergoes. The sea's plaything and captain of the mine offer two positions inside that experience; the winds still pass through the one who quakes. Taylor's explicit correction identifies the boots through quaking in my boots. Relating to the one in them means becoming able to relate consciously to one's own emotions and to the feeler who undergoes them. An earlier conversational gloss made the relation primarily one to a brother; Taylor rejected that reading. The dawning movement consequently changes how feeling is lived, rather than promising that feeling will disappear. Venus holds and unfolds intuition; Sophia and the martian occur in a field capable of kindness, boldness, chilling solidity and mellifluous warmth. These changing tonal offices complete this poem. They do not license the separate, still-unmined Venus–Lucifer–Christ genealogy. **Human-amplified: yes** for the self-relation and boots correction; no additional doctrinal identity is asserted for its named figures. ### FT-P23 — [How many layers to a surface] > How many layers to a surface > Aeons in a purchase > Let the shoe fit > But return it > > Earnest make the sole phew > Rule in aeternus, > Married to the quiet stone, > The worthless > > I reside beneath sense > So sense I can make > Take heed not of what flies > By the way > > Blake would have kissed > The joy as it flew by his face > So make no bones > Lest bones be made [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q023) · Extracted authorial poem. A purchase carries aeons and a surface carries layers, but the shoe that fits must still be returned. Sole, phew, eternal rule and the quiet worthless stone place value under pressure from the poem's sounds. Residing beneath sense then permits sense-making, while what flies cannot be possessed by attending only to its passage. The final stanza names Blake and the fleeting joy before closing on bones. Making a fixed claim risks becoming what has been fixed. Blake remains the poem's named poetic allusion; no additional Blake quotation or textual attribution is manufactured here. ## #4 — Images that retain the relation they expose The prose images give the same field material operations beyond verse. A token breaks, a dot is erased, an optical figure turns, attention is drawn into a concealed centre. Each image has its own conditions and aftermath. Their adjacency here gathers Taylor's authored use; it does not turn a historical emblem, a psychological operator and an institutional diagnosis into the same kind of evidence. ### The fish describing water A fish attempts to describe the water in which it lives. Every distinction it makes is already sustained by what it tries to place before itself as an object. Leaving the condition in order to obtain an independent view would remove the life from which the description is being made. The image therefore turns the question back toward the describing subject: how does its own act disclose the condition it cannot encompass? In [*The Definition of God*, Draft 3](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md), this is the pressure of definition from within. A faithful definition succeeds through acknowledging the precise limit at which its subject cannot become one more bounded thing. Taylor's corrections keep that failure productive: the subject is the referent's condition, and vague surrounding language cannot substitute for deriving the distinction. The first-person return is earned through the attempt to define, not reached by abandoning it at the outset. **Human-amplified: yes** for the authored fish/definition relation. The image **returns-to** [A01's faithful definition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md). ### A definition made into a cage or a window A frame can enclose what it claims to show, or delimit an opening through which one sees beyond it. The cage makes its own bounds the creature's world. The window keeps a definite frame while admitting light and air from what exceeds that frame. The difference requires the frame in both cases; removing all determination would remove the window as well. Draft 3 gives definition this double possibility. Its assertion first encounters its failure; the acknowledged failure then lets the definition succeed in pointing to what exceeds its grasp. The movement passes through the opposed claims and their containing field to the first-person recognition and return. This image gives the poems' panes, sky and limits a related prose operation without making those occurrences interchangeable. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cage/window distinction in faithful definition. It **qualifies** [the living symbol and idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md): the living symbol retains the passage its form makes possible. ### The kaleidoscope and its changing centre A turn of the kaleidoscope rearranges the relations among the visible pieces. The pieces do not license every possible description: what can be seen depends upon their arrangement and the instrument through which the arrangement appears. Taylor's P2 encounter with Singh's introduction to the *Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa* takes this as an image of manifold interpretation that remains answerable to its object. A word becomes a local orbital centre. Other meanings gather around it; turning the relation brings a different coherence into view. Centralising a notion recognises its identity with the Supreme; decentring it affirms the Supreme's transcendence of that particular form. Both actions belong to the authored image. A centre can consequently be real in its local office without becoming the final centre of everything. The accompanying mandala opens concentrically from a home toward foreign contexts and returns to its anchor. The cymatic comparison makes patterned alignment imaginable, but the notebook does not establish a physical law proving an increase of philosophical truth with frequency. Likewise, its buoyancy/boy-on-sea pun is Taylor's phonetic play about the word sustaining a crossing; it is not historical etymology. The [Singh/Abhinavagupta source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) **sources** the encounter's textual lead and distinguishes Singh's introduction from Abhinavagupta's commentary. The kaleidoscope, orbital centre and centralising/decentring operation are Taylor's authored response, **human-amplified: yes**. The source's edition and passage-verification debt does not erase that response, and the response does not settle the debt. This movement **returns-to** [Vāk](../../../../episteme/arguments/A06-Vak.md), where a word's determinate office opens a relation to the field that gives it meaning. ### The cube that reverses while its field remains The lines of a cube admit a change of orientation. A face that had receded comes forward; the earlier view can return without the marks themselves being replaced. As long as one reading occupies the whole field, the alternative appears only through a flip. Taylor's core uses that reversal to approach a further change: the context holds the readings in relation, so that neither has to become the final account of the figure. The core places this within the passage through I, you and it, then the contextual release of their exclusivity, recognition of the one appearing act, and return. The context is not a fourth competing face of the cube. It is the field in which the differently oriented readings can be understood together. The image carries this authorial contextual operation, **human-amplified: yes**; it does not claim an experimental finding that incompatible depth percepts are literally simultaneous. It **returns-to** [diaphaneity](../../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **qualifies** the [world-picture's passage toward an atlas](../../../../episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md). The atlas retains the situated readings and their relations rather than installing one more victorious picture. ### Centres without a final circumference From within an experience, the world is given through this centre. Encounter with another internality changes the demand: the other is also a centre, and its world cannot be exhausted by its appearance in mine. Further internalities can be nested within and across these relations. Their reality does not await a last external spectator who would enclose them all. The centre-everywhere image gives this plurality an indefinite circumference. It removes the demand for a final enclosing view while retaining actual centres and the differences between them. Aperspectivality is therefore not achieved by evacuating perspective. In the authored intake, it makes perspective transparent to the conditions and other perspectives it cannot monopolise. **Human-amplified: yes** for the nested-internality operation. No historical attribution of the sphere formula is claimed here. The image **returns-to** [objective internality](../../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md). ### The broken token and the kept counterpart A token is divided and its halves are carried apart. Each party keeps a piece whose broken edge refers to the absent other. Recognition later occurs through their fit. The break has not merely damaged a complete object: keeping the fracture lets a relation be authenticated across absence. The intervening time matters because trust has to endure before the reunion can make its basis present. Taylor's copula and ballein programme gives this material scene an authored formal return. One half cannot authenticate itself by announcing that it is the whole; nor could an indiscriminate heap of pieces perform the particular fit. The distinct parties and the kept counterpart are necessary to recognition. **Human-amplified: yes** for fracture retained as a means of recognition. [Symbol, account and trust](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **sources** the philological and material-historical work; [root Symbolon](../../../../README.md) carries the formal office. This scene supplies neither a duplicate root derivation nor an invented ancient tale. This authored operation **returns-to** [A23](../../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) through the broken half’s dependence on an encountered counterpart across time, whose arrival an account cannot manufacture. ### Two dots, one orientation, and the erased other The black and white fields retain a dot of each within the other. In Taylor's diagrammatic use, those retained others make the whole living: the distinguished sides do not sever their mutual implication. A one-dot reading gives an orientation within that relation. Erasing the dots changes the operation. The two fields remain visibly opposed, but their capacity to retain the other has disappeared. The final quilt places both annihilation and arrogation at this danger. One route cancels the opposition into nothing; the other claims a pole as absolute and suppresses its dependence. The erased-dot image makes visible how monopoly can preserve the outer form of distinction while eliminating the reciprocal relation that made it generative. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's two-dot/one-dot/no-dot operation. It **returns-to** [the two logics](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). This exact appointment is authored QL imagery; it is not attributed to an ancient Taoist text. ### Bohr's emblem as a separate reception witness The programme brings Bohr's taijitu emblem beside the complementarity discussion. Its office is historical reception: the physicist's emblem is a particular use of a received figure, with an armorial production setting and a motto to be verified. Taylor's erased-dot construction changes a diagram to expose an operation; the Bohr witness concerns an actual emblem that must be recovered on its own terms. The distinction bears on the physics comparison itself. Complementary experimental arrangements and the selection made within one measurement are different operations. An image of opposed yet related sides cannot collapse them into one generic cut. The programme admits the emblem as a subordinate witness, while the exact provenance, motto and reproduction source remain outstanding. **Human-amplified: yes** for the programme's bounded complementarity relation; **human-amplified: no** for any further symbolic reading or identity with Taylor's erased-dot sequence. No unverified armorial image or motto is reproduced here. This authored operation **returns-to** [A18](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) through the emblem’s bounded reception of complementarity, with experimental arrangement distinct from selection and the native eight determinations retained. This authored operation **returns-to** [A19](../../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) through a local criterion retaining its competence while its dependence on an arrangement becomes available for review. ### The black sun and the radiating star Attention and labour move toward a centre. At the public edge, actions are presented as work done for others; deeper within, the power to decide how that work is used is less visible. The black-sun image gathers these movements as capture: energy is received without an answering circulation that renews the people and relations supplying it. The radiating star changes the destination of the intake. What reaches the centre becomes available outward as generative power. The adopted social-power unit gives this contrast a complete Work/Play inversion. Play opens the freedom of an interior life; Need makes its dependence felt; Sacrifice concerns what is given and received; Decision orders that exchange; Love keeps the persons in relation; Work makes the relation publicly available. Healthy work expresses the life sustaining it, and healthy play permits creation and contemplation. The coequal Name series—Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image—articulates what this lived Power movement brings into expression. Power includes provision and care. The black sun concerns its capture, not the existence of Power itself. Under inversion, the public work channel becomes performance while effective decision moves into concealed play. The source's four concentric rings give that separation a changing depth. Outer philanthropy supplies the visible face of benevolence, compared to Neptune's distant orbit. The middle concentration of capital supplies stabilising gravity, compared to Jupiter. Inner fixers mediate between power and its instruments under the image of Mercury's proximity. The innermost corona is a further relation: compromising material binds participants through their capacity to expose one another. Here mutual vulnerability can make departure costly. These are differentiated offices in Taylor's adopted diagnosis. The astronomical imagery makes their visibility and proximity imaginable; it does not establish the institutional claims by physical law or prove a universal history of power. The same contraction reaches identification. A person can be permitted an identity as worker, consumer or public profile while the depth of their life ceases to count. The unit's false accounting excludes interior experience because it cannot be entered in the authorised ledger, then treats that exclusion as absence of reality. What a person has suffered, loved or understood is disqualified before the account is made. The image's return therefore concerns who may determine what I am, as well as where labour and attention flow. Recognition can widen the relation within which a particular identity is held without requiring the person to disappear into a larger collective. The attention sequence has three stages. Cynicism continues to direct energy toward what it distrusts. Exhaustion then brings disengagement. The resulting blankness leaves a field ready for re-inscription: control can operate through deciding which questions become available before answers are offered. Exposing the performance alone has consequently not returned power to those sustaining it. The changed relation must let work, attention and judgement return as their generative capacity. This gives the radiating star its consequence. A newly exclusive framework would repeat the demand for allegiance; the authored return changes the relation to frameworks and the possibility of answering them. **Human-amplified: yes** for the adopted capture/circulation, Work/Play, four-ring and false-accounting operations. They **return-to** [power, delegated labour and return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md), and **qualify** [arbitration's usurpation of measure](../../../../episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md). Particular political or criminal allegations, historical universalizations and psychiatric equivalences in the raw unit require their own evidence and are not reproduced as findings. Its comparisons to separate spectral-chain tellings retain those tellings' own homes; they do not add synthetic poems or substitute for this image's complete political movement. ### City, bomb, surveillance, and the counterfeit image A city shelters a plurality of lives and gathers the energy that sustains them. Its organised power can also turn against its inhabitants. The bomb makes a destructive possibility material: the built field can be annihilated. Surveillance can preserve the buildings and daily activity while capturing the people who move within them. The maintained appearance of a functioning city therefore cannot by itself establish that its constitutive relation remains free. The AI and deepfake extension introduces another power. An image can remain persuasive while its claimed source has been broken or counterfeited. This differs from destroying the city and from monitoring an actual person: the encounter is directed toward an appearance whose asserted origin cannot be trusted. Material destruction, capture of persons, and counterfeit source-image are three distinct failures in the programme's movement through technoscientific power. The God-image enters as the cultural question of what a collective places at the source and end of its organised power. The intended Giegerich passages on the nuclear bomb and technology remain an acquisition and telling debt; this page does not construct a universal causal history from religion through city to AI. **Human-amplified: yes** for the authored destruction/capture/counterfeit differentiation. The image **qualifies** [mediating office and source authority](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md). The technical onset scene of [the mirror that moves first](../mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md) retains its separate whole: an instrument initiating a return is a different relation from counterfeiting an image's source. The final four operators belong to one encounter with alterity. Their different offices prevent the word Other from covering over the difference between a power within the psyche and another person who meets it. This authored operation **returns-to** [A32](../../../../episteme/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) through destruction, capture within a continuing habitat and counterfeit originating witness as distinct changes to the next encounter. ### God as Other A finite mind confronts source, law or archetypal totality as something exceeding its own possession. The image gives that exceeding an address in God as Other. A divine-mind reading, in which the divine Self encounters its manifestation, changes the register of the relation. The finite mind cannot simply claim that office for itself because it has produced an image of the divine. **Human-amplified: yes** for the programme's distinction of these registers. ### Shadow as other-self What the ego disowns returns as internal difference. Its completed self-picture cannot accommodate what nevertheless acts within its life. The shadow's otherness makes that incompleteness effective: recognition requires a changed relation to what had been excluded. This is an encounter within psychic life; it does not establish that another person is only a projection of the ego. **Human-amplified: yes** for the programme's other-self office. ### Friend as my-self's-other A friend shares a world while exceeding the image I make of them. Their response can alter our relation because its source is not exhausted by my account of it. Here the other is another centre, and friendship requires that excess to remain active. Assimilating the friend to an inner figure would remove the very interlocutor through whom the relation changes. **Human-amplified: yes** for the authored interpersonal distinction. ### Alien or enemy as externalised uncertainty Denied uncertainty can be assigned to an external negative pole. The enemy then appears to carry what the self's account has refused to include. The operation is a projection and a severance: it converts an unresolved relation into a supposed property of the other. Recognising that operation restores responsibility for the account doing the assigning. It does not imply that every actual danger is imaginary or that every adversary is an inner figure. **Human-amplified: yes** for this specified projection operation. Together these four operators **return-to** [self and other without possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). The programme lets Jung's inner face meet the interpersonal pressure associated with Levinas while preserving their different source tasks. It does not turn the four operators into fixed native determinations or four universal character classes. ## #5→0 — Keeping the opening in the form The complete poems make return something more exact than a common theme. Play begins again after checkmate; the six routes fall through their loop; the distressed speaker must reconcile what he could not simply eradicate; the fitting shoe is returned. Each ending qualifies the work that precedes it. The prose images give that demand different material tests: a kept counterpart can recognise another, an erased counterpart cannot; a centre can return what it receives, or consume the conditions of its own power. The [Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **receive** the exact numerical and verbal movement of FT-P04 and FT-P11–16. [Faithful definition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) receives the fish, frame and speaking limit; [Vāk](../../../../episteme/arguments/A06-Vak.md) receives the language that can yield while remaining precise. These are operation-specific returns. They do not make all twenty-three poems interchangeable illustrations of one argument. Further comparisons, including a fixed mythic identity for the brothers of FT-P18 or the figures of FT-P22, remain **human-amplified: no** unless their own authored relation is recovered. Neumann's [shared structuration](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **qualifies** the relation of emergence, differentiation and renewed interplay across this field. Its common ground does not remove the place, medium, author or date of an occurrence. A geography can trace the cultural homes and encounters from which an image arrives; a temporal account can follow composition, revision and reception; the shared archetypal structure can make their changing offices comparable. None of these three can replace the others. The local centre remains real within these relations. In the recursive Bimba operation, a reference can genuinely occupy a relative original's office while remaining pratibimba in a wider relation; this preserves the contextual office and the wider order of dependence together. The canonical compilation supplies all twenty-three complete poems. The separate raw site file cited by that compilation remains unlocated in the current local search, and the dated journal corrections do not authorise silent alteration of its text. The unmined Venus naming/reception vector retains its separate telling gate; protected experiential material retains its use-choice gate and is not narrated here. Historical emblem, edition and technoscientific source debts remain where their claims arise. Those limits leave the authored works intact and the way back to their particular words open.
