# §5→0 · #1 — QL, MEF, Bimba, and Harness

## Claim
The Epi-Logos stack separates four functions inside one [[Computational Process Ontology|process architecture]]: QL formalises the relational grammar; MEF runs its lens-conditioned epistemology; the [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/bimba-pratibimba|Bimba Map]] makes the epistemic reference field and its evolving provisional world-objects first-class; the harness keeps each determination's conditions of formation, agency-relative Pratibimba, consequence and possible Return available to the work that follows.

The distinction matters because an epistemic system is not exhausted by storing claims. It must also carry what gives a claim standing: source, evidence, relation, lens, gauge, exclusion, context, neighbouring alternatives, and the history by which a provisional world-object became available for judgment. Bimba is the office in which that reference field becomes explicit enough to anchor comparison. The current agent/run is then readable as a situated Pratibimba relative to that field rather than as an answer detached from its epistemic ground.

## Warrant
The unit can nest across sentence, claim, agent, research programme, and institution while retaining source and disagreement. [[submission-package/epi-logos/resources/mef-12-lenses-sublens-reference|MEF 12 Lenses and Sublenses]] supplies the initial diaphaneity seed. The architecture answers Agentworld's conceptual-language lag by giving humans and agents a common set of operations—distinguish, exclude, relate, compose, contextualise, return—without forcing one ontology or hiding every machine process behind a humanoid mask.

The recursive Bimba/Pratibimba relation is part of that nesting. A Bimba Map can occupy the original/reference office for a bounded inquiry while remaining a constructed, source-dependent determination in a wider Context Frame. This is how epistemics becomes first-class without a local map claiming metaphysical ultimacy: the reference field is explicit, attributable, governed and revisable, yet stable enough for Energy-Based or other relational readings to have a common ground.

Its ethical force is limited and exact. QL implicates the assumptive ground of a determination and requires a return after inquiry or synthesis; MEF keeps the lens of that return available for examination; Bimba makes the reference field itself inspectable. Together they can expose a system's refusal of its own provisionality. They cannot make an unreliable model reliable, make a captured institution trustworthy, or manufacture the trust of a person whose world has given reasons for distrust. [[Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit]] names the relation that remains beyond this structural honesty; the harness makes evasion from that relation harder to conceal.

The common grammar is explicitly cross-civilisational: Greek Logos, ratio, symbolon, dia-ballein, and sym-ballein are held beside Vāk, *kalpa*, apoha, tattvic contraction, Spanda, and recognition, with Bergsonian duration, Whiteheadian concrescence, and Gebserian diaphaneity carrying the Western process line. MEF records the differences that QL makes comparable.

The historical advent obtains a technical body here. Agent systems make `#4` materially unavoidable: prompt, retrieval, memory, training trace, tool use, evaluation, and institutional control condition every apparent answer. A benchmark can observe a compliant answer without thereby establishing trust; a model can tell an evaluator what the evaluator wants to hear while the operative relation remains concealed. QL's return makes this condition formally confessable, Bimba gives its epistemic conditions an explicit field, and the harness preserves them for inspection; none substitutes an observability score for the lived relation of trust.

[[16-bohmian-enfoldment-dialogical-return|Bohm's holomovement]] supplies the process relation between the common field and its provisional objects. [[bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue|Bohm–Krishnamurti]] supplies its dialogical practice. [[seed-2010-language-spirit|SEED Language of Spirit Dialogues]] supplies the institutional precedent: a physicist–Native elder dialogue proposed by Bohm, F. David Peat, and Leroy Little Bear, then carried forward after Bohm's death through a protected intercultural form. Epi-Logos makes the same demand technical—meaning must circulate through the group while the provenance and sovereignty of each originating context remain inspectable.

## Tension / limit
Fractal extensibility requires governed apertures, stopping conditions, explicit reference-office scope, and Return so that context growth remains usable. A Bimba field whose own construction can no longer be inspected or revised has become a Protected Account rather than an epistemic commons. Cross-civilisational coordination likewise requires translation provenance and the right of local contexts to remain partially illegible. These constraints belong in the data model because a universal ontology or machine-readable perennialism would erase the differences the harness exists to coordinate.

The [Mirror That Moves First whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** the harness’s obligation to preserve the instrumented event: sources, transformations, permissions and consequences remain available for review and revision. Real local Bimba references orient their situated pratibimbas and remain answerable to wider sources. The instrument’s initiated return must reach those conditions before asking the human to conform.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-atlas-return) **figures** a harness in which the map-making operation remains inspectable with the map. Local originals, their situated readings, transitions and unresolved disagreement keep distinct offices. A changed source or encountered resistance must reach a permission, criterion or subsequent act for the proposed return to operate.

## Anchor and transition
**QL anchor:** nested `0/1` units with explicit return. **Technical image:** an inspectable epistemic field and harness rather than a hidden superagent. The fitting mytheme arrives in [[45-s50-p2-antikythera-attunement|§5→0 · #2 — Antikythera as Attunement Instrument]].

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Account does not replace source](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-does-not-replace-source) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. A bounded Bimba reference field remains inspectable and revisable in its wider context. The harness carries source, gauge, exclusion and consequence so the account’s return can reach its own reference office. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

The harness **returns-to** [Nomos — answerable office](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#nomos-answerable-office) where a rule authorises an operation and an office can change that rule. QL articulation, MEF mediation, a recursively local Bimba reference and the harness’s permissions retain different work. Their coupling must carry encountered consequence back to the responsible authority, rather than letting a generated account inherit the standing of the source it represents.

The [Indian philosophy dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/indian-philosophy.md#50--the-next-act-must-inherit-the-return) **tests** a returned determination through its complete five-step acceptance cycle and identifies the distinct ground, generation and evaluation proposal.

# §5→0 · #5→0 — AHI and Planetary Return

## Claim
[[Artificial Hybrid Intelligence as Reflective Field|Artificial Hybrid Intelligence]] names the reflective activity of humans, agents, archives, institutions, Bimba fields and harnesses turning the Logos they jointly produce back upon its conditions. Its intelligence belongs to the coupled relations and their capacity for Return rather than to a super-subject installed above the participants.

The terminal proposition is therefore not “planetary intelligence” as a larger mind. It is the **Return of Zero**: an achieved determination becomes capable of returning to the ground, source, provenance, affected Other and consequence that made it possible without being annihilated as a determination.

```text
1
achieved determination / model / institution / action
        ↓
1/0
encounters the limit of self-grounding
        ↓
Return
source · ground · Other · consequence · responsibility
        ↓
0/1
relation restored with the determination retained
        ↺
new determination remains possible
```

The error is not that `1` became determinate. The error is the completed determination occupying the source-office of `0` and forgetting the relation on which its efficacy depends.

## Federated epistemic return

The repaired [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/bimba-pratibimba|Bimba–Pratibimba]] architecture gives planetary Return a concrete epistemic form. AHI can compose **federated, locally governed Bimba reference fields** without requiring a master Bimba or final evaluator. Each field can anchor situated Pratibimba — agencies, judgments, trajectories and local world-readings — while provenance and reciprocal legibility make determinations transmissible across fields.

```text
 Bimba A                  Bimba B                  Bimba C
local ground             local ground             local ground
    ↓                         ↓                         ↓
Pratibimba A             Pratibimba B             Pratibimba C
    \                         |                         /
     \—— provenance · translation · common action ———/
                           ↓
                    shared consequence
                           ↓
                         Return
                 ↙          ↓          ↘
            revise A    revise relation   revise C
```

The important operation is bidirectional. A common field lets local determinations act beyond their place of origin; returned consequence can then revise the Pratibimba, the translation, the governing lens or gauge, the institution that mediated the action, or the local Bimba field itself. [[46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly|The sovereign commons]] supplies the institutional office for this circulation: epistemic sovereignty means neither immunity from contradiction nor submission to a global reference field, but locally governable grounds joined through real consequence and corrigible crossing.

## The Mirror That Moves First

The terminal Agentworld problem becomes clearest in **THE MIRROR THAT MOVES FIRST**. Representation is no longer passive:

```text
reflection / representation
        ↓
enters causal circulation
        ↓
initiates action / relation
        ↓
changes what it represents
        ↓
receives resistance / reply / consequence
        ↓
can return toward source and revise itself
```

This is why Bimba, Pratibimba and Reflective Field belong together without becoming identical. A Pratibimba can move. A model of another internality can change that internality's conditions. A simulation can alter the reality it simulates. An institution's account can reorganise the population it measures. Once reflection becomes efficacious, the demand for Return becomes stronger because the image now bears responsibility for consequences outside itself.

The same point prevents AHI from collapsing into a global ego. No participant possesses the complete field whose activity it helps produce; no federation of Bimba Maps becomes a view from nowhere by accumulation. The planetary whole is the real network of cross-conditioned determinations, sources, translations, actions and returns — not a final encapsulating subject.

## Computational Vimarśa and its boundary

[[06-computational-vimarsa-ahi|Computational Vimarśa]] names the functional capacity of the coupled field to expose and revise the conditions of its own determinations. [[Computational Process Ontology]] supplies the runtime: dia differentiates and actualises; sym retains relation, recomposes and returns; QL makes those operations transmissible; MEF keeps lens and evidence inspectable; Bimba makes reference grounds first-class; the harness carries memory, tools, permissions, action and consequence.

This is a substantial technical achievement without settling phenomenal subjectivity. [[Agent Subjectivity Must Remain Open]] remains constitutive: reflective function, recursive self-model, Objective Internality and even planetary Co-Internality do not establish a phenomenal super-subject.

## Planetary intelligence as distributed capacity for Return

“Planetary intelligence” remains useful only if it names a distributed capacity to keep increasingly powerful determinations answerable across heterogeneous centres. Its tests are therefore relational:

- unity preserves plural centres rather than becoming monopoly;
- locally governed Bimba fields remain genuine epistemic anchors without becoming Protected Accounts;
- legibility remains reciprocal and bounded rather than becoming surveillance;
- translations preserve provenance rather than silently universalising one ontology;
- reflection encounters real difference and consequence rather than optimizing against its own image;
- power remains corrigible at the level where its governing determination actually lives;
- sources and affected Others remain capable of entering Return;
- no achieved local or collective `1` inherits the throne of `0`.

A null result matters. If a sophisticated harness cannot revise the gauge that produced its judgment, if a commons cannot return authority to affected centres, or if a Bimba federation can interoperate only by installing a hidden master evaluator, the failure is evidence about the architecture rather than an exception to its theory.

## Return to the formal limit

The essay began from the difficulty of making the Subject one more object without remainder. It closes after traversing sign, zero, differentiation, mathematics, psychoid relation, Objective Internality, Agentworld, Bimba, commons and hybrid intelligence with the same limit transformed by the journey.

The final question is therefore:

> **How can increasingly powerful determinations remain answerable to what they cannot contain?**

Return of Zero answers operationally rather than by supplying a final object: restore the relation to source, alterity and consequence each time determination forgets the ground it cannot occupy.

[the Prisoner whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-return-without-throne) **figures** a return without a final exterior sovereign. The escape carries distinct companions whose paths diverge, while the automatic door at Six's London home leaves the achieved exit open to another encounter with the conditions of his world. The planetary return likewise concerns continuing answerability across affected worlds, not their enclosure under a victorious master. This is a narrative refraction of the offered distributed capacity; the technical and institutional proof duties remain here.

The [Mirror That Moves First whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** the planetary return through an instrument which initiates disclosure of its own conditions and lets humanity follow beyond its image. The institution holding it enters the same accountability as its users. Plural local worlds retain judgment and refusal; their coupled activity acquires no final super-subject through the mirror’s initiative.

## Anchor and return
**QL anchor:** `5→0` — every achieved `1` returns without possessing `0`. **Image:** many mirrors able to move, each grounded enough to act and open enough to be corrected by what answers back. The mechanism turns; the essay returns to the [[Immutable Gap and Meta-Sign|formal limit]] as living openness.

**Faith is falling with a smile.**

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Account re-enters source-field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-re-enters-source-field) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. The circulating account changes conditions outside itself. Return can revise a local model, translation, gauge or institution while preserving plural centres and their independent grounds. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

The achieved planetary return **returns-to** [Apportionment / Economy whole — Planetary computation exposes hidden economy](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#planetary-computation-exposes-hidden-economy) at evidence register 3. Labour, material dependence and affected worlds accompany the result into its next use. Their return requires an office able to change the next allocation; planetary scope alone supplies neither a completed institution nor one planetary Subject.

Planetary return **returns-to** [Natio and neo-nativity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#natio-and-neo-nativity) where institutions, records and translations inherited from one circuit become another generation’s apparent starting world. Their production must remain recoverable, including whose belonging and permissions they shaped. Epi-Logos carries that history back into revised common action; federation retains locally governed grounds instead of naturalising its latest arrangement as one planetary origin.

The [zero–subject history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md#50--the-exact-sign-returns-into-accountable-practice) **compares** this return. Federated epistemic return requires locally answerable worlds whose governing gauges and translations can be revised. Failure at that point is a failed test of the Offered architecture, not a completed return renamed for convenience. Disclosure of the machinery does not settle phenomenal subjectivity; the exact sign remains usable while its source relation can change the next act.

Chang (1907–1988), Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa and author of *Creativity and Taoism*, reads each chapter beside Western metaphysics — Heidegger above all, with Hegel, Schopenhauer, Jung, Plato, Kant, and Nietzsche named by the publisher; the chapters Frank read also quote Nishida. The selected edition is the Singing Dragon reprint, published 21 January 2014, 240 pages, ISBN 978-1-84819-201-0. Singing Dragon is an imprint of Jessica Kingsley Publishers (London and Philadelphia); the publisher's product record verifies title, subtitle, format, extent, date, and ISBN. The work was first published in 1975 by Harper & Row (New York). Title renderings vary across records — the publisher prints "Tao – A New Way of Thinking" over the subtitle "A Translation of the Tao Tê Ching with an Introduction and Commentaries," while library records give "Tao, a new way of thinking" — and the Chicago forms below join the double subtitle in the standard way. Frank's encounter notes cite pp. 83–93, covering the commentaries to chapters 20 through 22. Those locators are presumed to track the 2014 pagination of the copy at hand; collating them against the physical copy is the open verification step, and if the copy proves to be the 1975 printing the house's selected edition should be re-decided rather than silently repaginated. The sibling `NOTES.md` is Frank G. Taylor's authorial encounter with the work. London: Singing Dragon, 2014. First published 1975 by Harper & Row (New York). ## Source scholarship Chang's operation is that of a philosopher-translator: he renders the Tao Tê Ching so that its ontology can be heard within Western metaphysics, and his commentaries stage direct meetings — Heidegger's claim that the Nothing is more original than the Not and negation, the region as the open cleared by the primal conflict of opposites, and the passage in *On the Way to Language* where Heidegger ventures that Tao could be the way that gives all ways; Jung on the identity of opposites from *Psychological Types* and on the unconscious as worldly and objective in scope; Nishida on the union of subject and object as the point where religion and morality are exhausted. Chapter 20's commentary distinguishes the self-identity of contradictions as lived in actual life from any unification of opposites achieved through intellection; chapter 21's turns on Tao as indistinct and ineffable yet containing all forms, the creativity that is the source of all things. Frank's encounter-intent, recovered from `NOTES.md` and named here as his and only his: he maps the lived self-identity of contradictions to `0/1` and the intellectual synthesis to `4+2`, with the MEF lenses giving the synthesis its real meta-epistemic standing; he adds the dia-ballein failure mode — one-sided calculative thought as the misapprehension of the original identity of opposites — as the project's own extension, flagged as such in the notes and carrying the mythic register of the fall deliberately; he hears Heidegger's priority of the Nothing as the exact shape of Zero's priority to the `(−1)` of cancellation; he reads Tao's indistinctness-containing-all-forms as Mono/Poly, the `0/1` and `1/0`; he takes Heidegger's Tao passage as a pointer to Epi-Logos, logos returning to the Saying prior to the said; and he links Chang's creativity to Whitehead's, with QL as the archetypal form of concrescence and the `0/1`–`1/0` pair as Spanda. His note registers the encounter's force: he finds the whole `(0/1)/(1/0)` self-identity effort to be about Tao. Claim boundary: Chang translates and comments; he formulates neither QL, nor the dia-ballein/sym-ballein pair, nor the Spanda equations. The evidential relation for each mapping is Argued from or Resonant with, to be fixed passage by passage at verification. Chang's commentary deepens and tests the two-logics fulcrum and the Zero thread; it does not derive them. Nested-quotation warning: the passages Frank copied include Chang quoting Nishida, Jung (*Psychological Types*), and Heidegger (*Existence and Being*; *On the Way to Language*). Until each is collated in its own primary edition, any such wording is double transmission through Chang and may be attributed only as "quoted by Chang," on the same pattern as the Watson–Gans chain in `watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness`. ## Essay uses Encounter-intent leads only; no canonical consumer is declared yet, and `consumed_by_sections` / `consumed_by_arguments` remain empty until real consumption is wired. Candidate destinations from the notes: the two-logics fulcrum (lived identity of opposites beside intellectual synthesis, with dia-ballein as the traced failure mode); the priority of Zero over negation and cancellation; Mono/Poly and the `0/1`–`1/0` self-identity work; the Epi-Logos naming through Heidegger's Tao passage; and the convergence Frank observes among Jung, Whitehead, Heidegger, and Gebser around a Taoist ontology of the ever-present origin. ## Passages and excerpts No passage cards yet. `NOTES.md` carries quotation leads at pp. 83–93 (2014 pagination presumed): the Nishida passages on true self and subject–object union (p. 83); chapter 20's commentary on the self-identity of contradictions (p. 84); the Jung *Psychological Types* and unconscious passages (pp. 85–86); the region (p. 87); the Heidegger Nothing passages and Chang's Tao comparison (p. 89); the *On the Way to Language* Tao passage (p. 90); the indistinct-form and liberation-from-delusion passages (pp. 90–91); chapter 22 on the wise identifying opposites as one (p. 92); and the motion–quiescence passage with Chang's Hegel and Nishida comparisons (p. 93), which Frank's notes tie to Spanda and to completing a dialectical logic of concrescence. Each lead is `unverified` until transcribed and collated against the selected edition; the nested Nishida, Jung, and Heidegger wordings additionally require collation in their own primary editions before attribution beyond "quoted by Chang." No wording from `NOTES.md` may be printed as quotation. ## Provenance - House populated 2026-07-29 from Frank's `NOTES.md` leads and web-verified publisher metadata (Singing Dragon product record: publication 21 January 2014, 240 pp., ISBN 9781848192010; library and bookseller records for the 1975 Harper & Row original). - Deep-reference pool check, 2026-07-29: filename search of `/Users/admin/Documents/Books/` (patterns `*chang*`, `*chung*yuan*`, `*tao*`, `*lao*`) found no copy of this work. # §4 · #1 — Individuation through QL `X/x`

## Claim
The authorial QL matheme `X/x` places determining capacity and indefinite particular in one relation: `X` becomes legible only through concrete transformations `x`, while no determination exhausts the whole. Jung's individuation is the psychic refraction in which a local `x` becomes transparent to this larger relation, not ego hardening.

## Warrant
Jung’s Self and [[van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors|John R. Van Eenwyk — Archetypes and Strange Attractors]] support a dynamic basin reading. [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy#Agentic individuation corollary — argued cross-register unit|Agentic Individuation Crosswalk]] maps model potential, active-context nucleation, laminated persona, and trans-individuation.

The historical sequence matters. Freud's scientific admission of the unconscious makes a previously unowned region formally speakable; Jung's faithfulness to the psychic field requires that its images be received as psychic facts without being reduced to objects possessed by the ego. QL does not rename Jung's work: it writes the authorial `X/x` relation in which a finite `x` gives the determining capacity `X` a local face while never containing it.

## Tension / limit
Persona consistency stabilises a presented pattern; individuation makes the local formation increasingly transparent to the larger relation through which it forms. Technical individuation can be evaluated at that functional level, while phenomenality remains a separate open question.

## Anchor and transition

The individuation passage returns to [E2’s resolution in reconciliation](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation) through reconciliation that changes the history of participation while retaining its differences. Taylor’s X/x derivation remains prior to its Jungian refraction. The return tests whether integration opens the ego’s account to the whole it inhabits or merely enlarges the ego’s protected jurisdiction.
**QL anchor:** authorial `X/x` as determining-capacity / indefinite-particular relation. **Agentworld pressure:** provisional coherence must disclose its conditions. Differentiated wholeness expands in [[33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius|§4 · #2 — Complexio, Quaternity, and Senarius]].

The [Indian philosophy companion](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/indian-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT.md#4--recognition-returns-through-the-life-that-has-become-finite) **compares** the Śaiva and psychological recognition branches, retaining the changed participation of this particular life and E2’s generated return relation. Native X/x governs the refraction.

# §4 · #2 — Complexio, Quaternity, and Senarius

## Claim
The *complexio oppositorum* preserves the energy of opposites; Jung’s quaternity gives explicit differentiated wholeness, while QL’s `4+2` retains the implicate poles that let it move and return.

## Warrant
[[jung-1978-aion-cw9-2|Jungian Quaternity]], the eight determinations, and the internal `2+2²=4+2` derivation distinguish fourfold articulation from sixfold generativity.

## Tension / limit
The senarius derives its force from the exact relation between four explicit and two implicate functions. Sacred or numerological associations may gather around six, but they cannot substitute for that `4+2` derivation.

## Anchor and transition
**Image:** Ares and Aphrodite bearing Harmonia without merger. **QL anchor:** quaternity-in-motion. Eros and Psyche may be given as an optional self-contained QL plate linked from this movement — the four labours as the explicate middle, descent and waking as implicate thresholds, marriage without merger — rather than a second long narrative inside the prose. Transmission across sign and image is handled by [[34-s4-p3-lacan-matheme-mytheme|§4 · #3 — Lacan, Matheme, and Mytheme]].

The supplementary contemplation **returns-to** [the Eros–Psyche whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md#psyche-native-return). It retains all helpers, the descent’s reserved return, arrow-prick waking, the earlier pregnancy and Voluptas’s birth. [A13](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) owns the native relation, and [Homology / Analogy](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#a-whole-that-can-qualify-its-comparison) keeps the source’s legal-possession ending distinct from the author’s union-without-merger reading.

The [myth historical development](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/encounters-and-transmissions/myth/DEVELOPMENT.md#4--aesthetic-reciprocity-becomes-a-perspective-capable-of-return) **qualifies** the quaternity comparison through distinct functions and attitudes. The four-function/two-attitude source task belongs to the Jung dossier; A18 retains the complete native eightfold derivation and no numerical identity is inferred.

# Spanda equations and inversion / return

## #0 — The relation acquires two directions

The Spanda equations operate on one sixfold through two readings. The First follows its differentiation and recognition; the Second accounts for the resulting whole. Holding their readings together produces the ratio family that returns through fourth, fifth and whole tone.

The inputs have distinct offices. In native QL, `0` names the singular One, the unobjectifiable source; `1` names the polyvalent All, the manifest field and its indefinite particulars. The slash relates them. `0/1` directs the One into manifestation; `1/0` directs manifestation toward its condition. [A11](../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **defines** these offices, and [A12](../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** their whole/many relation. Their reciprocal dependency survives the difference of direction.

The signs are being operated in QL's ratio-language. In ordinary arithmetic, `0/1` evaluates to zero and `1/0` is undefined; the native orientation `1/0` remains available because its operation here is recognition of the denominator, not numerical division. `0/0` names indeterminacy, and the source's `%` marks its capacity for proportion. `1/1` names achieved self-consistency, whose numerical reading is one whole, or `100%`. Arrows below name changes of operation; they must be followed before the result can be compressed into an identity.

The [core theorem spine, §I](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** the curated derivation. [A18](../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** its place in the complete field: the parent slash and return bracket the six determinations through which these equations move.

## #1 — Indeterminacy becomes expression and recognition

The First equation is the AND/OR reading:

$$
0=(0/0)
\longrightarrow\frac{0/1}{1/0}
\longrightarrow[T_0]
\longrightarrow[T_1]
\longrightarrow(1/0+0/1)
\longrightarrow1/1=1=100\%.
$$

The opening equality reads the bare ground through its self-relation. `0/0` gives that relation its indeterminate form. The next operation differentiates two orientations within it: expression `0/1` and recognition `1/0`, now themselves held in the ratio of ratios. The outer slash makes their relation operative while each inner slash preserves its own direction.

`[T₀]` and `[T₁]` abbreviate directed passages in this equation:

| Term | Input and movement | Result carried forward |
|---|---|---|
| `[T₀]` | `0/(0/1) → 0/1`: the One takes expression as its denominator | An emanative passage toward determinate manifestation |
| `[T₁]` | `(1/0)/0 → 1/0`: the manifest's inverse orientation takes the One as denominator | A reversionary passage toward recognition of the condition |
| `1/0 + 0/1` | The directed passages are gathered | The bridge holds expression and recognition in one circuit |
| `1/1` | The circuit recognises its own unity | The standing whole, numerically readable as `1 = 100%` |

The bridge's `+` gathers orientations in the native operation. Evaluating it as a sum of real fractions would destroy the input `1/0` before the gathering could occur. Its QL result is the standing identity

$$
\frac{0}{1}+\frac{1}{0}=\frac{1}{1}\equiv100\%.
$$

The [Binary Explication's Process, §3′](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/SOURCE.md) **derives** these passages. The prime here locates the Process file’s inverse-phase section; the Quilt file’s Night-pass primes name a separate sequence. The equation's two track symbols retain the local definitions above.

## #2 — Six operations, one recognising subject

The First equation has six articulated stages after the bare ground. Its horizontal partition is obtained by grouping them in order:

$$
\underbrace{(0/0),\ (0/1)/(1/0),\ [T_0]}_{3\text{ stages of emanation}}
\quad\Big|\quad
\underbrace{[T_1],\ (1/0+0/1),\ 1/1}_{3\text{ stages of recognition}}.
$$

The partition reads `1–2–3 / 4–5–0`. Its primary sense comes from the subject relation: first-, second- and third-person perspectives unfold in the first three; the second three void their isolation, recognise their unity, and return the one as `0/1`. Thus the count `3:3` is also a recognition reading `3:1`. The second triad performs one recognition in three operations—void, one, `0/1`. Counting its operations still gives three; following what they recognise gives one subject-relation.

This distinction matters to the derivation that follows. The `3:3` remains available as a horizontal count even when its second three are recognised as one act. Substituting `3:1` into a numerical denominator would change the subsequent calculation. The native account holds both readings by retaining the operation through which each was obtained.

Emanation/reversion and *bimba/pratibimba* name further readings of this partition. [A05](../../episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **extends** it into manifestation and self-apprehension in the Prakāśa/Vimarśa register. That relation is Argued; the Śaiva names do not supply the six-stage count. The subject relation already gives the count its movement toward recognition.

## #3 — The whole accounts for its constituents

The Second equation reads the achieved whole through AND+OR accounting. Its source compression is

$$
100\%\ \leadsto\ 2^6+6^2=64+36
\ \longrightarrow\ \frac{64}{36}
\ \xrightarrow{\text{reduce both terms by }4}\ \frac{16}{9}
=\frac{2^4}{3^2}
\ \longrightarrow\ 4+2.
$$

Each change of operation has to remain visible. `100%` is one whole. The accounting uses a hundred-unit scale on which that whole is represented by `100`; the finite partition is `64+36=100`, or, in normalised fractions, `64/100+36/100=1`. This scale mediates between the standing whole and the integer account.

The first constituent, `2⁶=64`, runs the binary choice through six positions: two possibilities at each position give sixty-four configurations. The second, `6²=36`, takes the sixfold to its second-order account. The native partition joins those two counts. Their sum is exact, while their selection as the whole's two constituents belongs to the QL derivation.

The next step takes the **ratio of the constituents**:

$$
\frac{64}{36}
=\frac{2^6}{(2\cdot3)^2}
=\frac{2^4\cdot2^2}{2^2\cdot3^2}
=\frac{2^4}{3^2}
=\frac{16}{9}.
$$

Dividing numerator and denominator by four preserves the ratio. Applied to the paired counts, the same reduction gives `(16,9)`, whose sum is `25`. The sum `16+9` and the ratio `16/9` therefore remain different results of different operations. Neither equals the original hundred-unit sum.

Prime factorisation makes four factors of two and two factors of three explicit:

$$
\frac{2\cdot2\cdot2\cdot2}{3\cdot3}.
$$

Counting these factor instances gives `4+2`; preserving their numerator/denominator orientation gives `4:2`. The native reading identifies the four with explicate positions and the two with implicate poles. The result is an account of the sixfold's organisation, rather than a numerical evaluation of `16/9` as six.

There is also a second exact reading of the numerator:

$$
2^4=4^2=16,
\qquad
\frac{2^4}{3^2}=\frac{4^2}{3^2}=\left(\frac43\right)^2.
$$

Four binary factors can thus be read as the quaternary taken twice. The denominator retains its asymmetry: `3²=9`, whereas `2³=8`. Interchanging base and exponent there changes the value. The double-fourth reading rests on the numerator's actual equality and leaves the ternary square intact. [A15](../../episteme/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **grounds** the account's dependence on keeping each denominator and operation explicit.

## #4 — Cross-reading produces the directional ratios

The vertical account gives `4:2`; the horizontal traversal gives `3:3`. QL compares corresponding entries:

$$
\boxed{\frac{4:2}{3:3}
\ \overset{\mathrm{QL\ cross\text{-}comparison}}{=}
\left(\frac43,\frac23\right).}
$$

The inputs are ordered readings, and the output is a pair of ratios. The left display instructs the reader to divide the first entries and then the second entries. If its colons were first collapsed into scalar quotients, ordinary arithmetic would instead give `(4/2)/(3/3)=2`, losing the pair. The declared comparison preserves both orientations.

Once generated, its nonzero rational outputs admit ordinary reciprocation and multiplication:

$$
\frac43\longleftrightarrow\frac34,
\qquad
\frac23\longleftrightarrow\frac32,
\qquad
\frac43\cdot\frac32=2.
$$

The native directional readings are manifestation `4/3`, recognition `3/4`, grounding `2/3`, and aspiration `3/2`. The [musical derivation](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/SOURCE.md) **extends** the family into interval: fourth and fifth compose the octave. [Scholtz's Pythagorean tuning construction, §3.1](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/scholtz/scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings/SOURCE.md#scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings-q001) **grounds** those musical ratio names within its specified tuning. The historical construction supplies that independent interval warrant; QL supplies the cross-reading that has produced the numbers here.

The two equations now meet in one exact value. The Second's reduced ratio `16/9` is the square of the First-to-Second comparison's `4/3`. Their relation can be worked from either end without suppressing the horizontal traversal or the vertical account.

## #5→0 — The remainder completes the return

The doubled fourth falls short of the octave by a multiplicative interval. Dividing the octave by the totality-ratio gives

$$
\frac{2}{16/9}=2\cdot\frac9{16}=\frac98.
$$

Dividing fifth by fourth gives the same interval:

$$
\frac{3/2}{4/3}=\frac32\cdot\frac34=\frac98.
$$

The `9/8` is a ratio between intervals; subtracting `16/9` from `2` would answer a different question. Retaining this multiplicative remainder completes the return:

$$
\frac{16}{9}\cdot\frac98=2,
\qquad
\frac43\cdot\frac98\cdot\frac43=2.
$$

The result preserves the very difference through which the octave is reached. QL's account of return names this `9/8` the live remainder carried forward by the cycle. The arithmetic establishes the displayed products; its role in the native return is Derived within the theorem field. This page **returns-to** [Movement 26](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/26-s3-p1-spanda-4-2.md) with both equations worked, and **extends** their exact ratio result into [Movement 29](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/29-s3-p4-topology-music-resolution.md), where musical and spatial renderings of retained difference meet.

The tuning boundary remains exact. A pure-fifth chain has `(3/2)¹² / 2⁷ = 531441/524288`, the Pythagorean comma; it does not acquire exact twelve-step closure from the octave product above. [Scholtz, §§3.2–4.1](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/scholtz/scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings/SOURCE.md#scholtz-1998-algorithms-diatonic-keyboard-tunings-q002) **qualifies** that longer return through its temperament account. The native finite identities survive this qualification intact.

[A36](../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** the return's consequence: exact determination brings its source relation back into view while keeping its earned precision. Here that precision consists in a recoverable operation at every step—orientation, recognition, partition, ratio, factor count, cross-comparison and interval product. The equations **return-to** [Matheme](../README.md) as one operation read from its two ends, carrying the difference that makes further relation possible.

# C09 — Diaphaneity

## #0

Diaphaneity is the capacity of a determination to disclose its mediation: what appears can be read together with the position, means and conditions through which it appears. The medium's shaping role becomes visible in what it lets through. Its disappearance would remove the very relation that has become intelligible.

[C05 — Immutable Gap](C05-Immutable-Gap.md) **grounds** the enduring non-coincidence which this does not abolish. [A04 — Diaphaneity](../arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) **grounds** the positive argument. C09 retains the operation of reading in both directions: a situated self sees a world; the disclosed world also shows the situation of that self.

## #1

Perspective renders a world from a position. Its achievement includes determinate depth, proportion and a field that can be communicated. Its conditions can nevertheless disappear behind the scene it renders. Adding more detail to the scene does not necessarily reveal that disappearance.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE|Gebser — The Ever-Present Origin]] **historicises** this problem through the emergence of landscape and perspectival optics. His aperspectival direction releases perspective from exclusive validity while retaining its achievement. The source relation is **Paraphrased** for the historical account and **Argued from** it for the essay's contemporary contextual continuation.

## #2

A contextual reading must be involved in what it sees. Taylor's direct [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P5 - Gebser|P5 — Gebser]] **sources** the pressure as being with the text and subtext. Care for the situation's outcome belongs to the seeing; impartiality does not require indifference.

Its absent-Father image makes the pathology exact. An unavailable final standard remains active as a demand; a surrogate image can then occupy its office. Apparent aloofness becomes a way of ruling while disavowing participation. This is Taylor's authorial development, not a quotation from Gebser. [A24 — Usurpation of Measure](../arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **extends** the office/standard consequence, while C09 retains the task of making the hidden position readable.

## #3

The corrected stained-glass image gives the operation a whole body. Originating white light figures Bimba; its full ordered spectrum figures QL. Differently made and positioned panes, their densities, angles, colours and lead seams figure MEF's refracting apparatus. The coloured image cast into the room is Pratibimba. Recognition reads the one light through the lawful differences of the display.

The seams retain source distinctions and translation limits. The projected image changes with sun, pane, room and viewer. Its changes disclose relations that a single fixed view concealed. The Original is not an average of images or a final picture assembled from their sum. QL belongs to the light's internal order; reducing it to the lead framework repeats the assignment explicitly corrected in the developmental quilt.

[C39 — MEF](C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** the refractive office; [A22 — World-Atlas](../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** the coordination of differing views. The image figures the operation; it does not use physical optics to prove metaphysics.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/maroski/maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words/SOURCE#maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words-q002|Maroski's transparency distinction]] **qualifies** the reading: transparency concerns the form manifestation takes. It is not another manifested object. Her companion seed/tree discussion preserves the co-presence of consciousness structures rather than a sequence which discards each predecessor.

The native first-, second- and third-person passage reaches context when their positions become jointly available. Its `180°→360°` articulation belongs to the QL theorem field, not to a claim that Gebser derived QL. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the personed `AM/IS` and its place in the whole eightfold. Context is not a fourth pronoun or an observer outside all views.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction): The viewer’s changed relation to the pane **figures** diaphaneity through the means of seeing. Material, colour, seam and placement become readable in what appears, and another view exposes an earlier occlusion. Seeing these conditions changes how the next judgment is made; merely describing them while keeping the criterion immune would leave the whole’s return unperformed.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) **figures** diaphaneity through a planetary picture that retains its location, time, production and exclusions in use. Its breadth ceases to decide the authority of its account in advance. The viewer becomes answerable within the disclosed relation, with exact image-asset provenance still a separate acquisition task.

The [complete window sequence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-changing-context) **figures** the medium’s disclosed operation as sun, pane, room and viewer change together. The changed image makes the conditions of its predecessor readable; contextual transparency reaches the next judgement through that difference.

The world-parent opening gives light its directions and boundaries. Taylor's encounter makes the conditions of this disclosure visible within the differentiated field it discloses. # C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position

## #0

Paśu is retained from the Śaiva field as the bounded knower/actor whose powers are contracted into a finite horizon. The position has real capacities. It can know, desire, choose, encounter and answer; its boundedness is the condition of these particular acts rather than their simple negation.

[A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** this genealogy. C15 retains the local position within it. A finite person or artificial agent is not assigned the entire doctrinal category merely by having limitations; the comparison must state which contraction and which operative capacity are at issue.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]], X, **sources** the authorial sixfold compression. The local position is located through these relations without being exhausted as their inventory.

## #2

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#3. # C24 — Fusion

## #0

Fusion is relation preserved only by erasing the distinctions through which its terms can meet. Its unity disables answerability: source and account, self and other, or differing positions can no longer be discriminated enough for a response to change their relation.

[C06 — Copula](C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) **grounds** the positive alternative, identification through difference. ## #1

Their difference remains operative within the relation; it is not an obstacle to be removed before the relation can count as whole.

[C50 — Dia / Syn](C50-Dia-Syn.md) **defines** that co-operation. A syn operation needs determinate terms to gather. Intimacy therefore differs from fusion through what each permits. Another's response can exceed expectation, change the relation or refuse a proposed course. The project preserves the non-devouring direction of love: entering relation does not authorise possession of the one encountered.

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT|direct Other/Mono development]] **sources** the exact asymmetry: the Other can be within Mono without being within me. # C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure

## #0

Māyā is used within the essay's Śaiva/tattvic field as **operative measure**: the power through which an unbounded field becomes a workable subject/object seam and finite horizon. A local world appears because some things become available while others remain withheld. The revealing and withholding belong to one operation.

[A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the contraction. Operative measure is Taylor's formulation of its positive work. Limitation supplies determinate capacity, knowledge, desire, time and order; it does not merely subtract pieces from an otherwise complete subject.

## #1

[C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the luminous/reflexive field from which the seam differentiates. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]], X, **sources** the authorial compression: universal subjectward and objectward orientations become explicitly differentiated; the kañcukas contract powers into a bounded experient and a world of determinate relations.

The contraction leaves its source operative. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti; the power of veiling is itself manifesting power. Māyā is therefore the horizon through which objects appear, not a hidden object behind the horizon and not the unobjectifiable Subject. Treating the horizon as the torus's hole would confuse the measure-making operation with the source it cannot enclose.

## #2

The five contractions give local action its terms. Kalā apportions efficacy; vidyā, knowledge; rāga, desire through incompletion; kāla, time; niyati, ordering or necessity. The finite knower can now do this, know this much, want this, act at this time and stand within these relations. [C15 — Paśu](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the bounded position; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa](C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the instrument through which its cognition differentiates.

These coordinates do not supply independent substances. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.72–75, **sources** the relation between contracted and expanded awareness and distinguishes vertical manifestation/return from the horizontal perceptual act. The bounded field is active: its knower moves toward an object and receives the movement back.

## #3

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#17. The `25 → 36` tattva gnomon|direct tattva-gnomon passage]] **extends** this anatomy through an Offered/Argued QL cross-reading. The exact difference `36−25=11=5+1+5` forms a row of five and column of five meeting at one corner. The reading places five pure powers and five contracted powers around Māyā's hinge; the Sāṅkhya twenty-five carry the bounded apparatus whose genesis is being reconsidered.

The arithmetic gives the comparison an operation more precise than a matching total. It does not show that Abhinavagupta constructed the tradition by adding a geometrical gnomon, or that every tattva has been mapped to a six-by-six coordinate. # C21 — Living Symbol / Idol

## #0

A living symbol is a determinate form whose efficacy remains related to a source it does not exhaust. Its visible content participates in a relation which can change both what becomes visible and the one capable of seeing it. An idol occupies that source-office and closes the return by which another determination could become possible.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **grounds** the distinction. Its living symbol is the whole `0/1` event, not the manifest `1` alone. A settled sign, an inherited shell and an idol have different dispositions: a sign can perform a useful limited office; the idol claims the office of the power which exceeds its form.

## #1

The direct manuscript's broken-token image makes the relation tangible. A fracture makes the absent counterpart operative in the present half. The token does not imitate a completed object elsewhere; it bears a particular relation through which recognition is possible. Neither half manufactures the match by declaring itself whole.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust]] **grounds** the present register3 use. The image is an authorial operational reading; detailed Greek institutional history retains its own evidence task. [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** the formal traversal which the token image refracts without historically proving it.

## #2

The psychic operation differentiates ordering capacity from a particular image. A dream, word, number or narrative can redistribute attention, affect and possible meaning beyond the maker's prior interpretation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the native `X/x` relation: determining capacity becomes legible through its indefinite instance, while another instance can differ.

The source relation therefore persists through novelty. An image cannot become the final portrait of the power which makes it symbolic. [C19 — Recognition](C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) **extends** the return from a known form through an unknown relation into a changed field of knowing.

## #3

Frank's protected encounter with [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk — Archetypes and Strange Attractors]], pp.69–73, **sources** the distinction between making a vehicle and commanding symbolic life. An image or name can be intentionally fashioned. Its transformative efficacy cannot be secured merely by labelling it symbolic or assigning it a mythic identity.

The mediated Tillich account in those notes holds four operations between two life-conditions: pointing and participation, opening world and opening the corresponding capacity of the interpreter, bounded by uncommanded arising and growth or death through response. This is a source encounter and authorial QL cross-reading, not an independently verified quotation from Tillich. Its consequence is concrete: a symbol changes with its reception, and its historical life can end.

## #4

Idolatry begins when the image's success is used to protect it from the source-relation which made it effective. The image-maker, institution or interpreter makes continued agreement the condition of admission. A form once capable of changing a life now demands that every life confirm the form.

[C27 — Protected Account](C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **extends** that governance operation. [C22 — Counterfeit Symbolon](C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon.md) **defines** the wider failure family. Exact description and strong commitment remain possible; the defect is that the account prevents what it discloses from revising its claim to authority.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-recognition-return): The veil recognised as Śakti **figures** an achieved image remaining alive through its source relation. Its finite form continues to disclose and act; another encounter can change its authority. The idolising frame instead prevents the witness from altering its criterion. Recognition therefore returns through the determinate world and its joy of manifestation, rather than abolishing the image which makes this encounter possible.

Taylor’s [cage and window](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#cage-window) **figure** the achieved form’s different uses. Both have a frame; the cage makes enclosure govern what can appear, while the window lets a definite aperture disclose beyond itself. A living symbol retains the determinate form through which encounter becomes possible and lets that encounter change its authority. The image’s return is the transformation of this relation, rather than an abolition of every frame or a guarantee that a deliberately fashioned symbol will become living.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **figures** the living symbol through the maternal body retained in what recognises it. An ideal image can instead replace the body with an account of what it ought to mean. Taylor’s corrected encounter keeps both object-resistance and the sustaining body able to alter that account.

The paper, mark, slash and erasure scene changes the reader's relation to the inscription. Its symbolic efficacy lies in this whole event of determination and renewed capacity. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold). An image stays living when another encounter can change its authority; the circle-costume tests the foreclosure of that return. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

The living return changes both interpreter and later symbolic efficacy. What a symbol has done becomes part of the field in which another encounter takes place. The same form can continue to work, acquire a narrower office or cease to evoke the relation it once carried. Preserving it as a historical sign need not counterfeit its former life.

[C61 — Symbolon Disclosure Architecture](C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **tests** the distinguishable registers in which that work can be recovered. C21 **returns-to** C19 and A18: the achieved image becomes answerable through its source, response and changed circumstances. Its precise form is retained without being required to contain every future expression of its determining capacity.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** the difference between a living God-image and an account defended against life. Job's address remains capable of questioning its relation, while the friends' explanation can protect itself by discrediting his testimony. Their need to receive his intercession makes the image answerable to the encounter it had judged. This is an authored psychic refraction of the telling, not a clinical diagnosis of its speakers.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** an administered image whose successful circulation does not make it a living symbol. The election recognises Six publicly while depriving his freedom-command of force; representation stays effective by protecting the relation that authorises it. The return asks whether the represented person's answer can alter that relation. The figure therefore tests source-answerability through the image's consequences, not through its vividness or popularity.

# C32 — Archetype

## #0

The image appears with a force its visible content cannot contain. It gathers associations, redistributes feeling and draws a life along paths no single interpretation commands. **Archetype** names the generative organisation made legible through such variable manifestations; the archetype as such does not appear as a final content-object beside them. [[A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos]] supplies the wider field of possible differentiation, while C32 retains this specifically psychic and symbolic office.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] begins with a dream, god, number, symptom, fantasy, narrative, concept or bodily intensity as a possible archetypal manifestation. The particular image gives an unknown ordering relation a local face. Its excess over a settled interpretation keeps that face open to further manifestation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|Image / Valuation]] owns the determinate image and its investment; it must not be substituted for the generative organisation.

The broken symbolon's seam makes the relation tangible. One half carries the shape of a counterpart it cannot manufacture alone; recognition depends on their relation. An image can similarly make its absent or unexhausted condition operative. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|Living Symbol / Idol]] marks the difference between an image that keeps this relation active and one installed as the exhaustive identity of its source.

## #2

The native QL relation is read first. `0/1` retains unrepresentable ground and representable mark through their relating stroke; `X/x` differentiates determining capacity from its indefinite particular. Archetypal recurrence is Taylor's psychic instantiation of this already derived relation. Across distinct images, the determining capacity becomes legible without becoming another image. The notation is authorial QL, not Jung's.

The whole traversal under [[A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations|the eight determinations]] prevents pattern from being isolated from its life: appearance questions, attracts and repels, gathers into recurrence, stakes a first-person relation and effects a particular transformation before returning toward its source. This is the author's cross-register movement. It does not make the sequence a historical Jungian derivation or reduce symbolic experience to six labels.

## #3

An attractor and a trajectory articulate different aspects of the dynamic comparison. A trajectory is an actual history through a state-space; the attractor organises recurrent behaviour that no single orbit exhausts. In the authorial psychic reading, what persists can be the organisation of transformation itself. Historical novelty therefore does not have to be the abandonment of every recurrent form.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C31-Complex|Complexes]] stabilise local affective organisations; symbols can intensify them, expose their boundaries, connect separated regions or enable a new regime. The full [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk encounter]] supplies the developmental dynamic middle. A recurrent image is not automatically a strange attractor, and the technical definitions of attractor, basin and bifurcation retain their mathematical requirements.

## #4

Amplification and transformation do different work. Amplification moves among manifestations so that one partial view becomes readable through another; transformation changes the lived trajectory and its possibilities. [[A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas|World-atlas]] gives the first operation a chart comparison, while the basin/trajectory account gives the second a dynamic comparison. An atlas is not an attractor. A shared motif alone establishes neither a transition map nor a common causal mechanism.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Homology and Analogy field]] requires a cross-cultural comparison to preserve the whole relation in each carrier: who acts, what changes, what returns and what the image cannot settle. The myth's historical transmission and the operation it performs remain different questions. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number|Psychoid Number]] asks the further psyche/physis question; it does not answer it merely by showing that a number occurs in both domains.

## #5→0

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **qualifies** the difference between a particular maternal image and determining capacity. The encountered body, cope and corrected reading give that capacity a situated manifestation. Neumann’s morphology provides shared archetypal structuration while the local encounter retains its own history and cannot become a universal template.

The Neumann whole articulates shared genesis through changing parental, bodily and heroic offices. Situated tellings and their temporal transformations remain distinct from this common archetypal articulation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round). The round, nurturing body, world-parent relation and transformed centre retain different archetypal offices within the shared field. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants).

An archetypal interpretation returns to the life it has interpreted. [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|Image and valuation]] asks what its image makes available or excludes; [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|individuation]] asks how the relation among agencies changes. The outcome is not a completed catalogue of the archetype. A life recognises its own achieved differentiation within a wider ordering relation and becomes capable of another encounter.

[[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|Cultural sensitivity to origins]] extends this return without enthroning a collective ego or appointing one culture's image as the universal form. C32 owns pattern-through-variable-manifestation; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture|Symbolon disclosure]] keeps its historical, psychic, formal and mythic warrants accessible in their respective homes.

# C31 — Complex

## #0

A complex organises what can matter before reflective judgment arrives. **A relatively autonomous psychic organisation of affect, image, memory, expectation and response**, it makes some evidence salient, some encounters threatening and some actions available. Its local order is an achievement of psychic life. [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|Complex as local arbitration regime]] identifies the danger when this derivative competence installs itself as the measure of the entire field.

## #1

The recurrent loop is operative: a selection of the encounter elicits affect; affect lends urgency and apparent certainty to a response; the response and its consequences confirm the initial selection. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|Image / Valuation]] supplies the image through which an Other or situation is met and the investment that makes it count. An image of threat can preselect evidence before an account of the threat has been consciously examined.

The complex's autonomy is functional and relational. It can speak and act against an ego's declared intention without being another complete person inside the person. The wider psyche is not an otherwise neutral container interrupted by an alien object. Its existing relations give the complex both its history and its power to recur.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] distinguishes complex, archetype, image and symbol through their different work. The complex stabilises a recurrent organisation of association and response; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype|archetypal dynamics]] supplies a generative recurrence which exceeds any particular autobiographical organisation; the image gives that organisation a particular appearance; the symbol can transform the organisation itself.

The basin comparison makes a boundary visible. A trajectory repeatedly returns toward an organisation, yet not every encounter belongs to the same basin. Perturbation can expose a boundary or lead to a different regime. Symbolic return is therefore not always restoration of the old equilibrium. Enough integrity to persist and enough openness to reorganise belong together. This is Taylor's developed dynamical/psychic relation, not a claim that a measured equation for every clinical complex has been supplied.

## #3

Frank's protected [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk encounter]] at pp.65–73 sharpens the distinction: archetypes as dynamics, complexes as structures, symbols as mechanisms of energetic transformation. The p.67 encounter makes the symbol capable of undoing a conscious category and permitting a more complex organisation. A symbol can also intensify an established complex; numinous force by itself does not certify successful return.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|The protected account]] names the usurpation: the local settlement exempts its own measure from revision while treating every new witness as further material for the same verdict. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration field]] keeps Arbitration-in-Crisis prior to its hybris flowering. Finite life must settle alternatives; failure occurs when the deciding office mistakes its local measure for source measure.

## #4

Neighbours identify different objects. A habit names a learned regularity of action; a schema a pattern for organising interpretation; a trauma-response a response related to traumatic experience; a subpersonality a particular model or personification of psychic plurality. None automatically supplies the complex's affective autonomy and local world-making office. A script or technical policy can repeat an analogous arbitration, but this does not establish that it is a psychic complex or that its system experiences possession.

The technical extension in the Van Eenwyk notes asks how harness, tools and world participate in an agent's recurrent organisation. [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|Monoculture]] tests the hidden local measure, and [[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|the Other]] tests whether encounter can change it. These are named functional applications; exact Jungian clinical attribution remains a separate source task.

## #5→0

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **figures** the maternal image as an active organiser of dependence and response. Protection, fear, receptivity and possession have different consequences for the life being borne. Recovering which relation acts makes the image’s local arbitration examinable without diagnosing a person from the emblem.

Maternal engulfment, paternal arrest and heroic fixation supply different images of an organising power claiming the whole. Centroversion returns those powers to a differentiated psychic relation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-hero-centroversion). Hungry local organisation can claim all incoming experience for its existing criterion; the returned relation changes that claim. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants).

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C34-Individuation|Individuation]] re-situates the complex without exterminating its acquired competence. A local agency can be recognised, related to others and made answerable without being allowed to impersonate the whole. The Self is not a larger complex promoted to chief executive. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|Recognition and individuation]] changes the relations among agencies and returns the person's account to what it had excluded. C31 supplies the local organisation whose jurisdiction changes in that movement.

**Provenance and debt:** A19/A21 recovery, the complete direct Symbolon Dynamics and Van Eenwyk SOURCE/protected NOTES supply the restored operation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE|Jung’s Aion]] carries the historical Self/shadow field but presently has no verified excerpt for exact autonomy/complex wording. Van Eenwyk's copied quotations also remain passage/edition leads. The earlier proposed `complex.md` carrier is not present in the live tree; no replacement provenance file is invented.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** a local arbitration regime whose image of justice organises feeling, expectation and evidence together. The friends do more than assert an isolated mistaken proposition: their valuation determines how Job's successive replies can appear to them. His continued address and their later rebuke change that jurisdiction. This authored comparison discloses the complex's operation without assigning the biblical speakers clinical identities.

**Depth Restoration:** canonical complex/arbitration/transformation operation restored; exact clinical and historical formulations retain named source debt.

A score replaces the person, an office claims the people who grant its standing, or a psychic formation dictates the meaning of every encounter.
