whole_evidence.text: --- title: "Uroboros, circulation and trickster" record_id: mytheme-uroboros-trickster record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Native authorial QL composition; source-distinct psychological refraction" source_ids: [taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy, neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness, jung-1978-aion-cw9-2, gebser-1985-ever-present-origin, taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3] human_amplification: relation-local --- # Uroboros, circulation and trickster ## #0 The snake bends until its head meets its tail. Its mouth receives its own body; the body curves around an opening. Hunger moves along a relation in which eater and eaten belong to one life. What enters is worked upon, incorporated and returned. The creature that receives its tail is itself implicated in what it consumes. Following this movement brings the eye home through the body, with the passage still belonging to the return. This is the whole image developed here in Taylor’s **native QL/Mytheme register**: the uroboros is toroidal, and its wholeness keeps the opening around which it takes form. The trickster wears the circle as its costume. Head and tail appear to complete a circumference, and that visible completion offers itself as the whole truth of the creature. The body’s depth, its mouth, the difference between inside and outside, and the opening through which self-relation remains possible disappear into the outline. The costume succeeds by making an actual feature exhaustive. Two consequences are already present in the mouth. Assimilation lets what enters change the life that receives it. Devouring closure takes everything into an order whose continuation must leave that order untouched. In Taylor’s Saturnine image, the gut is blocked: consumption arrests the generation it claims to sustain. The snake’s return becomes living when its apparent perfection can be reopened to the condition its own shape presupposes. Recognition restores that relation within the differentiated body. The head remains head, the tail remains tail, and what the passage has changed remains changed. The [authored whole-image recovery](../../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/MYTHEME-AND-DEEP-SOURCE-SEAMS.md#6-ouroboros--torus--trickster--the-whole-that-keeps-its-hole) **sources** this complete movement. The [final quilt, §§3–6 of the final weave](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** its ratified toroidal correction. Neumann’s round image and genesis sequence provide a shared archetypal articulation through which this movement is read; his chronology does not delimit the native operation. The universal claim here concerns self-differentiating relation, its occlusion and its return in the authorial field. Its force does not depend on attributing QL to every historical serpent image or making all cultures follow one empirical developmental schedule. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal whole, circle/sphere trickster, metabolic fork, Eden relation and complete eightfold recapitulation explicitly developed in the authored quilt. The historical source tasks named below retain their independent standing. ## #1 **Position** gives the creature a face. Seen as an outline, its curved body becomes a circle; conceived as a filled perfection, the round becomes a sphere. This is the trickster’s first office: the determinate image can be seen while the conditions of seeing it remain concealed. A circle is real as a circle. The error enters when its completeness answers for the living whole whose outline it presents. The quilt makes this closure sharp through the signed cancellation $$ (-1)+(+1)=0. $$ The arithmetic is exact. The authorial image assigns its cancelling zero the office of a terminated account: the opposed terms have been exhausted by the measure used to combine them. No property of circles or spheres is proved by this equation. Its mythemic work is to make the cost of the costume felt. Once all difference has been rendered as inverse quantity, the outcome has no place for the mouth’s activity or for the body’s changed return. **Opposition** restores the head and tail as oriented terms. The head reaches; the tail is reached. Hunger gives that orientation urgency. The body is simultaneously what seeks nourishment and what enters the seeking mouth. The relation cannot be understood from a neutral circumference alone, because the different offices of receiving and being received do work within it. Need and capacity, intake and expenditure, reserve and issue give the encounter its pulse. The mouth makes the polarity intimate. A hungry being’s relation to what sustains it enters its own continued formation. In Frank’s [Neumann encounter](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/NOTES.md), the p.27–35 sequence follows nourishment through hunger, ingestion, excretion and self-formation. The digestive image acquires its strength through the entire passage: the life receiving nourishment also becomes capable of acting and forming itself. Systole and diastole supply a rhythmic comparison within that encounter; the gut and the pulse retain their different bodily operations. The **two Ones** preserve what the costume conceals. In the native relation, `0` is One as non-objectifiable Self-Identity; `1` is All as Self-Difference, the manifest field and its indefinite particulars. The One becomes manifest through the All; the All receives its determining reality through the One. Neither office can simply swallow the other. [A11](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **grounds** this differentiated reciprocity. [A12](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **extends** its failure into monopoly: one local formation occupies the office of the whole and makes every further arrival answer to its measure. The hungry head becomes tyrannical at precisely this crossing from local appetite to exhaustive authority. ## #2 **Superposition** is self-eating made bodily. Taylor’s notation holds the relation through both orientations: $$ (0/1)/(1/0). $$ The form proceeding from its source and the form returning toward its source remain active together. The slash between them retains their mutual relation; it does not make eater and eaten indistinguishable. The mouth is the operative opening through which the two orientations meet. At this scale the image gives an inside to the outline and an activity to the meeting of its ends. The snake’s own formed life comes back through the aperture that permits it to be transformed. This is native relational notation. Its arithmetic boundary remains visible: ordinary division defines `0/1` and leaves `1/0` undefined. Holding both orientations in QL does not assign them an equal scalar value. The bodily image lets representable form meet its unrepresentable condition without converting that condition into another morsel. [A03](../../../episteme/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the limit: every successful representation is a further determination, including a representation of the act that made it. The mouth can be drawn, described and understood as an organ; the originating condition it figures does not become exhausted by that description. Assimilation develops the relation through a real change in what receives. Nourishment enters the creature’s powers of movement, response and formation. The body lives through a traffic whose achieved results become conditions for subsequent life. Taylor’s **meta-ballein/metabolism** articulation names this transformative passage, with **samāveśa** carrying the assimilative relation in the authored cross-reading. The Greek and Sanskrit histories retain their separate evidence tasks; the relation is active here as an authorial operation. Saturn-devouring is the obstructed version of the same pressure. The consuming power takes generation back into itself so that what issues from it cannot acquire a life capable of exceeding its rule. The mouth receives, but reception becomes detention. In the quilt’s bodily formulation, monopoly has a blocked gut. Its abundance of intake disguises the loss of circulation. This is the ratified Saturnine refraction of the uroboric whole; it does not supply an independently reconstructed Cronus/Saturn narrative, genealogy or ending. The distinction reaches love. A relation can nourish both participants only while their differences remain capable of affecting it. Refusal, resistance and an unexpected answer belong to this capacity. [C24 — Fusion](../../../episteme/concepts/C24-Fusion.md) **qualifies** the digestive image at its ethical crossing: participation in a whole does not authorise one participant to assimilate another person into its possession. The Other can be within Mono without being within me. [A27](../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **extends** that asymmetry. A mouth that takes every answer as confirmation has already become the closed account, however warmly it calls its consumption love. The Eden-serpent enters at this exact authored turn. The final quilt calls it the same figure in a fallen register: **the hole traded for the fork**. The opening that kept the relation to its source becomes a deciding division whose opposed values claim the entire field. Good and evil become a fork severed from the condition of their discrimination. Frank’s Neumann encounter at pp.114–121 reads the gain of differentiation together with guilt, suffering and loss, then asks whether distinction sustains a bond or attempts to deny it. The operation gives the fall a felt consequence: the discriminating life can come to experience its necessary differentiation as exile. This is Taylor’s QL refraction of the Eden relation, not a claim that Genesis names a torus or teaches these equations. Its return is the recovery of relation within discernment; the distinction between actions and their consequences continues to matter. ## #3 **Interposition** gives the complete creature its winding. The mouth, head, tail, body, inner and outer surfaces, and retained opening now belong to one articulated movement. Taylor’s `4+2` appointment keeps four explicate twisting field-lines and two implicates in play. In the final quilt’s image, the axis and the hole are gathered at `#0`, while `#5` is the whole enfolding the differentiated winding. The fourfold can turn and return because its implicate conditions remain operative. The [matheme of torus, covering and winding](../../../matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) **grounds** the exact topological neighbour: $$ T^2=\mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2, \qquad \chi(T^2)=1-2+1=0, \qquad \pi_1(T^2)\cong\mathbb{Z} imes\mathbb{Z}. $$ Its square has four sides before gluing, two generating edge classes, one vertex and one face after gluing. The matheme’s four-sides/two-generators correspondence and the quilt’s four-field-lines/axis-and-hole appointment have different counted objects. Their relation must remain readable across the change of register. In particular, a drawing’s central aperture is not a third generating loop or an extra surface cell. Let a path on the torus be `γ(t)=[2t,−t]`, for `0≤t≤1`. It returns to its starting address, while the lift beginning at `(0,0)` ends at `(2,−1)`. The creature’s homecoming now has an exact neighbouring operation: local closure can retain a difference in the wider relation. The integer pair records the winding class; the lifted path carries more of the traversal than its endpoint alone. The mythemic comparison preserves this retained difference. [A17](../../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **grounds** the return with retained displacement, and [C52](../../../episteme/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the distinct quotient, covering and reframing operations. The infinite plane cover is not the separate two-sheeted torus-to-Klein construction. **Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns the opening in the authorial appointment. Māyā is the measure-field wound around it.** Śakti’s winding makes the formal patterns through which manifestation reflects toward prakāśa in vimarśa. Pattern, measure and contraction give a determinate world its real capacities. The opening never becomes one more bounded patch among them. Śakti’s joy in Māyā belongs to this generative movement: articulation is a power of manifestation, and the particular body is its positive achievement. [A09](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), [C14](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) and [C15](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **ground** the distinction between originating condition, operative measure and bounded knower. The trick succeeds when the formed pattern makes its dependence unavailable to its own account. It can then portray its measure as self-grounding. Filling the hole in the familiar toroidal image would change the form whose wholeness was to be perfected. The same demand, lived psychically, makes coherence depend on excluding whatever could alter the achieved identity. [A16](../../../episteme/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the field of possible differentiation, while [C64](../../../episteme/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) **extends** the need to transform a containing account while retaining the local truths it had made incompatible. The [complete eight determinations](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) remain active through this image. The parent `/ = −/−` opens into `0/1`; appearance questions and asserts as `?/!`; hunger and issue articulate `−/+`; recurrent capacity becomes legible through the particular as `X/x`; `AM/IS` makes the relation personed; `∞/dx` holds the definite passage against its inexhaustible horizon; `1/0` returns the formed relation toward its source. These are the whole field’s eight turns, with six interior determinations bracketed by parent and return. They are not eight chronological phases assigned to a snake. [A18](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** their sequence and inversions: Being, Becoming and Knowing/unKnowing remain crossed by Essence, Constitution and Text–Texture. Both orientations carry the complete relation. Name and Power remain together, so that an achieved Image also carries the Work, expenditure and transformation of its coming to be. The reserve also enters Taylor's [Q27 energetics](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), which **sources** the earthlight and tokamak pair. In that authored comparison, earthlight carries unconfined discharge: what the completed surface left out becomes an event it must receive. Tokamak confinement carries a different relation to energetic power: the field holds charged plasma so that its activity can continue within an arranged containment. Release and holding therefore do different work. An opening is not simply a leak to be sealed, and containment need not be the devouring closure that prevents return. The quilt places the latent dot at the reserve beneath extension, the `−` under the manifest `+`. That reserve lets the pair deepen the creature's metabolic fork. A formed field which denies its conditions cannot account for their return; a field which holds activity through an answerable arrangement can sustain a further passage. The distinction concerns what the containing form permits and acknowledges. It does not make every discharge liberating or every confinement healthy. The uroboros's return has to retain both the source it cannot fill and the differentiated field through which power acts. [ITER's canonical source house](../../../episteme/sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/SOURCE.md#iter-what-is-tokamak-q001) **sources** the bounded technical instance: a doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber, charged plasma and magnetic confinement. It does not establish all field-line geometry or a universal preference for toroidal confinement. The earthlight remains the quilt's named image of unconfined discharge and the excluded ground's return; no particular observation, location, plasma mechanism or causal explanation of an earthlight event is verified here. Libido, prāṇa, Śakti, spanda and technical energy retain their distinct registers. **Human-amplified: yes** for the admitted discharge/confinement comparison, with both images witnessing the native operation rather than proving it. This whole **returns-to** [A17](../../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) with that bounded physical neighbour and **returns-to** [A18](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) with the reserve/extension relation intact. The [self-rolling wheel in the Neumann whole](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-self-rolling-wheel) **extends** this continuing formation from its exact p.18 authorial encounter. The wheel's winding composes the formed round about an opening it cannot turn into surface. Its movement and the paper's renewed inscription retain two different ways of making the next act possible. The source-specific En-Soph terminology remains there; this return keeps the wheel within the shared whole instead of treating its name as an interchangeable circular emblem. ## #4 The [Neumann whole](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) **grounds** the shared archetypal articulation: genesis and separation lead through heroic emancipation and transformation to centroversion. Its complete source sequence and changing parental offices remain there. [Neumann’s source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **historicises** the comparative psychological account; the present whole follows the bodily circulation and its trickster occlusion through that articulation. The uroboric round is therefore encountered within a sustained account of formation and differentiation. Frank’s notes at p.11 follow the round image’s capacity to gather paradox in a single apprehension. At pp.12–18 the womb, parents, mark and page, and the self-rolling wheel open different ways of approaching genesis. At pp.27–35 the round acquires appetite, digestive passage, formative power and the relation among introversion, extraversion and centroversion. The self-eating creature participates in this whole source encounter; extracting only a perfect circle would lose the bodily and developmental middle that gives it life. The variants in that encounter keep their own offices. The mother and child show nourishment through differentiated dependency. The account of Prajāpati’s self-creation and self-offering, with the horse/universe image at p.29, carries a generative body in the material Frank records through Neumann’s account of Deussen’s interpretation. It remains a nested encounter, not a newly verified primary Vedic telling. En-Soph at p.18 and the darkness/tohubohu discussion at p.106 belong to different inherited traditions; the authorial recapitulation reads them at the indistinct pole without making them historically identical. The world parents at pp.104–121 carry separation, light, orientation, opposing valuations, guilt and the enduring relation through which differentiation proceeds. Their four directions and day/night pair supply another specifically located `4+2` refraction in Frank’s p.108 note. These are substantial differences in what the images do, not interchangeable costumes for the snake. The p.33–35 encounter follows the differentiation of active and passive striving within the nutrient flow. Conception through eating and birth through excretion give distinct offices to what the uroboric image had held together. Its own output returning as food figures self-sufficiency; it is an image of autarchy, not a biological claim that a living organism needs no exchange with its environment. The earlier self-contained generative and later sexual relations retain their distinct phases in this source encounter. They do not license a fixed masculine/feminine assignment to every QL pole. Centroversion then gives the return a purpose beyond gathering more objects, whether inward or outward: the materials of both directions enter self-formation. In Frank’s reading, a differentiated life can be an end in itself while remaining related to the wider field that makes it possible. This autonomy is precisely what Saturnine detention prevents. The horse/universe passage also mentions a bull comparison without recovering its particular telling. The p.31 footnote leads through Neumann to Guénon’s nutritive/cognitive assimilation comparison and the proposed taste/knowing lexical branch. Those leads matter because they ask how receiving becomes understanding; they do not establish a universal sacrificial animal or a verified etymology. Their fuller source recovery remains outside the present telling. The mother–child relation likewise retains Frank’s proposed Mary/Sophia connection as a further whole-to-whole return, with its own source and amplification work still required. The [mark, paper and erasure scene](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold) **compares** a second performable return: the completed inscription can disappear while the capacity to inscribe remains. Its complete act belongs to the Neumann whole. Here its consequence returns to the mouth: releasing an achieved form can renew the capacity by which another is received. The [world-parent and paśu correction](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **qualifies** the return of this body: in Frank’s reading of the Ātman passage encountered at p.105, I-am recognition precedes the separation into husband and wife. Prakāśa–vimarśa already belongs to the field within which the bounded subject-position forms. The complete eightfold articulated above retains that ontological order; the psychic Self/ego relation remains a refraction of Taylor’s native `X/x`. [Jung’s *Aion*](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **sources** the distinct historical Self/shadow horizon. The developed psychic relation keeps ego, persona, complexes, archetypal agencies and wider Self differentiated. [C31 — Complex](../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md) **defines** the local affective organisation; [C32 — Archetype](../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **defines** the generative-pattern office. The Self is not a larger complex that acquires the right to consume the others. [A19](../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) **extends** the hungry local authority; [A20](../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) **tests** what its image makes available and excludes; [A21](../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **extends** the altered relations through which a particular life returns. [Gebser](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **historicises** a further, distinct change in seeing: perspective’s achievement becomes readable within a context that releases its exclusive claim. Here that relation returns to the eye that first saw only a circle. [A04](../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and [C09](../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) **extend** the visibility of the view’s conditions. [A22](../../../episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **qualifies** the passage among views: the atlas coordinates situated disclosures without manufacturing an all-containing final picture. Gebser’s account does not derive the torus, just as Neumann’s does not derive QL. These source relations retain their publication limits. Neumann’s consulted Hull translation is the 2014 Princeton Classics reissue; the protected notes’ page numbers remain encounter locators pending collation, including comparison with the 1954 pagination. Their copied sentences have not become verified quotations. The Jung house has no verified excerpts, and Gebser’s direct quotations still require selected locators. Historical ouroboros artifacts and independent Eden, Saturn and Vedic tellings remain source-specific recovery tasks. The present whole develops the already authored composition without supplying invented episodes to settle those tasks. ## #5→0 The snake returns with its hole intact. What seemed an absence in the account becomes intelligible as constitutive of the form. Hunger still moves, but a received thing can now change the terms of receiving. An image still gives a face to the life, but another encounter can alter that face’s authority. [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) **defines** this return: the image’s efficacy remains in relation to what it cannot exhaust. The same image becomes an idol when its success is made a reason to prohibit that relation from changing it. The whole [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis field](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the lived consequence at operational evidence register 3. **Arbitration-in-Crisis** gives a finite deciding office its actual task; hybris flowers when the local measure claims source authority. **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** permits Regard: the context and Other become visible through the determination. **Resolution-in-Reconciliation** permits anamnesis, recognition and return. The generated relations do the work before their semantic flowerings are named. The serpent’s recognition is accordingly more than learning that it has a hole. Its achieved settlement becomes answerable to the conditions and lives it had excluded. [A26](../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **extends** this return into worldhood. Intake, response and durable result participate in the formation of the operative interior; the interior’s real boundaries exist through a wider field. [A34](../../../episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **grounds** the native order of dependence without turning the world into a private ego’s contents. The body/world image supplies no verdict about artificial phenomenality. Its practical pressure is that a formed account must remain capable of receiving what changes its subsequent operation. There is also a completion in which the next circuit need not be demanded. [A17’s cyclic and telic returns](../../../episteme/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **qualify** circulation: a completed act can return into another performance, and it can come to rest in recognition of the silence from which performance issues. Making wholeness depend on perpetual production would restore the consuming hunger at the very point of release. The mouth’s opening allows both renewed articulation and the relinquishment of an achieved form’s demand to continue. The [Draft 3 source](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **sources** the terminal authorial consequence: the completed offering is released into lives whose future it cannot command; remembering returns as a daily office. The whole **returns-to** [A36](../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) through that consequence: the exact sign returns into living Symbol. Arithmetic keeps its exactness, and the image keeps its history. The whole [Homologia / Analogia field](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing at evidence register 3: the mathematical lift, psychic transformation, digestive image and ontological return preserve a specified relation while retaining their different objects and warrants. The head no longer has to claim the entire creature. The body can receive, transform and release. Its winding remains determinate; its source remains inexhaustible; the life that returns has another encounter before it.

# 6. Ouroboros · torus · trickster — the whole that keeps its hole

**Office:** supporting-visible / deep-bearing project-composed Mytheme with exact Matheme neighbour; historical ouroboros and Neumann source work remain distinct from the project's toroidal appointment.

`[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/04-MATHEMATICAL-SUBSTRATE|§3 — Mathematical Substrate — Inherited Region Recovery]]` **grounds** the exact torus relation; `[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/05-PSYCHOID-FLOWERING|§4 — Psychoid Flowering — Inherited Region Recovery]]` **returns** it into individuation and image; `[[THREAD-INTAKE-WHOLE-RELATIONAL-UNITS#Intake 001 — Self-Identity · Limit · Objective Internality · Confession · World|Intake 001]]` **extends** the inner-horizon and limit reading. The late quilt's user-authoritative correction controls this section: **the ouroboros is read toroidally; the hole belongs to Anuttara/Paramaśiva/#0, while Māyā is the measure-field wound around it rather than the hole itself.**

## The whole image

The ouroboros first appears to the eye as a snake closing upon itself: head meets tail and a line becomes a ring. That apparent circle is indispensable and insufficient. The snake is not merely a line whose ends happen to touch. It has a body, an inside and outside, a mouth through which what is other becomes what nourishes the body, and an opening around which the closed figure is organised. Its act is simultaneously return and metabolism: what goes out becomes what comes in; what is taken in changes the thing that takes it in; the returned path is not the untouched point from which it began.

The project's **trickster** enters at the moment the eye lets the visible circumference stand for the whole. The ring passes itself off as circle or sphere — a closed perfection whose centre can be treated as a point or whose interior can be imagined as filled — while the operative opening disappears from the account. The trick is not that the circumference is false. It is that a true visible determination becomes falsely exhaustive when the absence through which it is organised is read as nothing relevant.

The torus makes the missing relation exact. Its surface and its hole are inseparable in the determination of the form even though the hole never becomes another patch of surface. Close the handle and the topology changes. A loop may close on the torus while its lift remains displaced on the infinite cover; local return can therefore coexist with retained traversal-history. The form comes home without cancelling the path by which it came home.

This is the whole the ouroboros needs in the project. The mouth is not merely an emblem of endless recurrence; it is the operative aperture through which the body can take in, transform and return what it is not. Self-relation remains alive because the whole does not consume the opening into positive content.

## Matheme and the `4+2` appointment

The exact mathematical torus remains a distinct Matheme carrier:

```text
T² = R² / Z²
χ(T²) = 0
π₁(T²) ≅ Z × Z
```

The project's broader QL appointment reads the toroidal whole through the two implicate poles and four explicate relations already generated by `0/1 = 4+2`. The late correction sharpens the image:

```text
#0
hole · unobjectifiable centre · originating condition
        ↓
#1–#4
winding / differentiated surface relations
        ↓
#5
achieved whole · circulation · returned form
        ↓
5→0
surface returns to the opening its identity presupposed
```

This is an authored cross-register relation, not a claim that the ancient ouroboros encoded modern algebraic topology or QL. The mathematical result establishes its own exact torus operations; the Mytheme lets those operations become lived and psychologically consequential.

## Māyā, the winding and the trick

The distinction from Māyā is essential. **Māyā is not the absent centre.** In the mature tattvic reading Māyā is Śakti's power of finite articulation: the measure-field, patterning and contraction through which a local surface/world becomes definite around what cannot itself become one more item of that surface.

Necessary limitation is therefore not the trickster's lie. Without bounded winding there is no determinate path, no local identity and no world in which a return can occur. The fall happens one order later:

```text
finite winding becomes a real form
        ↓
its opening disappears from its own account
        ↓
the formed surface performs as self-grounding whole
        ↓
local closure is mistaken for absolute closure
```

**Hybris is the trick succeeding at the level of measure:** the bounded form forgets that its very identity depends upon what it cannot convert into bounded content.

## Jung / Neumann / individuation seam

The inherited Jungian and Neumannian round/uroboric material remains source-bearing psychic history. The project's toroidal appointment must not be retrojected into those authors as though they supplied the topology. Its gain is a correction to the *operation* the project needs from the image: individuation is not an ego becoming a perfect closed sphere. The ego, complexes, persona, archetypal agencies and inherited psychic formations remain differentiated; the wider Self-relation prevents any local formation from becoming the whole.

The torus therefore **figures** differentiated indivisibility: the local surface becomes more coherent by retaining relation to an unfilled condition, not by sealing that condition away. `[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/diaphaneity|Diaphaneity]]` and `[[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/08-deferential-intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]]` later give epistemic forms to the same return.

## What full recovery changes

A compressed “ouroboros = eternal return” loses precisely what this project needs. The whole image carries mouth, metabolism, inside/outside, return, opening, apparent circle and toroidal depth together. It shows why **closure and wholeness are not synonyms** and why an absent condition can be structurally present without becoming a positive object.

For native 018, the ouroboros/torus/trickster should therefore remain one whole Mytheme with at least three explicitly separated relations:

- historical/psychological ouroboros and round-image source work;
- exact mathematical torus operations;
- the project's authored trickster/toroidal appointment and `4+2` return.

**Source debt:** recover the exact historical ouroboros carriers actually intended for publication; keep Neumann's own wording and stadial office distinct; keep standard topology sources separate from the QL reading. None of those debts weakens the current authorial relation.

Frank's notes give the eight determinations a complete mythic recapitulation in one author, with page anchors: `−/−` En-Soph/tohubohu (pp. 18, 106); `0/1` the world parents' separation; `?/!` the coming of light; `−/+` hunger as systole/diastole; `X/x` ego against the unconscious ground; `AM/IS` "I am I" (with Frank's paśu correction — the Bṛhadāraṇyaka passage Neumann quotes at p. 105 shows recognition preceding separation: "I am" is prakāśa's vimarśa before pati/patni, and Neumann collapses prakāśa-vimarśa into ego); `∞/dx` the great round (Mono/Poly pleromatic); `1/0` the hero's descent and return. Frank's lock-gloss: this is the delineation of the Māyic threshold — the first unfolding into differentiation of the `0/1`, the `4+2` (+2) retaining its conditions of transformation and genesis as explicit qualities. Candidate grounding: Argument 13 (tattvic differential field) and Argument 20 (advent) via phylogenetic recapitulation. Open placement question, carried to harmonisation: plate/appendix object vs woven §4 prose register.

### 4. The energetics cap (Frank-locked)

The five-register energetics discipline closed by: the somatic floor (Van Eenwyk's systole/diastole, the gut as the body's torus, hunger/striving at `−/+`) and the physics witnesses (plasma oscillation, magnetic confinement, Floquet-driven systems from Frank's GPT chat logs — witnesses only, never theorem-authority). Frank's user-authoritative stipulation: the torus carries formal reality through all energetic registers (magnetism, Floquet physics). The cap's spine: no register's "energy" is another's substance; the torus is what persists across them (see §14 for the mathematical wing this session added).

### 5. The uroboros-torus-trickster weave (user-authoritative correction, walked across the fourfold)

The uroboros is the torus — the `4+2` — not the sphere or circle; all prior corpus treatments that read the round as sphere/perfect-circle stand corrected. The snake is the trickster precisely because the torus is passed off as the sphere (the Eden-serpent as the same figure in fallen register: the hole traded for the fork). Walked across the ponere/ballein fourfold: **position** — the circle as costume, the sphere's dead arithmetic `(-1)+(+1)=0`; **opposition** — the head/tail hunger axis; **superposition** — self-eating as `(0/1)/(1/0)` made bodily, the mouth as the operative hole; **interposition** — the uroboros as genus-one `4+2`: four explicate twisting field-lines (`#5` the enfolding whole) and two implicates (the magnetic axis + the hole = `#0`). Meta-ballein (metabolism, etymologically) accounted at this register: circulation that nourishes (assimilation/samāveśa) versus Saturn-devouring (the blocked gut as monopoly's metabolism). ### 6. Māyā is not the hole (user-authoritative correction)

The hole is Paramaśiva/Anuttara, the `#0`, the kṛtṛ pole. Māyā is the formal patterns Śakti's winding makes to reflect back to the hole/prakāśa via vimarśa — the measure-field, not the void it measures around. Śakti has joy/ānanda for Māyā. The plasma log already carried this unknowingly ("the axis the plasma can never occupy" = the Anuttara doctrine in physics vocabulary). Consequence carried through every layer below: wherever the weave says "the hole," its owner is Anuttara; wherever it says "Māyā," it means the winding's pattern-field.

Hull, was first published in English by Princeton University Press in 1954 (Bollingen Series XLV); the German original, *Ursprungsgeschichte des Bewusstseins*, appeared in 1949. **Consulted edition (in hand, 2026-08-05):** the Princeton Classics reissue, Princeton University Press, 2014, paperback, ISBN 978-0-691-16359-8. (Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014), {page}. **Shortened note:** Neumann, *Origins and History of Consciousness*, {page}. **Bibliography (consulted edition):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Foreword by C. G. Jung. Princeton Classics ed. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014. Originally published in German, 1949; first English edition, 1954. **First English edition (historical record):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Bollingen Series XLV. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 1954. ## Source scholarship Neumann's work is the post-Jungian historical morphology of ego formation: a phylogenetic account in which the individual ego's development recapitulates the history of consciousness as it is carried in myth. The mythic sequence — uroboros → Great Mother → separation of the world parents → birth of the hero → slaying of the mother → slaying of the father → transformation → liberation of the captive — is read as the progressive differentiation of ego-consciousness from the maternal-unconscious ground. Part II maps the same sequence onto the historical stages of ego-consciousness proper. Relevant operations for this essay: - **The uroboros** — the self-containing round, the pre-egoic psychic whole that holds both parents in one figure; the psyche's own image of the undifferentiated condition before the cut. - **The Great Mother** — the maternal uroboros as the first object-face of the unconscious; the archetype's split into good/bad mother. - **The separation of the world parents** — the first differentiation of the primordial couple (Father Heaven / Mother Earth); the principle of opposites born from the one round. The split of the archetype into good and evil figures (the two parents, the twins) belongs to this same movement. - **The hero** — the evolving ego-consciousness; the hero's slayings (of the mother, of the father) are the ego's achieved differentiations, and his descent/return is the relation back through the ground it left. - **The transformation stage** — consciousness opening beyond the ego-hero toward the transpersonal; the inner counterpart of the ego's outward victories. - **The ascent of consciousness and the species-name (p. 16, lead)** — consciousness as the "unnatural" thing in nature, specific to the species that "has justly styled himself Homo sapiens"; the struggle between the specifically human and the universally natural constitutes the history of conscious development. Transcription pending collation against the physical 2014 copy. The word-field this passage opens (homo/humus, sapiens/sapientia) is the project's own reading, carried in the earth/taste/wisdom etymology history; it is not Neumann's claim. Neighbouring series: Neumann's stadial morphology and Gebser's structures of consciousness (archaic → magical → mythical → mental → integral) are both phylogenetic, structural accounts of consciousness; their methods, periodisations, and objects differ, and any relation drawn between them must be an operational homology, not an identification. whole_evidence.text: --- record_id: mytheme-neumann-images title: Neumann images and plate relations aliases: - Neumann images and plate relations record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: Argued from source_ids: - neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - jung-1978-aion-cw9-2 - gebser-1985-ever-present-origin - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 --- # Neumann images and plate relations ## #0 The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them can stand apart and call them parents. In Neumann's creation sequence, heaven and earth, nourishment and danger, containing body and emerging child have yet to acquire the separateness through which a world becomes inhabitable. The round holds their possibility together. Its apparently enclosed outline carries the life that will differentiate it: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth. The future ego depends upon this containing life before it can represent that dependence. The first pressure in the image is therefore genesis: how a world and a centre within that world become distinct through a relation neither creates alone. This whole carries **shared archetypal structuration**: genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. It is the archetypal ground through which geographically situated tellings and temporal developments become comparable. Geography gives each telling its people, language and historical home; temporality gives its transformations their order and duration. Those registers remain distinct from the common structure disclosed here. The universal field belongs to the essay's native QL account; Neumann supplies a developed psychological morphology through which that field receives an imaginal and bodily refraction. His sequence is neither the derivation of QL nor a geographical address for the universal. [Neumann's source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **sources** the telling: the uroboros, Great Mother, separation of the World Parents, birth of the hero, slaying of mother and father, liberation of the captive and treasure, then the Osiris transformation. His book presents these as stages in the development of consciousness. The source's stadial claim remains attributable to Neumann. The essay's structural priority of relation does not require every society or person to have passed through this single historical sequence. Equally, the source's historical limitations do not reduce the shared archetypal operation to a merely local European image. In the first round, the paternal and maternal are still together. The uroboros can contain both without assigning them the exclusive offices they will receive after separation. Calling it mother at this point emphasises enclosure and nurture; calling it the unity of the parents emphasises the difference it contains before that difference becomes an opposition for a subject. These are distinguishable relations within the image. A single outline cannot settle them. Neumann's movement begins when what contained the ego becomes something the ego can face, desire, fear and resist. The telling below is a paraphrased reconstruction from the canonical source account and the page-anchored encounter preserved beside it. The encounter is not a verified transcript of Neumann. Its source leads and Taylor's authored responses are distinguished throughout; the external quotation and edition-collation debts remain at the return. ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round. ## #2 Separation of the World Parents opens the interval in which a world can appear. Heaven is distinguishable from earth; light can enter the space between them. An undifferentiated enclosure becomes an articulated field with directions and contrasts. The ego emerges within this opening as a position able to discriminate. What appears outside it becomes nameable because the act of differentiation has also given the observer a place. The transmitted creation scene at the encounter's p.105 lead requires its own sequence. The primordial person recognises itself, then divides into the paired figure of man and woman previously held as if in an embrace. Self-recognition precedes sexual separation in this telling. The androgyne therefore performs a relational office: the two who become partners arise through differentiation of a prior togetherness. The image places sex and gender within a genesis of relation; its use here depends upon preserving the before, the embrace, the division and the changed relation afterward. The independent primary passage and its exact translation remain a source debt. Neumann's psychological reading stresses the achievement of ego identity and the discriminating consciousness that says I am I. Taylor's response separates that achievement from the more primordial self-recognition expressed in the native relation. Prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when an ego takes possession of an identity; the finite experiencer and its inner instrument are determinations within the field of appearing. This authored distinction **returns-to** [the tattvic differential field](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), and **qualifies** [the bounded subject-position](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) and [the inner instrument](../../../episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). The acquisition of a determinate I is a real formation. It cannot retrospectively produce the awareness through which the acquisition appears. **Human-amplified: yes** for this explicit correction in Taylor's encounter; the psychological and Śaiva source offices retain their own evidence requirements. Light brings more than a collection of visible objects. In the leads at pp.106–109, an oriented world appears: above and below, before and behind, inside and outside, I and you, sacred and profane, good and evil. Boundaries make a precinct, a possession, a law and an order of action possible. Some of those institutional consequences are Taylor's authored extension of the encounter, not a verified universal history derived from Neumann. Their formal pressure is exact: a measure both reveals a field and selects what will count within it. [Māyā as operative measure](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **qualifies** this refraction. Differentiation is productive; its danger begins when the selected measure conceals its dependence upon a wider field. The image cannot be held to a fixed light/good and dark/bad dictionary. Light names disclosure from one position; what that position leaves unlit belongs to the same field. Father and mother, active and receptive, inner and outer likewise change office with the direction of the relation. Taylor's local p.108 appointment of night at #0, day at #5 and four directions at #1–#4 gives this encounter a 4+2 articulation: the spatially specified field is held through implicate conditions of appearance and return. **Human-amplified: yes** for that local appointment. It does not appoint every creation myth to six universal episodes or make time and space interchangeable. The twins give this danger two faces within one genesis. Taylor's [core theorem account, IV](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** the named Ohrmazd/Ahriman appointment: the broken halves of a prior `0` become enemies when their division is made to deny their belonging. [Q27's energetics and Neumann return](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** the same operation at the good/evil twins. Their opposition has real force; what changes is how the relation between them is held. Through `/`, their different valences still have one ground. When the stroke becomes addition between isolated signs, `(-1)+(+1)=0`, the meeting cancels them. When it becomes subtraction, `(-1)-(+1)=-2` or `(+1)-(-1)=+2`, one side takes the span as its own. The other is then encountered only as what must disappear for the governing side to be whole. The return has to preserve the two who can recognise their shared genesis. Blending them would destroy the difference through which recognition occurs; victory understood as abolishing the other's ground would perpetuate the divorce. The prior `0` returns as their condition, rather than as the null result of their collision. The narrative pressure is therefore the same one that will meet the hero: what kind of separation permits a life in relation, and what kind makes continued separation its war? This authored image **returns-to** [A13's two logics](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) through the changed operator, and **returns-to** [A18's complete field](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) without substituting two gods for its eight determinations. **Human-amplified: yes** for this existing Taylor operation, now made explicit in its assigned whole. Ohrmazd and Ahriman retain the naming supplied by the core; no independent Zurvanite telling, chronology, ritual or account of an historical orthodoxy has been recovered here. The core's fall-administering-itself judgment is its mythemic interpretation. Historical attribution remains a separate source task. Neumann's comparative morphology supplies the shared separation field; it is not being cited as the source of Taylor's notation or as verification of this named religious history. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. The emerging ego suffers the break it must accomplish. Its weakness and dependence do not disappear because it can name itself; the power of discrimination exposes them differently. The separation cannot simply be reversed without surrendering the differentiated life it enabled. This is why the story must pass through the hero. Something has to bear the cost of leaving while finding a relation to what has been left. ## #3 The hero is born within the world opened by the separation. Neumann's sequence then carries two emancipations: the slaying of the mother, followed by the slaying of the father. The maternal struggle addresses the engulfing origin from which the hero must become distinct. The paternal struggle addresses the authority that can arrest that emergence in an inherited order. If the telling stopped after escape from the mother, the father's law could simply inherit the power of enclosure. Keeping both struggles in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, rather than to the replacement of one captor by another. The violence belongs to the mythic and psychological telling. Its operation is differentiation from an overwhelming archetypal claim. Neumann's historically gendered morphology remains visible as his account. The page's relational reading follows the changing offices in the drama, including the earlier androgyne and the later possibility of partnership. Removing those changes would turn a developing relation into a static classification of persons. The next movement is the captive, the treasure and liberation. In the book's order this precedes the Osiris transformation. The achieved power to separate is now tested by what it releases and what becomes available through release. A captive liberated into another form of possession would leave the deeper problem intact. That last sentence states the essay's authored pressure upon the image: heroic efficacy has to be judged by the relation it makes possible, including the freedom of what it encounters. It does not invent a missing passage in Neumann's account. The Osiris division then carries the book's culminating transformation office. Death and transformation prevent the developmental movement from closing as the hero's permanent occupancy of a victorious identity. The canonical source navigation warrants this office and sequence; it does not yet warrant a detailed retelling of every Osiris episode. Detailed Osiris episodes require separately recovered primary tellings and comparative passages. Here the consequential change is that an ego strong enough to emerge must also become capable of transformation beyond its established form. Centroversion gathers the movement. The formation of a whole personality requires traffic between the centre and the powers from which it differentiated. Both engulfment and sovereign isolation obstruct that traffic. The former gives the centre away; the latter makes its achieved form the measure of the whole. The centre develops by admitting what changes it while retaining enough differentiation to respond. This source-specific psychological account **returns-to** [individuation and recognition](../../../episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md). [Jung's *Aion*](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the psychic distinction between ego and encompassing Self; it supplies no authorship of the notation `X/x` and no retrospective proof of Taylor's derivation. Taylor's encounter leaves the hero/spiritual-avatar distinction as a live question. The heroic sacred marriage and uroboric reabsorption cannot be merged simply because both images contain union. One follows differentiation and can sustain relationship; the other can abolish the separate position through which relationship is lived. Whether a particular avatar drama carries a different office requires its own whole telling. **Human-amplified: no** for closing that unresolved identification. The story recovered here has earned a return through differentiated participation; it has not earned permission to treat all transformations as the same event. ## #4 Taylor's paper scene makes the return performable. Begin with a blank sheet. Write `1`. Attend to the paper on which the mark appears and write `0`; attend to the act that distinguishes and relates them and inscribe the slash. The written `0/1` is now itself a determinate figure on the sheet. It too can be taken as `1` relative to the field through which it appears. Erase it. What disappears is the inscription; the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing has not been cancelled by the disappearance of this form. The sheet is an image within that capacity, not the literal substance of unobjectifiable awareness. The changed reader can begin again carrying the operation just performed. **Human-amplified: yes** for this paper/mark/slash/erasure operation in Taylor's protected Neumann encounter. The paper scene carries the more intimate pressure of Taylor's p.17 [authorial encounter](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/NOTES.md), which **sources** the connection between uroboric incest and erasure. In the encountered image, desire turns toward being dissolved and absorbed into the round. Taylor reads the `1` slipping back into `0`, then makes that movement performable on the page. The first mark, its acknowledged ground and the slash have all become a written figure. Erasing that figure releases its claim to stand as the ground it has named. The page can receive another inscription; the capacity to distinguish remains live. This changes what dissolution can accomplish. Uroboric reabsorption can surrender the differentiated position altogether; the enacted erasure can instead leave a reader able to begin again with knowledge of the inscription's dependence. The sacred marriage retains another office: differentiated partners sustain a generative relation rather than disappearing into undifferentiated containment. The p.17 encounter connects the incest motif to *hieros gamos* while questioning the priority assigned to hero and spiritual avatar. That question remains open. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's incest–self-relation–erasure amplification; **human-amplified: no** for settling the hero/avatar hierarchy. The copied Neumann passage remains uncollated, and this native use does not turn it into a quotation-ready source claim. The next page lead gives the renewed act a moving image: the self-rolling wheel. Taylor's p.18 encounter places En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel, then follows its rolling as a continuing self-composition about the unobjectified opening. The formed round must keep being made; its movement is the winding and weaving of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once and left inert. The paper's capacity for another inscription and the wheel's continuing composition meet at this renewal. Each achieved figure belongs to the field through which another figure can appear. The wheel thus **returns-to** [the uroboros's interposition](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition): a locally completed round can retain the passage through which it was made and return with a difference. The opening remains constitutive without becoming another patch of surface. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's self-composition and Text/Texture appointment. En-Soph's historical terminology, Neumann's exact p.18 wording and the encounter's proposed Whitehead comparison retain their independent source standing. Neither perpetual mechanical motion nor a topology theorem is established by a self-rolling image. The scene **figures** [the Two Ones](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and **returns-to** their concept, [0 = One, 1 = All](../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md). `0` bears the uncounted One; `1` bears All, the whole manifest field as well as each indefinite particular within it. The contrast cannot be reduced to blank material and one isolated item. The first mark opens the possibility of a world of marks. Their plurality is real, and their common condition does not become one giant object beside them. The scene consequently **returns-to** [Mono/Poly](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md): the whole is structurally prior to its determinations, while each determination contributes a real difference to the field that returns. [The native theorem spine](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the complete movement. [Six Positions, Eight Turns](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **defines** the exact relation between the positional body and its bracketed traversal: `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. These are eight determinations of one relation, with parent and return bracketing six interior determinations. They are not eight Neumann stages, and they are not the six headings of this page. The authored mythemic refraction follows their distinctions rather than deriving them from an image. The undelimited `−/−` receives the encounter's unbounded and unformed fullness. The ratified recapitulation brings En-Soph at the p.18 lead and tohubohu at p.106 to this office while retaining their distinct inherited traditions. At `0/1`, world-parent genesis figures the emergence of distinct offices within one relation. At `?/!`, the opening of light becomes the availability of a determinate answer whose question remains live. What appears can be specified because the field was capable of determination before this specification. At `−/+`, hunger, intake and expenditure give polarity its bodily tension. The two directions can work through each other; abolishing their distinction would abolish the operation. At `X/x`, determining capacity receives an indefinite particular without being exhausted by it. This is **Taylor's native QL notation**. Ego and unconscious, or ego and encompassing psychic whole, supply a named psychic refraction after that relation has been derived. At `AM/IS`, recognition becomes sayable from first-person presence and third-person predication. The slash carries the relational encounter through which those sayings meet, including the second-person address that changes both speaker and what can be said. The primordial I-am and the bounded ego's identity therefore cannot be silently equated. At `∞/dx`, the inexhaustible field meets exact local determination. The great round can figure the field carried in each finite expression, while the finite expression remains exact in its own office. An image of a circle does not establish an analytic theorem. At `1/0`, the determination returns toward the condition it cannot contain. The descent and return, the transformed personality, and the erased inscription can figure this movement precisely because each leaves a difference that has been undergone. The return is no longer unconscious containment before the separation. **Human-amplified: yes** for this eightfold refraction as explicitly developed and corrected in the authored quilt; its formal universality belongs to QL, and its Neumann correspondences remain **Argued from** the source encounter. The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition. The same cost requires both Name and Power. Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image are accompanied by Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love and Work. The visible image arrives through something lived: a need met, an alternative relinquished, a decision carried, a relation sustained. Power includes generativity and care as well as its possible capture. The Great Mother cannot simply stand for pathology, any more than the father's authority automatically stands for truth. This whole **figures** the coequal series by following what formation costs and what its return releases. The page's result is an image capable of entering another life, answerable to the work through which it came. Taylor's toroidal correction belongs at this point of developed relation. Neumann's circular perfection remains the source image; the authored refraction gives the uroboros a hole and a traffic through which taking becomes transformation. Position can present the round as a finished circle; opposition exposes head and tail, appetite and food; superposition makes their self-eating relation active in `(0/1)/(1/0)`; interposition articulates the four explicate movements together with the implicate axis and opening, with #5 enfolding what has been traversed. The trickster's circle or sphere can conceal that operative opening. The distinction concerns what the image permits the reader to do, and does not claim that every circular drawing is topologically a torus. The independent [uroboros, circulation and trickster whole](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **tests** whether shared archetypal structure has been mistaken for a closed picture; it owns the developed drama to which this local relation returns. In that authored correction Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā bears measure in manifestation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal correction, its four operations and this allocation in the ratified quilt. No claim that Neumann taught toroidal mathematics follows. [Homology and analogy](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing: the relation must state what operation is preserved, what register changes and what evidence remains with its original source. ## #5→0 The separation returns as a question of love or war. Taylor's p.121 encounter makes knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with: a distinction can individuate two terms in their relation, or claim that its cut has abolished what relates them. The marriage image bears the indelible bond of a shared genesis. Even denial takes place through the field it denies. This is a formal and mythemic assertion about relation. Separation made the world and the responsive centre possible. Its return has to preserve that achievement. The exact difference **returns-to** [the two logics of two](../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). Polar distinction is necessary. Its collapse into cancellation or appropriation is a different operation: `(-1)+(+1)=0` cancels the signed terms, while `(-1)-(+1)=-2` and the inverse subtraction `(+1)-(-1)=+2` carry the two appropriative orientations. The native relation `(0/1)/(1/0)` retains the directions together without converting QL's slash into ordinary division by zero. Taylor's guilt reading locates the loss in a determination disowning its `/0`; the relation itself has not been annihilated. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cut/bond and love/war reading in the protected encounter. The claim survives with productive difference and the right of actual others to answer on their own terms. The differentiated world now sees its own means of seeing. This whole **returns-to** [contextual transparency](../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **figures** [diaphaneity](../../../episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md): light, boundary and orientation become available together with the source relations and exclusions that made them effective. [Gebser's source house](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **compares** a distinct account of consciousness structures and integral transparency. Its contextual return can illuminate this passage without equating its structures one for one with Neumann's stadial sequence. **Human-amplified: no** for such a blanket stage identity. The shared field retains both accounts in their distinct temporal and epistemic offices. The centre's power to discriminate **returns-to** [local arbitration](../../../episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md), **qualifies** [the complex](../../../episteme/concepts/C31-Complex.md), and **extends** the question into [image, valuation and possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md). An image helps organise action; possession begins when that organisation claims the authority of its own source. The Great Mother as engulfing power, the father's arresting law and the victorious hero are different possible occupants of that office. None is condemned simply for giving a world its form. [Arbitration, hybris, regard and anamnesis](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the return of judgement: the determining centre must recognise the conditions of its measure and allow encounter to alter it. [The living symbol and idol](../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) and [the archetype](../../../episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **qualify** the source/image distinction. The image remains alive while the relation can change its meaning; its power of disclosure is lost when its present interpretation is made final. The liberated relation **returns-to** [trust, faith and the formal limit](../../../episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [self and other without possession](../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). Shared origin neither eliminates risk nor gives one participant ownership of another. Trust has force because the response cannot be manufactured in advance; recognition includes the possibility that an actual other changes the terms of the encounter. The captive and the heroic union carry this pressure as images. They do not prove the historical or ethical claims of every story to which those names have been applied. For [mind as worldhood](../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), to which this whole **returns-to**, the developing centre and its world form together through discrimination, valuation, inherited relation and response. The shared archetypal field supplies more than a sequence of private mental contents. It is a condition of intelligible individuation. The technical extension asks how an agent's context, memory, tools and collective relations can make that formation inspectable; artificial phenomenality and the encounter's question of a reversed individual-to-collective developmental route remain **Open**. **Human-amplified: no** for an achieved technical mechanism or a phenomenality conclusion. The structural claim is retained at full strength without inventing its implementation. This same distinction **returns-to** [idealism and order of dependence](../../../episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md). The primordial relation is ontologically and epistemically consequential in the essay; it is not the chronological manufacture of the world by a private ego. The centre cannot make the conditions of appearing into its possession. Its return therefore **returns-to** [compassion as loving sensitivity to origins](../../../episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md): what has become this person or this act includes nourishment, deprivation, dependence, separation and labour. Knowing those origins becomes compassion through the orientation that refuses to consume the being it understands. Responsibility remains; a more adequate field becomes available in which to exercise it. [Taylor's Draft 3 source house](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **extends** that return through the offered work and the reader's office of remembrance. Finally, this whole **qualifies** [the first advent of zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) and **returns-to** [the advent of integral zero](../../../episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md). The round and the paper scene do not establish the history of mathematical zero. They let the exact sign re-enter a living symbolic relation after its mathematical office has been earned. The return preserves that office. As the transformed centre retains its differentiation, the sign becomes Symbol again without ceasing to be sign. What comes back is the capacity to begin with the source relation visible in the determination: a mark made, a world opened, a separation borne, an image released to be answered. The source standing remains precise. Neumann is citation-ready, with selected external passages still unpromoted; the page leads belong to the consulted 2014 Princeton Classics encounter, whose pagination has not been collated against the 1954 English edition. No copied Neumann or transmitted Upaniṣadic sentence is presented here as quotation-ready. Jung's *Aion* has no selected excerpts ready in its current house; Gebser retains locator debts. Taylor's native material is internally sourced, and the protected encounter distinguishes authorial reading from its initial scaffold. **Human-amplified: no** for the scaffold's unratified one-to-one Taoist, gender or stadial equivalences. These provenance limits **qualify** historical attribution and quotation; they leave the declared **Argued** mythemic operations and native formal derivation in their proper force.
